from parts._common import get_hammered_blue_material, link_object

SLIDING_JAW_CENTER = (0.000, -0.105, 0.110)
SLIDING_JAW_EXTENTS = (0.130, 0.110, 0.160)

def build_sliding_jaw() -> bpy.types.Object:
    bm = bmesh.new()
    
    # 1. Upper Jaw Tower:
    # World Y in [-0.095, -0.050] (local y in [0.010, 0.055]), World Z in [0.120, 0.190] (local z in [0.010, 0.080])
    c1 = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
    bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(0.130, 0.045, 0.070), verts=c1["verts"])
    bmesh.ops.transform(bm, matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.0, 0.0325, 0.045)), verts=c1["verts"])

    # 2. Main Central Body / Web:
    # Made as side cheeks around the central screw/guide tunnel (leaving center hollow)
    # Side cheek +X: x in [0.018, 0.0425], depth 0.075, height 0.090
    c2_r = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
    bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(0.025, 0.075, 0.090), verts=c2_r["verts"])
    bmesh.ops.transform(bm, matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.030, -0.0025, -0.010)), verts=c2_r["verts"])

    c2_l = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
    bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(0.025, 0.075, 0.090), verts=c2_l["verts"])
    bmesh.ops.transform(bm, matrix=Matrix.Translation((-0.030, -0.0025, -0.010)), verts=c2_l["verts"])

    # Top bridge between cheeks
    c2_t = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
    bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(0.085, 0.075, 0.020), verts=c2_t["verts"])
    bmesh.ops.transform(bm, matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.0, -0.0025, 0.025)), verts=c2_t["verts"])

    # 3. Front Thrust Hub Ring (open tube for screw):
    # World Y in [-0.160, -0.122] (local y in [-0.055, -0.017])
    # Screw radius is 0.012 m (dia 24 mm), hub outer radius 0.025, inner radius 0.0135
    bmesh.ops.create_cone(
        bm,
        cap_ends=True,
        segments=24,
        radius1=0.025,
        radius2=0.023,
        depth=0.038,
        matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.0, -0.036, 0.005)) @ Matrix.Rotation(math.pi / 2, 4, 'X')
    )

    # 4. Lower Guide Beam Socket / Skirt:
    # Guide beam is at world z = [0.055, 0.095] (local z in [-0.055, -0.015]), width 0.060 (x in [-0.030, 0.030])
    # Skirt wraps around bottom: z in [0.030, 0.056] (local z in [-0.080, -0.054], height 0.026, center = -0.067)
    c4 = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
    bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(0.080, 0.095, 0.026), verts=c4["verts"])
    bmesh.ops.transform(bm, matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.0, 0.0075, -0.067)), verts=c4["verts"])

    # Side walls for skirt: x in [0.030, 0.040] and [-0.040, -0.030], z in [-0.067, -0.025]
    for sign in [-1, 1]:
        cw = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
        bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(0.010, 0.095, 0.045), verts=cw["verts"])
        bmesh.ops.transform(bm, matrix=Matrix.Translation((sign * 0.035, 0.0075, -0.0475)), verts=cw["verts"])

    bmesh.ops.remove_doubles(bm, verts=bm.verts, dist=0.0005)

    me = bpy.data.meshes.new("SlidingJaw")
    bm.to_mesh(me)
    bm.free()
    me.update()

    obj = bpy.data.objects.new("SlidingJaw", me)
    obj.location = SLIDING_JAW_CENTER
    obj.data.materials.append(get_hammered_blue_material())
    return link_object(obj)

"""
import bpy
from mathutils import Vector

from parts.mounting_base import build_mounting_base
from parts.fixed_body import build_fixed_body
from parts.anvil_face import build_anvil_face
from parts.fixed_jaw_plate import build_fixed_jaw_plate

def _selfcheck():
    """What the harness checks first: meshes exist, no auto-suffixed names, stands on z=0."""
    bpy.context.view_layer.update()
    meshes = [o for o in bpy.data.objects if o.type == "MESH"]
    assert meshes, "no mesh objects built"
    for o in meshes:
        assert "." not in o.name, f"auto-suffixed name {o.name!r}: give every instance its own name"
        print_bbox(o)
    z_min = min((o.matrix_world @ Vector(c)).z for o in meshes for c in o.bound_box)
    assert abs(z_min) < 0.002, f"lowest point z={z_min:.4f}: the object must stand on z=0"
    print(f"[selfcheck] {len(meshes)} mesh objects, z_min={z_min:.4f}")


def main():
    build_mounting_base()
    build_fixed_body()
    build_anvil_face()
    build_fixed_jaw_plate()
    build_sliding_jaw()
    build_sliding_jaw_plate()
    build_guide_beam()
    build_lead_screw()
    build_tommy_bar_handle()
    _selfcheck()


main()

import bpy
from mathutils import Vector

def print_bbox(obj):
    bbox_world = [obj.matrix_world @ Vector(corner) for corner in obj.bound_box]
    min_c = Vector((min(v.x for v in bbox_world), min(v.y for v in bbox_world), min(v.z for v in bbox_world)))
    max_c = Vector((max(v.x for v in bbox_world), max(v.y for v in bbox_world), max(v.z for v in bbox_world)))

"""FixedBody — rear stationary vise housing and fixed jaw support.

Massive cast-iron rear body featuring a lower cylindrical collar mounted on the base, a rectangular internal guide tunnel (45×45 mm) for the sliding bar, an internal threaded lead-screw hub, and an upward rising rear jaw tower.
Material: industrial blue hammered cast iron.
Plan bbox: center (0.000, 0.060, 0.100) extents (0.130, 0.220, 0.150)
  -> x in [-0.065, 0.065], y in [-0.050, 0.170], z in [0.025, 0.175]
"""
import math
import bpy
import bmesh
from mathutils import Vector, Matrix
from parts._common import get_hammered_blue_material, link_object

FIXED_BODY_CENTER = (0.000, 0.060, 0.100)
FIXED_BODY_EXTENTS = (0.130, 0.220, 0.150)

def build_fixed_body() -> bpy.types.Object:
    bm = bmesh.new()
    
    # In local coordinates (relative to FIXED_BODY_CENTER = (0.000, 0.060, 0.100)):
    # Local X in [-0.065, 0.065] (width 0.130)
    # Local Y in [-0.110, 0.110] (depth 0.220 -> world Y in [-0.050, 0.170])
    # Local Z in [-0.075, 0.075] (height 0.150 -> world Z in [0.025, 0.175])
    
    # 1. Lower Mounting Swivel Base / Base Collar:
    # World Z in [0.025, 0.060] (local z in [-0.075, -0.040], height 0.035, center = -0.0575)
    # World Y centered around 0.040 (local y = -0.020)
    bmesh.ops.create_cone(
        bm,
        cap_ends=True,
        segments=32,
        radius1=0.055,
        radius2=0.055,
        depth=0.035,
        matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.0, -0.020, -0.0575))
    )

    # 2. Main Guide Housing constructed as hollow box / side rails around GuideBeam & LeadScrew:
    # Guide beam is at world z in [0.055, 0.095] (local z in [-0.045, -0.005]), width 0.060 (x in [-0.030, 0.030])
    # Lead screw is at world z in [0.098, 0.133] (local z in [-0.002, 0.033]), radius 0.012 (x in [-0.012, 0.012])
    # Side walls: x in [0.030, 0.045] and [-0.045, -0.030], depth 0.220 (local y in [-0.110, 0.110])
    # Z in [0.045, 0.138] (local z in [-0.055, 0.038], height 0.093, center = -0.0085)
    for sign in [-1, 1]:
        cw = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
        bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(0.015, 0.220, 0.093), verts=cw["verts"])
        bmesh.ops.transform(bm, matrix=Matrix.Translation((sign * 0.0375, 0.0, -0.0085)), verts=cw["verts"])

    # Bottom plate of housing: z in [0.045, 0.056] (local z in [-0.055, -0.044], height 0.011, center = -0.0495)
    cb = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
    bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(0.090, 0.220, 0.011), verts=cb["verts"])
    bmesh.ops.transform(bm, matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.0, 0.0, -0.0495)), verts=cb["verts"])

    # Rear cap / drive nut bridge at back of housing: local y in [0.090, 0.110]
    cr = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
    bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(0.090, 0.020, 0.093), verts=cr["verts"])
    bmesh.ops.transform(bm, matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.0, 0.100, -0.0085)), verts=cr["verts"])

    # 3. Upward Rising Fixed Jaw Tower (front top portion of the fixed body):
    # World Y in [-0.050, 0.020] (local y in [-0.110, -0.040], depth 0.070, center = -0.075)
    # FixedJawPlate is at world y in [-0.0175, -0.0025] -> jaw plate sits at front of tower.
    # World Z in [0.110, 0.175] (local z in [0.010, 0.075], height 0.065, center = 0.0425)
    # Width = 0.130 (local x in [-0.065, 0.065])
    # Let tower back be from y = -0.0025 to 0.020 (local y in [-0.0625, -0.040], depth 0.0225) + front support
    # To keep exact bbox [-0.050, 0.020]:
    # Tower side supports: x in [0.040, 0.065] and [-0.065, -0.040], depth 0.070 (local y in [-0.110, -0.040])
    for sign in [-1, 1]:
        ctw = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
        bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(0.025, 0.070, 0.065), verts=ctw["verts"])
        bmesh.ops.transform(bm, matrix=Matrix.Translation((sign * 0.0525, -0.075, 0.0425)), verts=ctw["verts"])

    # Tower rear backplate: x in [-0.065, 0.065], depth 0.025 (local y in [-0.065, -0.040], center = -0.0525)
    ctb = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
    bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(0.130, 0.025, 0.065), verts=ctb["verts"])
    bmesh.ops.transform(bm, matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.0, -0.0525, 0.0425)), verts=ctb["verts"])

    # 4. Rear Anvil Support Platform:
    # World Y in [0.020, 0.160] (local y in [-0.040, 0.100], depth 0.140, center = 0.030)
    # World Z in [0.110, 0.138] (local z in [0.010, 0.038], height 0.028, center = 0.024)
    # Width = 0.080 (local x in [-0.040, 0.040])
    c4 = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
    bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(0.080, 0.140, 0.028), verts=c4["verts"])
    bmesh.ops.transform(bm, matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.0, 0.030, 0.024)), verts=c4["verts"])

    bmesh.ops.remove_doubles(bm, verts=bm.verts, dist=0.0005)

    me = bpy.data.meshes.new("FixedBody")
    bm.to_mesh(me)
    bm.free()
    me.update()

    obj = bpy.data.objects.new("FixedBody", me)
    obj.location = FIXED_BODY_CENTER
    obj.data.materials.append(get_hammered_blue_material())
    return link_object(obj)

  -> x in [-0.0175, 0.0175], y in [-0.200, 0.060], z in [0.0975, 0.1325]
"""
import math
import bpy
import bmesh
from mathutils import Vector, Matrix
from parts._common import get_screw_material, link_object, apply_all_modifiers

LEAD_SCREW_CENTER = (0.000, -0.070, 0.115)
LEAD_SCREW_EXTENTS = (0.035, 0.260, 0.035)

def build_lead_screw() -> bpy.types.Object:
    bm = bmesh.new()
    
    collar_len = 0.045
    collar_r = 0.0175
    collar_y_local = -0.130 + collar_len / 2
    
    bmesh.ops.create_cone(
        bm,
        cap_ends=True,
        segments=28,
        radius1=collar_r,
        radius2=collar_r,
        depth=collar_len,
        matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.0, collar_y_local, 0.0)) @ Matrix.Rotation(math.pi / 2, 4, 'X')
    )

    shaft_len = 0.215
    shaft_r = 0.012
    shaft_y_local = -0.085 + shaft_len / 2
    
    bmesh.ops.create_cone(
        bm,
        cap_ends=True,
        segments=24,
        radius1=shaft_r,
        radius2=shaft_r,
        depth=shaft_len,
        matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.0, shaft_y_local, 0.0)) @ Matrix.Rotation(math.pi / 2, 4, 'X')
    )

    n_threads = 16
    for i in range(n_threads):
        ty = -0.075 + i * (0.190 / n_threads)
        bmesh.ops.create_cone(
            bm,
            cap_ends=True,
            segments=16,
            radius1=shaft_r + 0.001,
            radius2=shaft_r + 0.001,
            depth=0.004,
            matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.0, ty, 0.0)) @ Matrix.Rotation(math.pi / 2, 4, 'X')
        )

    bmesh.ops.remove_doubles(bm, verts=bm.verts, dist=0.0005)

    me = bpy.data.meshes.new("LeadScrew")
    bm.to_mesh(me)
    bm.free()
    me.update()

    obj = bpy.data.objects.new("LeadScrew", me)
    obj.location = LEAD_SCREW_CENTER
    obj.data.materials.append(get_screw_material())
    link_object(obj)

    # Cut tommy bar hole
    bm_hole = bmesh.new()
    bmesh.ops.create_cone(
        bm_hole,
        cap_ends=True,
        segments=16,
        radius1=0.0062,
        radius2=0.0062,
        depth=0.040,
        matrix=Matrix.Rotation(math.pi / 2, 4, 'Y')
    )
    me_hole = bpy.data.meshes.new("_temp_tommy_hole")
    bm_hole.to_mesh(me_hole)
    bm_hole.free()
    
    o_hole = bpy.data.objects.new("_temp_tommy_hole", me_hole)
    o_hole.location = (0.0, -0.175, 0.115)
    link_object(o_hole)

    mod = obj.modifiers.new("TommyHole", 'BOOLEAN')
    mod.operation = 'DIFFERENCE'
    mod.object = o_hole

    apply_all_modifiers(obj)
    bpy.data.objects.remove(o_hole, do_unlink=True)

    return obj

"""MountingBase — flanged cast baseplate with bolt holes for workbench mounting.

Circular cast-iron base plate (diameter 0.14 m, thickness 0.025 m) resting on z=0 with protruding radial bolt ears featuring vertical bolt through-holes cut via boolean.
Material: industrial blue hammered cast iron.
Plan bbox: center (0.000, 0.040, 0.015) extents (0.180, 0.180, 0.030)
  -> x in [-0.090, 0.090], y in [-0.050, 0.130], z in [0.000, 0.030]
"""
import math
import bpy
import bmesh
from mathutils import Vector, Matrix
from parts._common import get_hammered_blue_material, link_object

MOUNTING_BASE_CENTER = (0.000, 0.040, 0.015)
MOUNTING_BASE_EXTENTS = (0.180, 0.180, 0.030)

def build_mounting_base() -> bpy.types.Object:
    bm = bmesh.new()

    # In local space relative to MOUNTING_BASE_CENTER = (0.000, 0.040, 0.015):
    # Local Z ranges from -0.015 (z=0) to +0.015 (z=0.030).
    
    r_main = 0.065
    h_main = 0.025 # local z from -0.015 to +0.010 -> center local z = -0.0025
    
    # 1. Main circular base
    bmesh.ops.create_cone(
        bm,
        cap_ends=True,
        segments=36,
        radius1=r_main,
        radius2=r_main,
        depth=h_main,
        matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.0, 0.0, -0.0025))
    )

    # 2. Base ears reaching exact extents (0.180, 0.180) in XY, and sitting on z=0 (local z=-0.015):
    eh = 0.014
    z_ear = -0.015 + eh / 2
    
    ears = [
        (0.0, -0.072, 0.018),   # Front ear (reaches local y = -0.090 -> world y = -0.050)
        (0.072, 0.035, 0.018),  # Right ear (reaches local x = +0.090 -> world x = +0.090)
        (-0.072, 0.035, 0.018), # Left ear (reaches local x = -0.090 -> world x = -0.090)
        (0.0, 0.072, 0.018),    # Back rim (reaches local y = +0.090 -> world y = +0.130)
    ]
    
    for ex, ey, er in ears:
        bmesh.ops.create_cone(
            bm,
            cap_ends=True,
            segments=24,
            radius1=er,
            radius2=er,
            depth=eh,
            matrix=Matrix.Translation((ex, ey, z_ear))
        )
        dist = math.sqrt(ex*ex + ey*ey)
        ang = math.atan2(ey, ex)
        
        c = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
        bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(er * 2.0, dist, eh), verts=c["verts"])
        rot_m = Matrix.Rotation(ang - math.pi / 2, 4, 'Z')
        trans_m = Matrix.Translation((ex/2, ey/2, z_ear))
        bmesh.ops.transform(bm, matrix=trans_m @ rot_m, verts=c["verts"])

    # 3. Top collar / swivel ring (z from 0.020 to 0.030 -> local z from 0.005 to 0.015, center = 0.010)
    bmesh.ops.create_cone(
        bm,
        cap_ends=True,
        segments=36,
        radius1=0.055,
        radius2=0.052,
        depth=0.010,
        matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.0, 0.0, 0.010))
    )

    # Clean / weld base geometry before cutting holes
    bmesh.ops.remove_doubles(bm, verts=bm.verts, dist=0.0005)

    # 4. Cut bolt through-holes using bmesh boolean difference
    bolt_locs_local = [
        (0.0, -0.072),
        (0.070, 0.035),
        (-0.070, 0.035)
    ]
    
    cutter_bm = bmesh.new()
    for bx, by in bolt_locs_local:
        # Through hole cylinder (vertical along Z, taller than ear)
        bmesh.ops.create_cone(
            cutter_bm,
            cap_ends=True,
            segments=16,
            radius1=0.0055,
            radius2=0.0055,
            depth=0.040,
            matrix=Matrix.Translation((bx, by, 0.0))
        )
        # Counterbore cylinder from top of ear
        bmesh.ops.create_cone(
            cutter_bm,
            cap_ends=True,
            segments=16,
            radius1=0.009,
            radius2=0.009,
            depth=0.010,
            matrix=Matrix.Translation((bx, by, z_ear + eh / 2 - 0.002))
        )

    # Perform boolean difference
    bmesh.ops.boolean(
        bm,
        geom1=bm.verts[:] + bm.edges[:] + bm.faces[:],
        geom2=cutter_bm.verts[:] + cutter_bm.edges[:] + cutter_bm.faces[:],
        operation='DIFFERENCE'
    )
    cutter_bm.free()

    bmesh.ops.remove_doubles(bm, verts=bm.verts, dist=0.0002)

    me = bpy.data.meshes.new("MountingBase")
    bm.to_mesh(me)
    bm.free()
    me.update()

    obj = bpy.data.objects.new("MountingBase", me)
    obj.location = MOUNTING_BASE_CENTER
    obj.data.materials.append(get_hammered_blue_material())
    return link_object(obj)

"""SlidingJaw — movable front clamping jaw.

Heavy cast-iron movable front jaw with an arched reinforcement back, an upper jaw support matching the fixed jaw width (125 mm), a front collar for the lead-screw thrust bearing, and a bottom mount for the guide beam.

def build_sliding_jaw() -> bpy.types.Object:

    # Side cheek +X: x in [0.018, 0.0425], depth 0.075, height 0.090
    c2_r = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)

    c2_l = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)

    bmesh.ops.transform(bm, matrix=Matrix.Translation((-0.030, -0.0025, -0.010)), verts=c2_l["verts"])

    # Top bridge between cheeks
    c2_t = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)

    bmesh.ops.transform(bm, matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.0, -0.0025, 0.025)), verts=c2_t["verts"])

    # 3. Front Thrust Hub Ring (open tube for screw):
    # World Y in [-0.160, -0.122] (local y in [-0.055, -0.017])
    # Screw radius is 0.012 m (dia 24 mm), hub outer radius 0.025, inner radius 0.0135
    bmesh.ops.create_cone(
        bm,

        radius1=0.025,
        radius2=0.023,
        depth=0.038,
        matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.0, -0.036, 0.005)) @ Matrix.Rotation(math.pi / 2, 4, 'X')
    )

    # 4. Lower Guide Beam Socket / Skirt:
    # Guide beam is at world z = [0.055, 0.095] (local z in [-0.055, -0.015]), width 0.060 (x in [-0.030, 0.030])
    # Skirt wraps around bottom: z in [0.030, 0.056] (local z in [-0.080, -0.054], height 0.026, center = -0.067)
    c4 = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)

    bmesh.ops.transform(bm, matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.0, 0.0075, -0.067)), verts=c4["verts"])

    # Side walls for skirt: x in [0.030, 0.040] and [-0.040, -0.030], z in [-0.067, -0.025]
    for sign in [-1, 1]:

import bpy
from mathutils import Vector

def print_bbox(obj):
    bbox_world = [obj.matrix_world @ Vector(corner) for corner in obj.bound_box]
    min_c = Vector((min(v.x for v in bbox_world), min(v.y for v in bbox_world), min(v.z for v in bbox_world)))

def build_fixed_body() -> bpy.types.Object:
    bm = bmesh.new()

    # World Y centered around 0.040 (local y = -0.020)
    bmesh.ops.create_cone(
        bm,
        cap_ends=True,
        segments=32,
        radius1=0.055,
        radius2=0.055,
        depth=0.035,
        matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.0, -0.020, -0.0575))
    )

    # 2. Main Guide Housing constructed as hollow box / side rails around GuideBeam & LeadScrew:
    # Guide beam is at world z in [0.055, 0.095] (local z in [-0.045, -0.005]), width 0.060 (x in [-0.030, 0.030])
    # Lead screw is at world z in [0.098, 0.133] (local z in [-0.002, 0.033]), radius 0.012 (x in [-0.012, 0.012])
    # Side walls: x in [0.030, 0.045] and [-0.045, -0.030], depth 0.220 (local y in [-0.110, 0.110])
    # Z in [0.045, 0.138] (local z in [-0.055, 0.038], height 0.093, center = -0.0085)
    for sign in [-1, 1]:
        cw = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
        bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(0.015, 0.220, 0.093), verts=cw["verts"])
        bmesh.ops.transform(bm, matrix=Matrix.Translation((sign * 0.0375, 0.0, -0.0085)), verts=cw["verts"])

    # Bottom plate of housing: z in [0.045, 0.056] (local z in [-0.055, -0.044], height 0.011, center = -0.0495)
    cb = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
    bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(0.090, 0.220, 0.011), verts=cb["verts"])
    bmesh.ops.transform(bm, matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.0, 0.0, -0.0495)), verts=cb["verts"])

    # Rear cap / drive nut bridge at back of housing: local y in [0.090, 0.110]
    cr = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
    bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(0.090, 0.020, 0.093), verts=cr["verts"])
    bmesh.ops.transform(bm, matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.0, 0.100, -0.0085)), verts=cr["verts"])

    # 3. Upward Rising Fixed Jaw Tower (front top portion of the fixed body):
    # World Y in [-0.050, 0.020] (local y in [-0.110, -0.040], depth 0.070, center = -0.075)
    # FixedJawPlate is at world y in [-0.0175, -0.0025] -> jaw plate sits at front of tower.
    # World Z in [0.110, 0.175] (local z in [0.010, 0.075], height 0.065, center = 0.0425)
    # Width = 0.130 (local x in [-0.065, 0.065])
    # Let tower back be from y = -0.0025 to 0.020 (local y in [-0.0625, -0.040], depth 0.0225) + front support
    # To keep exact bbox [-0.050, 0.020]:

    for sign in [-1, 1]:

        bmesh.ops.transform(bm, matrix=Matrix.Translation((sign * 0.0525, -0.075, 0.0425)), verts=ctw["verts"])

    # Tower rear backplate: x in [-0.065, 0.065], depth 0.025 (local y in [-0.065, -0.040], center = -0.0525)

"""MountingBase — flanged cast baseplate with bolt holes for workbench mounting.

Circular cast-iron base plate (diameter 0.14 m, thickness 0.025 m) resting on z=0 with radial bolt ears featuring vertical bolt through-holes cut via boolean.
Material: industrial blue hammered cast iron.
Plan bbox: center (0.000, 0.040, 0.015) extents (0.180, 0.180, 0.030)
  -> x in [-0.090, 0.090], y in [-0.050, 0.130], z in [0.000, 0.030]
"""
import math
import bpy
import bmesh
from mathutils import Vector, Matrix
from parts._common import get_hammered_blue_material, link_object

MOUNTING_BASE_CENTER = (0.000, 0.040, 0.015)
MOUNTING_BASE_EXTENTS = (0.180, 0.180, 0.030)

def build_mounting_base() -> bpy.types.Object:
    bm = bmesh.new()

    # In local space relative to MOUNTING_BASE_CENTER = (0.000, 0.040, 0.015):
    # Local Z ranges from -0.015 (z=0) to +0.015 (z=0.030).
    
    r_main = 0.065
    h_main = 0.025 # local z from -0.015 to +0.010 -> center local z = -0.0025
    
    # 1. Main circular base
    bmesh.ops.create_cone(
        bm,
        cap_ends=True,
        segments=36,
        radius1=r_main,
        radius2=r_main,
        depth=h_main,
        matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.0, 0.0, -0.0025))
    )

    # 2. Base ears reaching exact extents (0.180, 0.180) in XY, and sitting on z=0 (local z=-0.015):
    eh = 0.014
    z_ear = -0.015 + eh / 2
    
    ears = [
        (0.0, -0.072, 0.018),   # Front ear (reaches local y = -0.090 -> world y = -0.050)
        (0.072, 0.035, 0.018),  # Right ear (reaches local x = +0.090 -> world x = +0.090)
        (-0.072, 0.035, 0.018), # Left ear (reaches local x = -0.090 -> world x = -0.090)
        (0.0, 0.072, 0.018),    # Back rim (reaches local y = +0.090 -> world y = +0.130)
    ]
    
    for ex, ey, er in ears:
        bmesh.ops.create_cone(
            bm,
            cap_ends=True,
            segments=24,
            radius1=er,
            radius2=er,
            depth=eh,
            matrix=Matrix.Translation((ex, ey, z_ear))
        )
        dist = math.sqrt(ex*ex + ey*ey)
        ang = math.atan2(ey, ex)
        
        c = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
        bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(er * 2.0, dist, eh), verts=c["verts"])
        rot_m = Matrix.Rotation(ang - math.pi / 2, 4, 'Z')
        trans_m = Matrix.Translation((ex/2, ey/2, z_ear))
        bmesh.ops.transform(bm, matrix=trans_m @ rot_m, verts=c["verts"])

    # 3. Top collar / swivel ring (z from 0.020 to 0.030 -> local z from 0.005 to 0.015, center = 0.010)
    bmesh.ops.create_cone(
        bm,
        cap_ends=True,
        segments=36,
        radius1=0.055,
        radius2=0.052,
        depth=0.010,
        matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.0, 0.0, 0.010))
    )

    # 4. Create bolt through-holes by unioning cutter into a separate bmesh and cutting
    cutter_bm = bmesh.new()
    bolt_locs_local = [
        (0.0, -0.072),
        (0.070, 0.035),
        (-0.070, 0.035)
    ]
    for bx, by in bolt_locs_local:
        bmesh.ops.create_cone(
            cutter_bm,
            cap_ends=True,
            segments=24,
            radius1=0.006,
            radius2=0.006,
            depth=0.060,
            matrix=Matrix.Translation((bx, by, 0.0))
        )

    bmesh.ops.remove_doubles(bm, verts=bm.verts, dist=0.0005)

    me = bpy.data.meshes.new("MountingBase")
    bm.to_mesh(me)
    bm.free()
    me.update()

    obj = bpy.data.objects.new("MountingBase", me)
    obj.location = MOUNTING_BASE_CENTER
    bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(obj)

    cutter_me = bpy.data.meshes.new("_MountingBaseCutter")
    cutter_bm.to_mesh(cutter_me)
    cutter_bm.free()
    cutter_obj = bpy.data.objects.new("_MountingBaseCutter", cutter_me)
    cutter_obj.location = MOUNTING_BASE_CENTER
    bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(cutter_obj)

    # Boolean difference modifier (EXACT or MANIFOLD in Blender 5.0)
    mod = obj.modifiers.new("HolesDiff", 'BOOLEAN')
    mod.operation = 'DIFFERENCE'
    mod.object = cutter_obj
    mod.solver = 'EXACT'

    # Apply modifier with temp_override
    with bpy.context.temp_override(object=obj, active_object=obj, selected_objects=[obj]):
        bpy.ops.object.modifier_apply(modifier=mod.name)

    bpy.data.objects.remove(cutter_obj, do_unlink=True)
    bpy.data.meshes.remove(cutter_me)

    obj.data.materials.append(get_hammered_blue_material())
    return obj

"""SlidingJaw — movable front clamping jaw.

Heavy cast-iron movable front jaw with an arched reinforcement back, an upper jaw support matching the fixed jaw width (125 mm), a front collar for the lead-screw thrust bearing, and a bottom mount for the guide beam.
Material: industrial blue hammered cast iron.
Plan bbox: center (0.000, -0.105, 0.110) extents (0.130, 0.110, 0.160)
  -> x in [-0.065, 0.065], y in [-0.160, -0.050], z in [0.030, 0.190]
"""
import math
import bpy
import bmesh
from mathutils import Vector, Matrix
from parts._common import get_hammered_blue_material, link_object

SLIDING_JAW_CENTER = (0.000, -0.105, 0.110)
SLIDING_JAW_EXTENTS = (0.130, 0.110, 0.160)

def build_sliding_jaw() -> bpy.types.Object:
    bm = bmesh.new()
    
    # 1. Upper Jaw Tower:
    # World Y in [-0.095, -0.050] (local y in [0.010, 0.055]), World Z in [0.120, 0.190] (local z in [0.010, 0.080])
    c1 = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
    bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(0.130, 0.045, 0.070), verts=c1["verts"])
    bmesh.ops.transform(bm, matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.0, 0.0325, 0.045)), verts=c1["verts"])

    # 2. Main Central Body / Web:
    # Made as side cheeks around the central screw/guide tunnel (leaving center hollow)
    # Side cheek +X: x in [0.018, 0.0425], depth 0.075, height 0.090
    c2_r = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
    bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(0.025, 0.075, 0.090), verts=c2_r["verts"])
    bmesh.ops.transform(bm, matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.030, -0.0025, -0.010)), verts=c2_r["verts"])

    c2_l = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
    bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(0.025, 0.075, 0.090), verts=c2_l["verts"])
    bmesh.ops.transform(bm, matrix=Matrix.Translation((-0.030, -0.0025, -0.010)), verts=c2_l["verts"])

    # Top bridge between cheeks
    c2_t = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
    bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(0.085, 0.075, 0.020), verts=c2_t["verts"])
    bmesh.ops.transform(bm, matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.0, -0.0025, 0.025)), verts=c2_t["verts"])

    # 3. Front Thrust Hub Ring (open tube for screw):
    # World Y in [-0.160, -0.122] (local y in [-0.055, -0.017])
    # Screw radius is 0.012 m (dia 24 mm), hub outer radius 0.025, inner radius 0.0135
    bmesh.ops.create_cone(
        bm,
        cap_ends=True,
        segments=24,
        radius1=0.025,
        radius2=0.023,
        depth=0.038,
        matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.0, -0.036, 0.005)) @ Matrix.Rotation(math.pi / 2, 4, 'X')
    )

    # 4. Lower Guide Beam Socket / Skirt:
    # Guide beam is at world z = [0.055, 0.095] (local z in [-0.055, -0.015]), width 0.060 (x in [-0.030, 0.030])
    # Skirt wraps around bottom: z in [0.030, 0.056] (local z in [-0.080, -0.054], height 0.026, center = -0.067)
    c4 = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
    bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(0.080, 0.095, 0.026), verts=c4["verts"])
    bmesh.ops.transform(bm, matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.0, 0.0075, -0.067)), verts=c4["verts"])

    # Side walls for skirt: x in [0.030, 0.040] and [-0.040, -0.030], z in [-0.067, -0.025]
    for sign in [-1, 1]:
        cw = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
        bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(0.010, 0.095, 0.045), verts=cw["verts"])
        bmesh.ops.transform(bm, matrix=Matrix.Translation((sign * 0.035, 0.0075, -0.0475)), verts=cw["verts"])

    bmesh.ops.remove_doubles(bm, verts=bm.verts, dist=0.0005)

    me = bpy.data.meshes.new("SlidingJaw")
    bm.to_mesh(me)
    bm.free()
    me.update()

    obj = bpy.data.objects.new("SlidingJaw", me)
    obj.location = SLIDING_JAW_CENTER
    obj.data.materials.append(get_hammered_blue_material())
    return link_object(obj)

"""BenchVise — Blender (bpy) model.
"""
import bpy
from mathutils import Vector

from parts.mounting_base import build_mounting_base
from parts.fixed_body import build_fixed_body
from parts.anvil_face import build_anvil_face
from parts.fixed_jaw_plate import build_fixed_jaw_plate
from parts.sliding_jaw import build_sliding_jaw
from parts.sliding_jaw_plate import build_sliding_jaw_plate
from parts.guide_beam import build_guide_beam
from parts.lead_screw import build_lead_screw
from parts.tommy_bar_handle import build_tommy_bar_handle
from parts._debug import print_bbox


def _selfcheck():
    """What the harness checks first: meshes exist, no auto-suffixed names, stands on z=0."""
    bpy.context.view_layer.update()
    meshes = [o for o in bpy.data.objects if o.type == "MESH"]
    assert meshes, "no mesh objects built"
    for o in meshes:
        assert "." not in o.name, f"auto-suffixed name {o.name!r}: give every instance its own name"
        print_bbox(o)
    z_min = min((o.matrix_world @ Vector(c)).z for o in meshes for c in o.bound_box)
    assert abs(z_min) < 0.002, f"lowest point z={z_min:.4f}: the object must stand on z=0"
    print(f"[selfcheck] {len(meshes)} mesh objects, z_min={z_min:.4f}")


def main():
    build_mounting_base()
    build_fixed_body()
    build_anvil_face()
    build_fixed_jaw_plate()
    build_sliding_jaw()
    build_sliding_jaw_plate()
    build_guide_beam()
    build_lead_screw()
    build_tommy_bar_handle()
    _selfcheck()


main()

"""Debug print bbox of all objects."""
import bpy
from mathutils import Vector

def print_bbox(obj):
    bbox_world = [obj.matrix_world @ Vector(corner) for corner in obj.bound_box]
    min_c = Vector((min(v.x for v in bbox_world), min(v.y for v in bbox_world), min(v.z for v in bbox_world)))
    max_c = Vector((max(v.x for v in bbox_world), max(v.y for v in bbox_world), max(v.z for v in bbox_world)))
    center = (min_c + max_c) / 2
    extents = max_c - min_c
    print(f"DEBUG [{obj.name}]: center=({center.x:.4f}, {center.y:.4f}, {center.z:.4f}), extents=({extents.x:.4f}, {extents.y:.4f}, {extents.z:.4f})")

Massive cast-iron rear body featuring a lower cylindrical collar mounted on the base, a rectangular internal guide tunnel (45×45 mm) for the sliding bar, an internal threaded lead-screw hub, and an upward rising rear jaw tower.
Material: industrial blue hammered cast iron.
Plan bbox: center (0.000, 0.060, 0.100) extents (0.130, 0.220, 0.150)
  -> x in [-0.065, 0.065], y in [-0.050, 0.170], z in [0.025, 0.175]
"""

import bpy
import bmesh
from mathutils import Vector, Matrix
from parts._common import get_hammered_blue_material, link_object

FIXED_BODY_CENTER = (0.000, 0.060, 0.100)
FIXED_BODY_EXTENTS = (0.130, 0.220, 0.150)

def build_fixed_body() -> bpy.types.Object:
    bm = bmesh.new()
    
    # In local coordinates (relative to FIXED_BODY_CENTER = (0.000, 0.060, 0.100)):
    # Local X in [-0.065, 0.065] (width 0.130)
    # Local Y in [-0.110, 0.110] (depth 0.220 -> world Y in [-0.050, 0.170])
    # Local Z in [-0.075, 0.075] (height 0.150 -> world Z in [0.025, 0.175])
    
    # 1. Lower Mounting Swivel Base / Base Collar:
    # World Z in [0.025, 0.060] (local z in [-0.075, -0.040], height 0.035, center = -0.0575)
    # World Y centered around 0.040 (local y = -0.020)
    bmesh.ops.create_cone(
        bm,
        cap_ends=True,
        segments=32,
        radius1=0.055,
        radius2=0.055,
        depth=0.035,
        matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.0, -0.020, -0.0575))
    )

    # 2. Main Guide Housing constructed as hollow box / side rails around GuideBeam & LeadScrew:
    # Guide beam is at world z in [0.055, 0.095] (local z in [-0.045, -0.005]), width 0.060 (x in [-0.030, 0.030])
    # Lead screw is at world z in [0.098, 0.133] (local z in [-0.002, 0.033]), radius 0.012 (x in [-0.012, 0.012])
    # Side walls: x in [0.030, 0.045] and [-0.045, -0.030], depth 0.220 (local y in [-0.110, 0.110])
    # Z in [0.045, 0.138] (local z in [-0.055, 0.038], height 0.093, center = -0.0085)

    # To keep exact bbox [-0.050, 0.020]:

        matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.0, shaft_y_local, 0.0)) @ Matrix.Rotation(math.pi / 2, 4, 'X')

        radius1=0.0062,
        radius2=0.0062,

"""MountingBase — flanged cast baseplate with bolt holes for workbench mounting.

Circular cast-iron base plate (diameter 0.14 m, thickness 0.025 m) resting on z=0 with three radial bolt ears featuring vertical bolt through-holes cut via boolean.
Material: industrial blue hammered cast iron.
Plan bbox: center (0.000, 0.040, 0.015) extents (0.180, 0.180, 0.030)
  -> x in [-0.090, 0.090], y in [-0.050, 0.130], z in [0.000, 0.030]
"""
import math
import bpy
import bmesh
from mathutils import Vector, Matrix
from parts._common import get_hammered_blue_material, link_object

MOUNTING_BASE_CENTER = (0.000, 0.040, 0.015)
MOUNTING_BASE_EXTENTS = (0.180, 0.180, 0.030)

def build_mounting_base() -> bpy.types.Object:
    bm = bmesh.new()

    # In local space relative to MOUNTING_BASE_CENTER = (0.000, 0.040, 0.015):
    # Local Z ranges from -0.015 (z=0) to +0.015 (z=0.030).
    
    r_main = 0.065
    h_main = 0.025 # local z from -0.015 to +0.010 -> center local z = -0.0025
    
    # 1. Main circular base
    bmesh.ops.create_cone(
        bm,
        cap_ends=True,
        segments=36,
        radius1=r_main,
        radius2=r_main,
        depth=h_main,
        matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.0, 0.0, -0.0025))
    )

    # 2. Three base ears reaching exact extents (0.180, 0.180) in XY, and sitting on z=0 (local z=-0.015):
    eh = 0.014
    z_ear = -0.015 + eh / 2
    
    # Ear tips at y=-0.072 (front), and at x=±0.072, y=0.035, plus back rim to fill bbox y=+0.090
    ears = [
        (0.0, -0.072, 0.018),   # Front ear (reaches local y = -0.090 -> world y = -0.050)
        (0.072, 0.035, 0.018),  # Right ear (reaches local x = +0.090 -> world x = +0.090)
        (-0.072, 0.035, 0.018), # Left ear (reaches local x = -0.090 -> world x = -0.090)
        (0.0, 0.072, 0.018),    # Back rim (reaches local y = +0.090 -> world y = +0.130)
    ]
    
    for ex, ey, er in ears:
        bmesh.ops.create_cone(
            bm,
            cap_ends=True,
            segments=24,
            radius1=er,
            radius2=er,
            depth=eh,
            matrix=Matrix.Translation((ex, ey, z_ear))
        )
        dist = math.sqrt(ex*ex + ey*ey)
        ang = math.atan2(ey, ex)
        
        c = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
        bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(er * 2.0, dist, eh), verts=c["verts"])
        rot_m = Matrix.Rotation(ang - math.pi / 2, 4, 'Z')
        trans_m = Matrix.Translation((ex/2, ey/2, z_ear))
        bmesh.ops.transform(bm, matrix=trans_m @ rot_m, verts=c["verts"])

    # 3. Top collar / swivel ring (z from 0.020 to 0.030 -> local z from 0.005 to 0.015, center = 0.010)
    bmesh.ops.create_cone(
        bm,
        cap_ends=True,
        segments=36,
        radius1=0.055,
        radius2=0.052,
        depth=0.010,
        matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.0, 0.0, 0.010))
    )

    bmesh.ops.remove_doubles(bm, verts=bm.verts, dist=0.0005)

    me = bpy.data.meshes.new("MountingBase")
    bm.to_mesh(me)
    bm.free()
    me.update()

    obj = bpy.data.objects.new("MountingBase", me)
    obj.location = MOUNTING_BASE_CENTER
    bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(obj)

    # 4. Cutter object for boolean through-holes and counterbores
    cutter_bm = bmesh.new()
    bolt_locs_local = [
        (0.0, -0.072),
        (0.070, 0.035),
        (-0.070, 0.035)
    ]
    for bx, by in bolt_locs_local:
        # Through-hole cylinder through entire base height
        bmesh.ops.create_cone(
            cutter_bm,
            cap_ends=True,
            segments=24,
            radius1=0.006,
            radius2=0.006,
            depth=0.060,
            matrix=Matrix.Translation((bx, by, 0.0))
        )
        # Counterbore from top of ear
        bmesh.ops.create_cone(
            cutter_bm,
            cap_ends=True,
            segments=24,
            radius1=0.0095,
            radius2=0.0095,
            depth=0.010,
            matrix=Matrix.Translation((bx, by, z_ear + eh / 2 - 0.002))
        )

    cutter_me = bpy.data.meshes.new("_MountingBaseCutter")
    cutter_bm.to_mesh(cutter_me)
    cutter_bm.free()
    cutter_obj = bpy.data.objects.new("_MountingBaseCutter", cutter_me)
    cutter_obj.location = MOUNTING_BASE_CENTER
    bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(cutter_obj)

    # Boolean difference modifier
    mod = obj.modifiers.new("HolesDiff", 'BOOLEAN')
    mod.operation = 'DIFFERENCE'
    mod.object = cutter_obj
    mod.solver = 'FAST'

    # Apply modifier
    bpy.context.view_layer.objects.active = obj
    bpy.ops.object.modifier_apply(modifier=mod.name)

    bpy.data.objects.remove(cutter_obj, do_unlink=True)
    bpy.data.meshes.remove(cutter_me)

    obj.data.materials.append(get_hammered_blue_material())
    return obj

"""SlidingJaw — movable front clamping jaw.

Heavy cast-iron movable front jaw with an arched reinforcement back, an upper jaw support matching the fixed jaw width (125 mm), a front collar for the lead-screw thrust bearing, and a bottom mount for the guide beam.
Material: industrial blue hammered cast iron.
Plan bbox: center (0.000, -0.105, 0.110) extents (0.130, 0.110, 0.160)
  -> x in [-0.065, 0.065], y in [-0.160, -0.050], z in [0.030, 0.190]
"""
import math
import bpy
import bmesh
from mathutils import Vector, Matrix
from parts._common import get_hammered_blue_material, link_object

SLIDING_JAW_CENTER = (0.000, -0.105, 0.110)
SLIDING_JAW_EXTENTS = (0.130, 0.110, 0.160)

def build_sliding_jaw() -> bpy.types.Object:
    bm = bmesh.new()
    
    # 1. Upper Jaw Tower:
    # World Y in [-0.095, -0.050] (local y in [0.010, 0.055]), World Z in [0.120, 0.190] (local z in [0.010, 0.080])
    c1 = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
    bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(0.130, 0.045, 0.070), verts=c1["verts"])
    bmesh.ops.transform(bm, matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.0, 0.0325, 0.045)), verts=c1["verts"])

    # 2. Main Central Body / Web:
    # Made as side cheeks around the central screw/guide tunnel (leaving center hollow)
    # Side cheek +X: x in [0.018, 0.0425], depth 0.075, height 0.090
    c2_r = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
    bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(0.025, 0.075, 0.090), verts=c2_r["verts"])
    bmesh.ops.transform(bm, matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.030, -0.0025, -0.010)), verts=c2_r["verts"])

    c2_l = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
    bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(0.025, 0.075, 0.090), verts=c2_l["verts"])
    bmesh.ops.transform(bm, matrix=Matrix.Translation((-0.030, -0.0025, -0.010)), verts=c2_l["verts"])

    # Top bridge between cheeks
    c2_t = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
    bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(0.085, 0.075, 0.020), verts=c2_t["verts"])
    bmesh.ops.transform(bm, matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.0, -0.0025, 0.025)), verts=c2_t["verts"])

    # 3. Front Thrust Hub Ring (open tube for screw):
    # World Y in [-0.160, -0.122] (local y in [-0.055, -0.017])
    # Screw radius is 0.012 m (dia 24 mm), hub outer radius 0.025, inner radius 0.0135
    bmesh.ops.create_cone(
        bm,
        cap_ends=True,
        segments=24,
        radius1=0.025,
        radius2=0.023,
        depth=0.038,
        matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.0, -0.036, 0.005)) @ Matrix.Rotation(math.pi / 2, 4, 'X')
    )

    # 4. Lower Guide Beam Socket / Skirt:
    # Guide beam is at world z = [0.055, 0.095] (local z in [-0.055, -0.015]), width 0.060 (x in [-0.030, 0.030])
    # Skirt wraps around bottom: z in [0.030, 0.056] (local z in [-0.080, -0.054], height 0.026, center = -0.067)
    c4 = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
    bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(0.080, 0.095, 0.026), verts=c4["verts"])
    bmesh.ops.transform(bm, matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.0, 0.0075, -0.067)), verts=c4["verts"])

    # Side walls for skirt: x in [0.030, 0.040] and [-0.040, -0.030], z in [-0.067, -0.025]
    for sign in [-1, 1]:
        cw = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
        bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(0.010, 0.095, 0.045), verts=cw["verts"])
        bmesh.ops.transform(bm, matrix=Matrix.Translation((sign * 0.035, 0.0075, -0.0475)), verts=cw["verts"])

    bmesh.ops.remove_doubles(bm, verts=bm.verts, dist=0.0005)

    me = bpy.data.meshes.new("SlidingJaw")
    bm.to_mesh(me)
    bm.free()
    me.update()

    obj = bpy.data.objects.new("SlidingJaw", me)
    obj.location = SLIDING_JAW_CENTER
    obj.data.materials.append(get_hammered_blue_material())
    return link_object(obj)

from mathutils import Vector, Matrix
from parts._common import get_chrome_material, link_object

TOMMY_BAR_HANDLE_CENTER = (0.000, -0.175, 0.115)

def build_tommy_bar_handle() -> bpy.types.Object:
    bm = bmesh.new()

    bar_r = 0.006

        bm,

        radius1=bar_r,

import bpy
from mathutils import Vector

def print_bbox(obj):
    bbox_world = [obj.matrix_world @ Vector(corner) for corner in obj.bound_box]
    min_c = Vector((min(v.x for v in bbox_world), min(v.y for v in bbox_world), min(v.z for v in bbox_world)))
    max_c = Vector((max(v.x for v in bbox_world), max(v.y for v in bbox_world), max(v.z for v in bbox_world)))
    center = (min_c + max_c) / 2
    extents = max_c - min_c
    print(f"DEBUG [{obj.name}]: center=({center.x:.4f}, {center.y:.4f}, {center.z:.4f}), extents=({extents.x:.4f}, {extents.y:.4f}, {extents.z:.4f})")

            depth=eh,
            matrix=Matrix.Translation((ex, ey, z_ear))
        )
        dist = math.sqrt(ex*ex + ey*ey)
        ang = math.atan2(ey, ex)
        
        c = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
        bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(er * 2.0, dist, eh), verts=c["verts"])
        rot_m = Matrix.Rotation(ang - math.pi / 2, 4, 'Z')
        trans_m = Matrix.Translation((ex/2, ey/2, z_ear))
        bmesh.ops.transform(bm, matrix=trans_m @ rot_m, verts=c["verts"])

    # 3. Top collar / swivel ring (z from 0.020 to 0.030 -> local z from 0.005 to 0.015, center = 0.010)
    bmesh.ops.create_cone(
        bm,
        cap_ends=True,
        segments=36,
        radius1=0.055,
        radius2=0.052,
        depth=0.010,
        matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.0, 0.0, 0.010))
    )

    # 4. Create bolt through-holes for all three tabs
    # The cutter depth is 0.020, local z from -0.015 to +0.005 (center = -0.005) so it doesn't poke below -0.015 (world z=0)
    cutter_bm = bmesh.new()
    bolt_locs_local = [
        (0.0, -0.072),
        (0.072, 0.035),
        (-0.072, 0.035)
    ]
    for bx, by in bolt_locs_local:
        bmesh.ops.create_cone(
            cutter_bm,
            cap_ends=True,
            segments=24,
            radius1=0.007,
            radius2=0.007,
            depth=0.020,
            matrix=Matrix.Translation((bx, by, -0.005))
        )

    bmesh.ops.remove_doubles(bm, verts=bm.verts, dist=0.0005)

    me = bpy.data.meshes.new("MountingBase")
    bm.to_mesh(me)
    bm.free()
    me.update()

    obj = bpy.data.objects.new("MountingBase", me)
    obj.location = MOUNTING_BASE_CENTER
    bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(obj)

    cutter_me = bpy.data.meshes.new("_MountingBaseCutter")
    cutter_bm.to_mesh(cutter_me)
    cutter_bm.free()
    cutter_obj = bpy.data.objects.new("_MountingBaseCutter", cutter_me)
    cutter_obj.location = MOUNTING_BASE_CENTER
    bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(cutter_obj)

    # Boolean difference modifier
    mod = obj.modifiers.new("HolesDiff", 'BOOLEAN')
    mod.operation = 'DIFFERENCE'
    mod.object = cutter_obj
    mod.solver = 'EXACT'

    with bpy.context.temp_override(object=obj, active_object=obj, selected_objects=[obj]):
        bpy.ops.object.modifier_apply(modifier=mod.name)

    bpy.data.objects.remove(cutter_obj, do_unlink=True)
    bpy.data.meshes.remove(cutter_me)

    # Ensure no vertices below local z = -0.015
    for v in obj.data.vertices:
        if v.co.z < -0.015:
            v.co.z = -0.015
    obj.data.update()

    obj.data.materials.append(get_hammered_blue_material())
    return obj

"""SlidingJaw — movable front clamping jaw.

Heavy cast-iron movable front jaw with an arched reinforcement back, an upper jaw support matching the fixed jaw width (125 mm), a front collar for the lead-screw thrust bearing, and a bottom mount for the guide beam.
Material: industrial blue hammered cast iron.
Plan bbox: center (0.000, -0.105, 0.110) extents (0.130, 0.110, 0.160)
  -> x in [-0.065, 0.065], y in [-0.160, -0.050], z in [0.030, 0.190]
"""
import math
import bpy
import bmesh
from mathutils import Vector, Matrix
from parts._common import get_hammered_blue_material, link_object

SLIDING_JAW_CENTER = (0.000, -0.105, 0.110)
SLIDING_JAW_EXTENTS = (0.130, 0.110, 0.160)

def build_sliding_jaw() -> bpy.types.Object:
    bm = bmesh.new()
    
    # 1. Upper Jaw Tower:
    # World Y in [-0.095, -0.050] (local y in [0.010, 0.055]), World Z in [0.120, 0.190] (local z in [0.010, 0.080])
    c1 = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
    bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(0.130, 0.045, 0.070), verts=c1["verts"])
    bmesh.ops.transform(bm, matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.0, 0.0325, 0.045)), verts=c1["verts"])

    # 2. Main Central Body / Web:
    # Made as side cheeks around the central screw/guide tunnel (leaving center hollow)
    # Side cheek +X: x in [0.018, 0.0425], depth 0.075, height 0.090
    c2_r = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
    bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(0.025, 0.075, 0.090), verts=c2_r["verts"])
    bmesh.ops.transform(bm, matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.030, -0.0025, -0.010)), verts=c2_r["verts"])

    c2_l = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
    bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(0.025, 0.075, 0.090), verts=c2_l["verts"])
    bmesh.ops.transform(bm, matrix=Matrix.Translation((-0.030, -0.0025, -0.010)), verts=c2_l["verts"])

    # Top bridge between cheeks
    c2_t = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
    bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(0.085, 0.075, 0.020), verts=c2_t["verts"])
    bmesh.ops.transform(bm, matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.0, -0.0025, 0.025)), verts=c2_t["verts"])

    # 3. Front Thrust Hub Ring (open tube for screw):
    # World Y in [-0.160, -0.122] (local y in [-0.055, -0.017])
    # Screw radius is 0.012 m (dia 24 mm), hub outer radius 0.025, inner radius 0.0135
    bmesh.ops.create_cone(
        bm,
        cap_ends=True,
        segments=24,
        radius1=0.025,
        radius2=0.023,
        depth=0.038,
        matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.0, -0.036, 0.005)) @ Matrix.Rotation(math.pi / 2, 4, 'X')
    )

    # 4. Lower Guide Beam Socket / Skirt:
    # Guide beam is at world z = [0.055, 0.095] (local z in [-0.055, -0.015]), width 0.060 (x in [-0.030, 0.030])
    # Skirt wraps around bottom: z in [0.030, 0.056] (local z in [-0.080, -0.054], height 0.026, center = -0.067)
    c4 = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
    bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(0.080, 0.095, 0.026), verts=c4["verts"])
    bmesh.ops.transform(bm, matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.0, 0.0075, -0.067)), verts=c4["verts"])

    # Side walls for skirt: x in [0.030, 0.040] and [-0.040, -0.030], z in [-0.067, -0.025]
    for sign in [-1, 1]:
        cw = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
        bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(0.010, 0.095, 0.045), verts=cw["verts"])
        bmesh.ops.transform(bm, matrix=Matrix.Translation((sign * 0.035, 0.0075, -0.0475)), verts=cw["verts"])

    bmesh.ops.remove_doubles(bm, verts=bm.verts, dist=0.0005)

    me = bpy.data.meshes.new("SlidingJaw")
    bm.to_mesh(me)
    bm.free()
    me.update()

    obj = bpy.data.objects.new("SlidingJaw", me)
    obj.location = SLIDING_JAW_CENTER
    obj.data.materials.append(get_hammered_blue_material())
    return link_object(obj)

"""BenchVise — Blender (bpy) model.
"""
import bpy
from mathutils import Vector

from parts.mounting_base import build_mounting_base
from parts.fixed_body import build_fixed_body
from parts.anvil_face import build_anvil_face
from parts.fixed_jaw_plate import build_fixed_jaw_plate
from parts.sliding_jaw import build_sliding_jaw
from parts.sliding_jaw_plate import build_sliding_jaw_plate
from parts.guide_beam import build_guide_beam
from parts.lead_screw import build_lead_screw
from parts.tommy_bar_handle import build_tommy_bar_handle
from parts._debug import print_bbox


def _selfcheck():
    """What the harness checks first: meshes exist, no auto-suffixed names, stands on z=0."""
    bpy.context.view_layer.update()
    meshes = [o for o in bpy.data.objects if o.type == "MESH"]
    assert meshes, "no mesh objects built"
    for o in meshes:
        assert "." not in o.name, f"auto-suffixed name {o.name!r}: give every instance its own name"
        print_bbox(o)
    z_min = min((o.matrix_world @ Vector(c)).z for o in meshes for c in o.bound_box)
    assert abs(z_min) < 0.002, f"lowest point z={z_min:.4f}: the object must stand on z=0"
    print(f"[selfcheck] {len(meshes)} mesh objects, z_min={z_min:.4f}")


def main():
    build_mounting_base()
    build_fixed_body()
    build_anvil_face()
    build_fixed_jaw_plate()
    build_sliding_jaw()
    build_sliding_jaw_plate()
    build_guide_beam()
    build_lead_screw()
    build_tommy_bar_handle()
    _selfcheck()


main()

"""Debug print bbox of all objects."""
import bpy
from mathutils import Vector

def print_bbox(obj):
    bbox_world = [obj.matrix_world @ Vector(corner) for corner in obj.bound_box]
    min_c = Vector((min(v.x for v in bbox_world), min(v.y for v in bbox_world), min(v.z for v in bbox_world)))
    max_c = Vector((max(v.x for v in bbox_world), max(v.y for v in bbox_world), max(v.z for v in bbox_world)))
    center = (min_c + max_c) / 2
    extents = max_c - min_c
    print(f"DEBUG [{obj.name}]: center=({center.x:.4f}, {center.y:.4f}, {center.z:.4f}), extents=({extents.x:.4f}, {extents.y:.4f}, {extents.z:.4f})")

    bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)

"""FixedBody — rear stationary vise housing and fixed jaw support.

Massive cast-iron rear body featuring a lower cylindrical collar mounted on the base, a rectangular internal guide tunnel (45×45 mm) for the sliding bar, an internal threaded lead-screw hub, and an upward rising rear jaw tower.
Material: industrial blue hammered cast iron.
Plan bbox: center (0.000, 0.060, 0.100) extents (0.130, 0.220, 0.150)
  -> x in [-0.065, 0.065], y in [-0.050, 0.170], z in [0.025, 0.175]
"""
import math
import bpy
import bmesh
from mathutils import Vector, Matrix
from parts._common import get_hammered_blue_material, link_object

FIXED_BODY_CENTER = (0.000, 0.060, 0.100)
FIXED_BODY_EXTENTS = (0.130, 0.220, 0.150)

def build_fixed_body() -> bpy.types.Object:
    bm = bmesh.new()
    
    # In local coordinates (relative to FIXED_BODY_CENTER = (0.000, 0.060, 0.100)):
    # Local X in [-0.065, 0.065] (width 0.130)
    # Local Y in [-0.110, 0.110] (depth 0.220 -> world Y in [-0.050, 0.170])
    # Local Z in [-0.075, 0.075] (height 0.150 -> world Z in [0.025, 0.175])
    
    # 1. Lower Mounting Swivel Base / Base Collar:
    # World Z in [0.025, 0.060] (local z in [-0.075, -0.040], height 0.035, center = -0.0575)
    # World Y centered around 0.040 (local y = -0.020)
    bmesh.ops.create_cone(
        bm,
        cap_ends=True,
        segments=32,
        radius1=0.055,
        radius2=0.055,
        depth=0.035,
        matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.0, -0.020, -0.0575))
    )

    # 2. Main Guide Housing constructed as hollow box / side rails around GuideBeam & LeadScrew:
    # Guide beam is at world z in [0.055, 0.095] (local z in [-0.045, -0.005]), width 0.060 (x in [-0.030, 0.030])
    # Lead screw is at world z in [0.098, 0.133] (local z in [-0.002, 0.033]), radius 0.012 (x in [-0.012, 0.012])
    # Side walls: x in [0.030, 0.045] and [-0.045, -0.030], depth 0.220 (local y in [-0.110, 0.110])
    # Z in [0.045, 0.138] (local z in [-0.055, 0.038], height 0.093, center = -0.0085)
    for sign in [-1, 1]:
        cw = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
        bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(0.015, 0.220, 0.093), verts=cw["verts"])
        bmesh.ops.transform(bm, matrix=Matrix.Translation((sign * 0.0375, 0.0, -0.0085)), verts=cw["verts"])

    # Bottom plate of housing: z in [0.045, 0.056] (local z in [-0.055, -0.044], height 0.011, center = -0.0495)
    cb = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
    bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(0.090, 0.220, 0.011), verts=cb["verts"])
    bmesh.ops.transform(bm, matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.0, 0.0, -0.0495)), verts=cb["verts"])

    # Rear cap / drive nut bridge at back of housing: local y in [0.090, 0.110]
    cr = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
    bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(0.090, 0.020, 0.093), verts=cr["verts"])
    bmesh.ops.transform(bm, matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.0, 0.100, -0.0085)), verts=cr["verts"])

    # 3. Upward Rising Fixed Jaw Tower (front top portion of the fixed body):
    # World Y in [-0.050, 0.020] (local y in [-0.110, -0.040], depth 0.070, center = -0.075)
    # FixedJawPlate is at world y in [-0.0175, -0.0025] -> jaw plate sits at front of tower.
    # World Z in [0.110, 0.175] (local z in [0.010, 0.075], height 0.065, center = 0.0425)
    # Width = 0.130 (local x in [-0.065, 0.065])
    # Let tower back be from y = -0.0025 to 0.020 (local y in [-0.0625, -0.040], depth 0.0225) + front support
    # To keep exact bbox [-0.050, 0.020]:
    # Tower side supports: x in [0.040, 0.065] and [-0.065, -0.040], depth 0.070 (local y in [-0.110, -0.040])
    for sign in [-1, 1]:
        ctw = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
        bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(0.025, 0.070, 0.065), verts=ctw["verts"])
        bmesh.ops.transform(bm, matrix=Matrix.Translation((sign * 0.0525, -0.075, 0.0425)), verts=ctw["verts"])

    # Tower rear backplate: x in [-0.065, 0.065], depth 0.025 (local y in [-0.065, -0.040], center = -0.0525)
    ctb = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
    bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(0.130, 0.025, 0.065), verts=ctb["verts"])
    bmesh.ops.transform(bm, matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.0, -0.0525, 0.0425)), verts=ctb["verts"])

    # 4. Rear Anvil Support Platform:
    # World Y in [0.020, 0.160] (local y in [-0.040, 0.100], depth 0.140, center = 0.030)
    # World Z in [0.110, 0.138] (local z in [0.010, 0.038], height 0.028, center = 0.024)
    # Width = 0.080 (local x in [-0.040, 0.040])
    c4 = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)

"""MountingBase — flanged cast baseplate with bolt holes for workbench mounting.

Circular cast-iron base plate (diameter 0.14 m, thickness 0.025 m) resting on z=0 with three radial bolt ears featuring vertical bolt through-holes cut via boolean.
Material: industrial blue hammered cast iron.
Plan bbox: center (0.000, 0.040, 0.015) extents (0.180, 0.180, 0.030)
  -> x in [-0.090, 0.090], y in [-0.050, 0.130], z in [0.000, 0.030]
"""
import math
import bpy
import bmesh
from mathutils import Vector, Matrix
from parts._common import get_hammered_blue_material, link_object

MOUNTING_BASE_CENTER = (0.000, 0.040, 0.015)
MOUNTING_BASE_EXTENTS = (0.180, 0.180, 0.030)

def build_mounting_base() -> bpy.types.Object:
    bm = bmesh.new()

    # In local space relative to MOUNTING_BASE_CENTER = (0.000, 0.040, 0.015):
    # Local Z ranges from -0.015 (z=0) to +0.015 (z=0.030).
    
    r_main = 0.065
    h_main = 0.025 # local z from -0.015 to +0.010 -> center local z = -0.0025
    
    # 1. Main circular base
    bmesh.ops.create_cone(
        bm,
        cap_ends=True,
        segments=36,
        radius1=r_main,
        radius2=r_main,
        depth=h_main,
        matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.0, 0.0, -0.0025))
    )

    # 2. Three base ears reaching exact extents (0.180, 0.180) in XY, and sitting on z=0 (local z=-0.015):
    eh = 0.014
    z_ear = -0.015 + eh / 2
    
    # Ears positioned at 3 radial directions: front (0.0, -0.072), back-right (0.072, 0.035), back-left (-0.072, 0.035), and back rim (0.0, 0.072)
    ears = [
        (0.0, -0.072, 0.018),   # Front ear (reaches local y = -0.090 -> world y = -0.050)
        (0.072, 0.035, 0.018),  # Right ear (reaches local x = +0.090 -> world x = +0.090)
        (-0.072, 0.035, 0.018), # Left ear (reaches local x = -0.090 -> world x = -0.090)
        (0.0, 0.072, 0.018),    # Back rim (reaches local y = +0.090 -> world y = +0.130)
    ]
    
    for ex, ey, er in ears:
        bmesh.ops.create_cone(
            bm,
            cap_ends=True,
            segments=24,
            radius1=er,
            radius2=er,
            depth=eh,
            matrix=Matrix.Translation((ex, ey, z_ear))
        )
        dist = math.sqrt(ex*ex + ey*ey)
        ang = math.atan2(ey, ex)
        
        c = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
        bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(er * 2.0, dist, eh), verts=c["verts"])
        rot_m = Matrix.Rotation(ang - math.pi / 2, 4, 'Z')
        trans_m = Matrix.Translation((ex/2, ey/2, z_ear))
        bmesh.ops.transform(bm, matrix=trans_m @ rot_m, verts=c["verts"])

    # 3. Top collar / swivel ring (z from 0.020 to 0.030 -> local z from 0.005 to 0.015, center = 0.010)
    bmesh.ops.create_cone(
        bm,
        cap_ends=True,
        segments=36,
        radius1=0.055,
        radius2=0.052,
        depth=0.010,
        matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.0, 0.0, 0.010))
    )

    # 4. Create bolt through-holes for all three tabs
    cutter_bm = bmesh.new()
    # The ear centers are (0.0, -0.072), (0.072, 0.035), (-0.072, 0.035)
    bolt_locs_local = [
        (0.0, -0.072),
        (0.072, 0.035),
        (-0.072, 0.035)
    ]
    for bx, by in bolt_locs_local:
        bmesh.ops.create_cone(
            cutter_bm,
            cap_ends=True,
            segments=24,
            radius1=0.007,
            radius2=0.007,
            depth=0.080,
            matrix=Matrix.Translation((bx, by, 0.0))
        )

    bmesh.ops.remove_doubles(bm, verts=bm.verts, dist=0.0005)

    me = bpy.data.meshes.new("MountingBase")
    bm.to_mesh(me)
    bm.free()
    me.update()

    obj = bpy.data.objects.new("MountingBase", me)
    obj.location = MOUNTING_BASE_CENTER
    bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(obj)

    cutter_me = bpy.data.meshes.new("_MountingBaseCutter")
    cutter_bm.to_mesh(cutter_me)
    cutter_bm.free()
    cutter_obj = bpy.data.objects.new("_MountingBaseCutter", cutter_me)
    cutter_obj.location = MOUNTING_BASE_CENTER
    bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(cutter_obj)

    # Boolean difference modifier
    mod = obj.modifiers.new("HolesDiff", 'BOOLEAN')
    mod.operation = 'DIFFERENCE'
    mod.object = cutter_obj
    mod.solver = 'EXACT'

    with bpy.context.temp_override(object=obj, active_object=obj, selected_objects=[obj]):
        bpy.ops.object.modifier_apply(modifier=mod.name)

    bpy.data.objects.remove(cutter_obj, do_unlink=True)
    bpy.data.meshes.remove(cutter_me)

    obj.data.materials.append(get_hammered_blue_material())
    return obj

from parts._common import get_hammered_blue_material, link_object

SLIDING_JAW_CENTER = (0.000, -0.105, 0.110)
SLIDING_JAW_EXTENTS = (0.130, 0.110, 0.160)

def build_sliding_jaw() -> bpy.types.Object:
    bm = bmesh.new()
    
    # 1. Upper Jaw Tower:
    # World Y in [-0.095, -0.050] (local y in [0.010, 0.055]), World Z in [0.120, 0.190] (local z in [0.010, 0.080])
    c1 = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
    bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(0.130, 0.045, 0.070), verts=c1["verts"])
    bmesh.ops.transform(bm, matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.0, 0.0325, 0.045)), verts=c1["verts"])

    # 2. Main Central Body / Web:
    # Made as side cheeks around the central screw/guide tunnel (leaving center hollow)
    # Side cheek +X: x in [0.018, 0.0425], depth 0.075, height 0.090
    c2_r = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
    bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(0.025, 0.075, 0.090), verts=c2_r["verts"])
    bmesh.ops.transform(bm, matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.030, -0.0025, -0.010)), verts=c2_r["verts"])

    c2_l = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
    bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(0.025, 0.075, 0.090), verts=c2_l["verts"])
    bmesh.ops.transform(bm, matrix=Matrix.Translation((-0.030, -0.0025, -0.010)), verts=c2_l["verts"])

    # Top bridge between cheeks
    c2_t = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
    bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(0.085, 0.075, 0.020), verts=c2_t["verts"])
    bmesh.ops.transform(bm, matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.0, -0.0025, 0.025)), verts=c2_t["verts"])

    # 3. Front Thrust Hub Ring (open tube for screw):
    # World Y in [-0.160, -0.122] (local y in [-0.055, -0.017])
    # Screw radius is 0.012 m (dia 24 mm), hub outer radius 0.025, inner radius 0.0135
    bmesh.ops.create_cone(
        bm,
        cap_ends=True,
        segments=24,
        radius1=0.025,
        radius2=0.023,
        depth=0.038,
        matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.0, -0.036, 0.005)) @ Matrix.Rotation(math.pi / 2, 4, 'X')
    )

    # 4. Lower Guide Beam Socket / Skirt:
    # Guide beam is at world z = [0.055, 0.095] (local z in [-0.055, -0.015]), width 0.060 (x in [-0.030, 0.030])
    # Skirt wraps around bottom: z in [0.030, 0.056] (local z in [-0.080, -0.054], height 0.026, center = -0.067)
    c4 = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
    bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(0.080, 0.095, 0.026), verts=c4["verts"])
    bmesh.ops.transform(bm, matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.0, 0.0075, -0.067)), verts=c4["verts"])

    # Side walls for skirt: x in [0.030, 0.040] and [-0.040, -0.030], z in [-0.067, -0.025]
    for sign in [-1, 1]:
        cw = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
        bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(0.010, 0.095, 0.045), verts=cw["verts"])
        bmesh.ops.transform(bm, matrix=Matrix.Translation((sign * 0.035, 0.0075, -0.0475)), verts=cw["verts"])

    bmesh.ops.remove_doubles(bm, verts=bm.verts, dist=0.0005)

    me = bpy.data.meshes.new("SlidingJaw")
    bm.to_mesh(me)
    bm.free()
    me.update()

    obj = bpy.data.objects.new("SlidingJaw", me)
    obj.location = SLIDING_JAW_CENTER
    obj.data.materials.append(get_hammered_blue_material())

"""Common materials and helpers for BenchVise parts."""
import bpy
import bmesh
import math
from mathutils import Vector, Matrix

def get_hammered_blue_material():
    mat_name = "IndustrialBlueCastIron"
    mat = bpy.data.materials.get(mat_name)
    if mat is None:
        mat = bpy.data.materials.new(mat_name)
        bsdf = mat.node_tree.nodes["Principled BSDF"]
        bsdf.inputs["Base Color"].default_value = (0.12, 0.28, 0.52, 1.0)
        bsdf.inputs["Roughness"].default_value = 0.55
        bsdf.inputs["Metallic"].default_value = 0.3

def get_bright_steel_material():

def print_bbox(obj):

"""FixedBody — rear stationary vise housing and fixed jaw support.

Massive cast-iron rear body featuring a lower cylindrical collar mounted on the base, a rectangular internal guide tunnel (45×45 mm) for the sliding bar, an internal threaded lead-screw hub, and an upward rising rear jaw tower.
Material: industrial blue hammered cast iron.
Plan bbox: center (0.000, 0.060, 0.100) extents (0.130, 0.220, 0.150)

"""
import math
import bpy
import bmesh
from mathutils import Vector, Matrix
from parts._common import get_hammered_blue_material, link_object, apply_all_modifiers

FIXED_BODY_CENTER = (0.000, 0.060, 0.100)
FIXED_BODY_EXTENTS = (0.130, 0.220, 0.150)

def build_fixed_body() -> bpy.types.Object:
    bm = bmesh.new()
    
    # 1. Lower Mounting Swivel Base / Base Collar:
    # World Z in [0.025, 0.060] (local z in [-0.075, -0.040], height 0.035, center = -0.0575)
    # World Y centered around 0.040 (local y = -0.020)
    bmesh.ops.create_cone(
        bm,
        cap_ends=True,
        segments=32,
        radius1=0.055,
        radius2=0.055,
        depth=0.035,
        matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.0, -0.020, -0.0575))
    )

    # 2. Main Guide Housing Side Rails:
    # Guide beam is at world z in [0.055, 0.095], width 0.060 (x in [-0.030, 0.030]).
    # Channel inside fixed body has 1 mm clearance on each side: x in [-0.031, 0.031]
    # Side walls: x in [0.031, 0.046] and [-0.046, -0.031], depth 0.220 (local y in [-0.110, 0.110])
    # Z in [0.045, 0.138] (local z in [-0.055, 0.038], height 0.093, center = -0.0085)
    for sign in [-1, 1]:
        cw = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
        bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(0.015, 0.220, 0.093), verts=cw["verts"])
        bmesh.ops.transform(bm, matrix=Matrix.Translation((sign * 0.0385, 0.0, -0.0085)), verts=cw["verts"])

    # Bottom plate of housing: z in [0.025, 0.053] (local z in [-0.075, -0.047], height 0.014, center = -0.061)
    cb = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
    bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(0.092, 0.220, 0.014), verts=cb["verts"])
    bmesh.ops.transform(bm, matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.0, 0.0, -0.061)), verts=cb["verts"])

    # Rear cap / drive nut bridge at back of housing: local y in [0.090, 0.110]
    cr = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
    bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(0.092, 0.020, 0.093), verts=cr["verts"])
    bmesh.ops.transform(bm, matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.0, 0.100, -0.0085)), verts=cr["verts"])

    # 3. Upward Rising Fixed Jaw Tower (front top portion of the fixed body):
    # World Y in [-0.050, 0.020] (local y in [-0.110, -0.040], depth 0.070, center = -0.075)
    # World Z in [0.110, 0.175] (local z in [0.010, 0.075], height 0.065, center = 0.0425)
    # Width = 0.130 (local x in [-0.065, 0.065])
    for sign in [-1, 1]:
        ctw = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
        bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(0.025, 0.070, 0.065), verts=ctw["verts"])
        bmesh.ops.transform(bm, matrix=Matrix.Translation((sign * 0.0525, -0.075, 0.0425)), verts=ctw["verts"])

    # Tower rear backplate: x in [-0.065, 0.065], depth 0.025 (local y in [-0.065, -0.040], center = -0.0525)
    ctb = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
    bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(0.130, 0.025, 0.065), verts=ctb["verts"])
    bmesh.ops.transform(bm, matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.0, -0.0525, 0.0425)), verts=ctb["verts"])

    # 4. Rear Anvil Support Platform:
    # World Y in [0.020, 0.160] (local y in [-0.040, 0.100], depth 0.140, center = 0.030)
    # World Z in [0.110, 0.138] (local z in [0.010, 0.038], height 0.028, center = 0.024)
    # Width = 0.080 (local x in [-0.040, 0.040])
    c4 = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
    bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(0.080, 0.140, 0.028), verts=c4["verts"])
    bmesh.ops.transform(bm, matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.0, 0.030, 0.024)), verts=c4["verts"])

    bmesh.ops.remove_doubles(bm, verts=bm.verts, dist=0.0005)

    me = bpy.data.meshes.new("FixedBody")
    bm.to_mesh(me)
    bm.free()
    me.update()

    obj = bpy.data.objects.new("FixedBody", me)
    obj.location = FIXED_BODY_CENTER
    obj.data.materials.append(get_hammered_blue_material())
    link_object(obj)

    # Cast iron bevel for smooth rounded transitions
    bev = obj.modifiers.new("CastBevel", "BEVEL")
    bev.width = 0.002
    bev.segments = 2
    bev.limit_method = "ANGLE"
    bev.angle_limit = math.radians(35)
    apply_all_modifiers(obj)

    return obj

"""MountingBase — flanged cast baseplate with bolt holes for workbench mounting.

Circular cast-iron base plate (diameter 0.14 m, thickness 0.025 m) resting on z=0 with three protruding radial bolt ears (spaced at 120°, 12 mm thick) featuring 10 mm vertical bolt through-holes and counterbores.
Material: industrial blue hammered cast iron.
Plan bbox: center (0.000, 0.040, 0.015) extents (0.180, 0.180, 0.030)
  -> x in [-0.090, 0.090], y in [-0.050, 0.130], z in [0.000, 0.030]
"""
import math
import bpy
import bmesh
from mathutils import Vector, Matrix
from parts._common import get_hammered_blue_material, link_object, apply_all_modifiers

MOUNTING_BASE_CENTER = (0.000, 0.040, 0.015)
MOUNTING_BASE_EXTENTS = (0.180, 0.180, 0.030)

def build_mounting_base() -> bpy.types.Object:
    bm = bmesh.new()

    r_main = 0.065
    h_main = 0.025 # local z from -0.015 to +0.010 -> center local z = -0.0025
    
    # 1. Main circular base
    bmesh.ops.create_cone(
        bm,
        cap_ends=True,
        segments=36,
        radius1=r_main,
        radius2=r_main,
        depth=h_main,
        matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.0, 0.0, -0.0025))
    )

    # 2. 3 prominent radial mounting tabs (spaced at 120°: front -90°, back-right 30°, back-left 150°)
    eh = 0.012
    z_ear = -0.015 + eh / 2.0
    er = 0.020
    
    ears = [
        (0.0, -0.070),                                                             # Front tab
        (0.070 * math.cos(math.radians(30)), 0.070 * math.sin(math.radians(30))),   # Back-Right
        (-0.070 * math.cos(math.radians(30)), 0.070 * math.sin(math.radians(30))),  # Back-Left
    ]
    
    for ex, ey in ears:
        bmesh.ops.create_cone(
            bm,
            cap_ends=True,
            segments=24,
            radius1=er,
            radius2=er,
            depth=eh,
            matrix=Matrix.Translation((ex, ey, z_ear))
        )
        dist = math.hypot(ex, ey)
        ang = math.atan2(ey, ex)
        
        c = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
        bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(er * 2.0, dist, eh), verts=c["verts"])
        rot_m = Matrix.Rotation(ang - math.pi / 2, 4, 'Z')
        trans_m = Matrix.Translation((ex / 2, ey / 2, z_ear))
        bmesh.ops.transform(bm, matrix=trans_m @ rot_m, verts=c["verts"])

    # Back rim reaching exact plan +Y bound (+0.090 local -> +0.130 world)
    bmesh.ops.create_cone(
        bm,
        cap_ends=True,
        segments=24,
        radius1=0.018,
        radius2=0.018,
        depth=eh,
        matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.0, 0.072, z_ear))
    )
    c_back = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
    bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(0.036, 0.072, eh), verts=c_back["verts"])
    bmesh.ops.transform(bm, matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.0, 0.036, z_ear)), verts=c_back["verts"])

    # 3. Top collar / swivel ring (z from 0.020 to 0.030 -> local z from 0.005 to 0.015, center = 0.010)
    bmesh.ops.create_cone(
        bm,
        cap_ends=True,
        segments=36,
        radius1=0.055,
        radius2=0.052,
        depth=0.010,
        matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.0, 0.0, 0.010))
    )

    # 4. Cut vertical bolt through-holes by subtracting hole cylinders from mesh in bmesh
    for bx, by in ears:
        # Create cylinder cutter
        bm_hole = bmesh.new()
        bmesh.ops.create_cone(
            bm_hole,
            cap_ends=True,
            segments=20,
            radius1=0.0065,
            radius2=0.0065,
            depth=0.040,
            matrix=Matrix.Translation((bx, by, -0.005))
        )
        bmesh.ops.create_cone(
            bm_hole,
            cap_ends=True,
            segments=20,
            radius1=0.012,
            radius2=0.012,
            depth=0.008,
            matrix=Matrix.Translation((bx, by, z_ear + eh / 2.0))
        )
        bmesh.ops.triangle_fill(bm_hole)
        # Boolean cut
        bmesh.ops.boolean(bm, geom1=bm.verts[:] + bm.edges[:] + bm.faces[:],
                          geom2=bm_hole.verts[:] + bm_hole.edges[:] + bm_hole.faces[:],
                          boolean_mode='DIFFERENCE')
        bm_hole.free()

    bmesh.ops.remove_doubles(bm, verts=bm.verts, dist=0.0005)

    me = bpy.data.meshes.new("MountingBase")
    bm.to_mesh(me)
    bm.free()
    me.update()

    obj = bpy.data.objects.new("MountingBase", me)
    obj.location = MOUNTING_BASE_CENTER
    obj.data.materials.append(get_hammered_blue_material())
    link_object(obj)

    # Cast iron bevel for smooth realistic casting fillets/chamfers
    bev = obj.modifiers.new("CastBevel", "BEVEL")
    bev.width = 0.0015
    bev.segments = 2
    bev.limit_method = "ANGLE"
    bev.angle_limit = math.radians(35)
    apply_all_modifiers(obj)

    return obj

def build_sliding_jaw() -> bpy.types.Object:

    # In local coordinates relative to SLIDING_JAW_CENTER = (0.000, -0.105, 0.110):
    # 1. Upper Jaw Tower:
    # World Y in [-0.095, -0.050] (local y in [0.010, 0.055]), World Z in [0.120, 0.190] (local z in [0.010, 0.080])
    c1 = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
    bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(0.130, 0.045, 0.070), verts=c1["verts"])
    bmesh.ops.transform(bm, matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.0, 0.0325, 0.045)), verts=c1["verts"])

    # 2. Main Central Body Cheeks:
    # Side cheek +X & -X: outer width 0.130 (x in [-0.065, 0.065]), inner width leaves tunnel
    # Depth in world y [-0.145, -0.070] (local y in [-0.040, 0.035], depth 0.075, center = -0.0025)
    # Z in [0.055, 0.145] (local z in [-0.055, 0.035], height 0.090, center = -0.010)
    for sign in [-1, 1]:
        c2 = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
        bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(0.025, 0.075, 0.090), verts=c2["verts"])
        bmesh.ops.transform(bm, matrix=Matrix.Translation((sign * 0.0525, -0.0025, -0.010)), verts=c2["verts"])

    # Top bridge between cheeks
    c2_t = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
    bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(0.080, 0.075, 0.020), verts=c2_t["verts"])
    bmesh.ops.transform(bm, matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.0, -0.0025, 0.025)), verts=c2_t["verts"])

    # 3. Front Thrust Hub Ring (reaches world y = -0.160 -> local y = -0.055)
    bmesh.ops.create_cone(
        bm,
        cap_ends=True,
        segments=24,
        radius1=0.026,
        radius2=0.024,
        depth=0.038,
        matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.0, -0.036, 0.005)) @ Matrix.Rotation(math.pi / 2, 4, 'X')
    )

    # 4. Front End-Plate / Mounting Face for Guide Beam:
    # GuideBeam starts at world y = -0.130 (local y = -0.025).
    # This solid front plate (local y in [-0.055, -0.024], depth 0.031) sits in FRONT of the guide beam (welded face-to-face with 1 mm overlap).
    # Z in [0.030, 0.100] (local z in [-0.080, -0.010])
    c_fplate = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
    bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(0.080, 0.031, 0.070), verts=c_fplate["verts"])
    bmesh.ops.transform(bm, matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.0, -0.0395, -0.045)), verts=c_fplate["verts"])

    # 5. Lower Skirt / Bottom Rail Support:
    # Sits below the guide beam: world z in [0.030, 0.055] (local z in [-0.080, -0.055], height 0.025, center = -0.0675)
    # Y in world [-0.145, -0.050] (local y in [-0.040, 0.055], depth 0.095, center = 0.0075)
    c_bot = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
    bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(0.080, 0.095, 0.025), verts=c_bot["verts"])
    bmesh.ops.transform(bm, matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.0, 0.0075, -0.0675)), verts=c_bot["verts"])

    # Side ribs outside the guide beam: x in [0.031, 0.045] and [-0.045, -0.031], z in [0.055, 0.095]
    for sign in [-1, 1]:
        cw = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
        bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(0.014, 0.080, 0.040), verts=cw["verts"])
        bmesh.ops.transform(bm, matrix=Matrix.Translation((sign * 0.038, 0.015, -0.035)), verts=cw["verts"])

    bmesh.ops.remove_doubles(bm, verts=bm.verts, dist=0.0005)

    me = bpy.data.meshes.new("SlidingJaw")
    bm.to_mesh(me)
    bm.free()
    me.update()

    obj = bpy.data.objects.new("SlidingJaw", me)
    obj.location = SLIDING_JAW_CENTER
    obj.data.materials.append(get_hammered_blue_material())
    link_object(obj)

    # Cast iron bevel for smooth rounded transitions
    bev = obj.modifiers.new("CastBevel", "BEVEL")
    bev.width = 0.002
    bev.segments = 2
    bev.limit_method = "ANGLE"
    bev.angle_limit = math.radians(35)
    apply_all_modifiers(obj)

    return obj

"""BenchVise — Blender (bpy) model.
Entry point that imports part builders from parts/*.
"""
import bpy
from mathutils import Vector

from parts.mounting_base import build_mounting_base
from parts.fixed_body import build_fixed_body
from parts.anvil_face import build_anvil_face
from parts.fixed_jaw_plate import build_fixed_jaw_plate
from parts.sliding_jaw import build_sliding_jaw
from parts.sliding_jaw_plate import build_sliding_jaw_plate
from parts.guide_beam import build_guide_beam
from parts.lead_screw import build_lead_screw
from parts.tommy_bar_handle import build_tommy_bar_handle


def _selfcheck():
    """What the harness checks first: meshes exist, no auto-suffixed names, stands on z=0."""
    bpy.context.view_layer.update()
    meshes = [o for o in bpy.data.objects if o.type == "MESH"]
    assert meshes, "no mesh objects built"
    for o in meshes:
        assert "." not in o.name, f"auto-suffixed name {o.name!r}: give every instance its own name"
    z_min = min((o.matrix_world @ Vector(c)).z for o in meshes for c in o.bound_box)
    assert abs(z_min) < 0.002, f"lowest point z={z_min:.4f}: the object must stand on z=0"
    print(f"[selfcheck] {len(meshes)} mesh objects, z_min={z_min:.4f}")


def main():
    build_mounting_base()
    build_fixed_body()
    build_anvil_face()
    build_fixed_jaw_plate()
    build_sliding_jaw()
    build_sliding_jaw_plate()
    build_guide_beam()
    build_lead_screw()
    build_tommy_bar_handle()
    _selfcheck()


main()

"""Debug print bbox of all objects."""
import bpy
from mathutils import Vector

def print_bbox(obj):
    bbox_world = [obj.matrix_world @ Vector(corner) for corner in obj.bound_box]
    min_c = Vector((min(v.x for v in bbox_world), min(v.y for v in bbox_world), min(v.z for v in bbox_world)))
    max_c = Vector((max(v.x for v in bbox_world), max(v.y for v in bbox_world), max(v.z for v in bbox_world)))
    center = (min_c + max_c) / 2
    extents = max_c - min_c
    print(f"DEBUG [{obj.name}]: center=({center.x:.4f}, {center.y:.4f}, {center.z:.4f}), extents=({extents.x:.4f}, {extents.y:.4f}, {extents.z:.4f})")

    # Guide beam is at world z in [0.055, 0.095], width 0.060 (x in [-0.030, 0.030]).
    # Channel inside fixed body has 1 mm clearance on each side: x in [-0.031, 0.031]
    # Side walls: x in [0.031, 0.046] and [-0.046, -0.031], depth 0.220 (local y in [-0.110, 0.110])
    # Z in [0.045, 0.138] (local z in [-0.055, 0.038], height 0.093, center = -0.0085)

    for sign in [-1, 1]:

def build_mounting_base() -> bpy.types.Object:

    bmesh.ops.create_cone(
        bm,
        cap_ends=True,
        segments=36,
        radius1=r_main,
        radius2=r_main,
        depth=h_main,
        matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.0, 0.0, -0.0025))
    )

    # 2. 3 prominent radial mounting tabs (spaced at 120°: front -90°, back-right 30°, back-left 150°)
    eh = 0.012
    z_ear = -0.015 + eh / 2.0
    er = 0.020
    
    ears = [
        (0.0, -0.070),                                                             # Front tab
        (0.070 * math.cos(math.radians(30)), 0.070 * math.sin(math.radians(30))),   # Back-Right
        (-0.070 * math.cos(math.radians(30)), 0.070 * math.sin(math.radians(30))),  # Back-Left

        bmesh.ops.create_cone(

            cap_ends=True,
            segments=24,
            radius1=er,
            radius2=er,
            depth=eh,
            matrix=Matrix.Translation((ex, ey, z_ear))

        ang = math.atan2(ey, ex)
        
        c = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
        bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(er * 2.0, dist, eh), verts=c["verts"])
        rot_m = Matrix.Rotation(ang - math.pi / 2, 4, 'Z')
        trans_m = Matrix.Translation((ex / 2, ey / 2, z_ear))
        bmesh.ops.transform(bm, matrix=trans_m @ rot_m, verts=c["verts"])
