import math
import random
import bpy
import bmesh
from mathutils import Vector, Matrix

random.seed(0)

FRONT_WHEEL_CENTER = (0.054, -0.065, 0.035)
FRONT_WHEEL_EXTENTS = (0.024, 0.070, 0.070)

def make_material(name, rgb, roughness=0.55, metallic=0.0):
    mat = bpy.data.materials.new(name)
    bsdf = mat.node_tree.nodes["Principled BSDF"]
    bsdf.inputs["Base Color"].default_value = (rgb[0], rgb[1], rgb[2], 1.0)
    bsdf.inputs["Roughness"].default_value = roughness
    bsdf.inputs["Metallic"].default_value = metallic
    return mat

def create_wheel_mesh(name: str, x_pos: float, y_pos: float, z_pos: float, is_right: bool):
    """
    Creates a chunky toddler toy wheel:
    - Cylinder oriented along X axis (diameter 0.070 m, width 0.024 m)
    - Axle hole through the center (r=4.1 mm)
    - Shallow concentric hub cap detail on the outer face
    - Soft bevel along outer and inner rim
    """
    bm = bmesh.new()
    
    # Outer radius 0.035, width 0.024
    r = 0.035
    w = 0.024
    segments = 32
    
    # Build cylinder with concentric hub rings on end faces
    bmesh.ops.create_cone(bm, cap_ends=True, segments=segments, radius1=r, radius2=r, depth=w)
    bmesh.ops.rotate(bm, cent=(0, 0, 0), matrix=Matrix.Rotation(math.pi / 2, 3, 'Y'), verts=bm.verts)
    
    # Axle hole
    bm_hole = bmesh.new()
    bmesh.ops.create_cone(bm_hole, cap_ends=True, segments=24, radius1=0.0042, radius2=0.0042, depth=0.035)
    bmesh.ops.rotate(bm_hole, cent=(0, 0, 0), matrix=Matrix.Rotation(math.pi / 2, 3, 'Y'), verts=bm_hole.verts)
    
    # Hub indentation on outer face
    # For right wheel (is_right=True, outer is +X), for left wheel outer is -X
    hub_sign = 1.0 if is_right else -1.0
    bm_hub = bmesh.new()
    bmesh.ops.create_cone(bm_hub, cap_ends=True, segments=24, radius1=0.018, radius2=0.018, depth=0.004)
    bmesh.ops.rotate(bm_hub, cent=(0, 0, 0), matrix=Matrix.Rotation(math.pi / 2, 3, 'Y'), verts=bm_hub.verts)
    bmesh.ops.translate(bm_hub, vec=(hub_sign * (w * 0.5), 0, 0), verts=bm_hub.verts)
    
    me_hole = bpy.data.meshes.new("_w_hole")
    bm_hole.to_mesh(me_hole); bm_hole.free()
    hole_obj = bpy.data.objects.new("_w_hole", me_hole)
    hole_obj.location = (x_pos, y_pos, z_pos)
    bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(hole_obj)
    
    me_hub = bpy.data.meshes.new("_w_hub")
    bm_hub.to_mesh(me_hub); bm_hub.free()
    hub_obj = bpy.data.objects.new("_w_hub", me_hub)
    hub_obj.location = (x_pos, y_pos, z_pos)
    bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(hub_obj)
    
    me = bpy.data.meshes.new(name)
    bm.to_mesh(me); bm.free()
    
    obj = bpy.data.objects.new(name, me)
    obj.location = (x_pos, y_pos, z_pos)
    bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(obj)
    
    # Bevel rims
    bev = obj.modifiers.new("Bevel", "BEVEL")
    bev.width = 0.003
    bev.segments = 3
    bev.limit_method = "ANGLE"
    bev.angle_limit = math.radians(60)
    with bpy.context.temp_override(object=obj, active_object=obj, selected_objects=[obj], selected_editable_objects=[obj]):
        bpy.ops.object.modifier_apply(modifier="Bevel")
        
    # Cut hub dish
    cut_hub = obj.modifiers.new("HubDish", "BOOLEAN")
    cut_hub.object = hub_obj
    cut_hub.operation = "DIFFERENCE"
    cut_hub.solver = "EXACT"
    with bpy.context.temp_override(object=obj, active_object=obj, selected_objects=[obj], selected_editable_objects=[obj]):
        bpy.ops.object.modifier_apply(modifier="HubDish")
        
    # Cut axle hole
    cut_axle = obj.modifiers.new("AxleHole", "BOOLEAN")
    cut_axle.object = hole_obj
    cut_axle.operation = "DIFFERENCE"
    cut_axle.solver = "EXACT"
    with bpy.context.temp_override(object=obj, active_object=obj, selected_objects=[obj], selected_editable_objects=[obj]):
        bpy.ops.object.modifier_apply(modifier="AxleHole")
        
    for tool_obj in [hole_obj, hub_obj]:
        t_mesh = tool_obj.data.name
        bpy.data.objects.remove(tool_obj, do_unlink=True)
        if t_mesh in bpy.data.meshes:
            bpy.data.meshes.remove(bpy.data.meshes[t_mesh], do_unlink=True)
            
    # Normalize bounds
    bpy.context.view_layer.update()
    bb = [Vector(v) for v in obj.bound_box]
    min_x = min(v.x for v in bb); max_x = max(v.x for v in bb)
    min_y = min(v.y for v in bb); max_y = max(v.y for v in bb)
    min_z = min(v.z for v in bb); max_z = max(v.z for v in bb)
    
    scale_x = FRONT_WHEEL_EXTENTS[0] / (max_x - min_x)
    scale_y = FRONT_WHEEL_EXTENTS[1] / (max_y - min_y)
    scale_z = FRONT_WHEEL_EXTENTS[2] / (max_z - min_z)
    
    bm_adj = bmesh.new()
    bm_adj.from_mesh(obj.data)
    for v in bm_adj.verts:
        v.co.x = (v.co.x) * scale_x
        v.co.y = (v.co.y) * scale_y
        v.co.z = (v.co.z) * scale_z
    bm_adj.to_mesh(obj.data)
    bm_adj.free()
    obj.data.update()
    
    for poly in obj.data.polygons:
        poly.use_smooth = True
        
    return obj

def build_front_wheel():
    """FrontWheel — front rolling wheel
    Material: natural oiled beech wood with matte finish
    """
    mat = make_material("BeechWoodMat", (0.86, 0.72, 0.52), roughness=0.5, metallic=0.0)
    
    w0 = create_wheel_mesh("FrontWheel_0", 0.054, -0.065, 0.035, is_right=True)
    w0.data.materials.append(mat)
    
    w1 = create_wheel_mesh("FrontWheel_1", -0.054, -0.065, 0.035, is_right=False)
    w1.data.materials.append(mat)
    
    return [w0, w1]

    bsdf.inputs["Metallic"].default_value = metallic

def create_taillight(name: str, x_pos: float, y_pos: float, z_pos: float):
    """
    Circular button cap (diameter 14 mm, depth 6 mm), facing +Y.
    """
    bm = bmesh.new()
    # Cylinder along Y: radius 0.007 (diameter 0.014), depth 0.006
    bmesh.ops.create_cone(bm, cap_ends=True, segments=24, radius1=0.007, radius2=0.007, depth=0.006)
    # Rotate cylinder from Z to Y axis

    obj = bpy.data.objects.new(name, me)
    obj.location = (x_pos, y_pos, z_pos)

    bev = obj.modifiers.new("Bevel", "BEVEL")

def build_taillight():

import math
import random
import bpy
import bmesh
from mathutils import Vector, Matrix

random.seed(0)

CAR_BODY_CENTER = (0.000, 0.000, 0.062)
CAR_BODY_EXTENTS = (0.088, 0.204, 0.096)

def make_material(name, rgb, roughness=0.2, metallic=0.0):
    mat = bpy.data.materials.new(name)
    bsdf = mat.node_tree.nodes["Principled BSDF"]
    bsdf.inputs["Base Color"].default_value = (rgb[0], rgb[1], rgb[2], 1.0)
    bsdf.inputs["Roughness"].default_value = roughness
    bsdf.inputs["Metallic"].default_value = metallic
    return mat

def build_car_body():
    """CarBody — main unified vehicle body and cabin
    Smooth, one-piece contoured car body with a bulbous cabin top, rounded front hood, and tapered rear.
    Material: glossy bright red painted wood
    """
    mat = make_material("CarBodyMat", (0.85, 0.05, 0.05), roughness=0.2, metallic=0.0)

    bm = bmesh.new()
    
    # 13 Y stations from y=-0.102 to y=+0.102 (front is -Y, rear is +Y)
    # (y, wb, wm, wt, zb, zw, zt, is_cabin)
    stations = [
        (-0.102, 0.026, 0.034, 0.026, 0.022, 0.042, 0.050, False), # front nose tip
        (-0.088, 0.036, 0.042, 0.034, 0.016, 0.045, 0.056, False), # front hood
        (-0.065, 0.038, 0.043, 0.035, 0.014, 0.048, 0.058, False), # over front wheels
        (-0.040, 0.040, 0.044, 0.038, 0.014, 0.050, 0.064, False), # base of windshield
        (-0.020, 0.042, 0.044, 0.034, 0.014, 0.052, 0.098, True),  # windshield
        ( 0.000, 0.042, 0.044, 0.035, 0.014, 0.052, 0.110, True),  # cabin peak
        ( 0.020, 0.042, 0.044, 0.034, 0.014, 0.052, 0.104, True),  # cabin rear
        ( 0.040, 0.042, 0.044, 0.037, 0.014, 0.050, 0.072, False), # rear window base
        ( 0.065, 0.038, 0.043, 0.035, 0.014, 0.048, 0.058, False), # over rear wheels
        ( 0.088, 0.036, 0.042, 0.032, 0.016, 0.045, 0.054, False), # rear deck
        ( 0.102, 0.026, 0.034, 0.024, 0.022, 0.040, 0.048, False), # rear bumper tip
    ]
    
    loops = []
    for y, wb, wm, wt, zb, zw, zt, is_cab in stations:
        z_mid_low = (zb + zw) * 0.5
        z_mid_high = (zw + zt) * 0.5
        wt_eff = wt * (0.75 if is_cab else 0.85)
        
        pts = [
            ( 0.0,         zb),                 # 0 bottom center
            ( wb * 0.7,    zb + (zw - zb)*0.1), # 1 bottom right
            ( wm,          z_mid_low),          # 2 lower right
            ( wm,          zw),                 # 3 waist right
            ( wt,          z_mid_high),         # 4 upper right
            ( wt_eff,      zt - (zt - zw)*0.1), # 5 top right
            ( 0.0,         zt),                 # 6 top center
            (-wt_eff,      zt - (zt - zw)*0.1), # 7 top left
            (-wt,          z_mid_high),         # 8 upper left
            (-wm,          zw),                 # 9 waist left
            (-wm,          z_mid_low),          # 10 lower left
            (-wb * 0.7,    zb + (zw - zb)*0.1), # 11 bottom left
        ]
        v_loop = []
        for x, z in pts:
            v_loop.append(bm.verts.new((x, y, z)))
        loops.append(v_loop)
        
    n_pts = len(loops[0])
    for i in range(len(loops) - 1):
        l1 = loops[i]
        l2 = loops[i + 1]
        for j in range(n_pts):
            j_next = (j + 1) % n_pts
            bm.faces.new([l1[j], l2[j], l2[j_next], l1[j_next]])
            
    # Close front cap (at station 0, y=-0.102)
    v_front_center = bm.verts.new((0, stations[0][0] - 0.005, (stations[0][4] + stations[0][6]) * 0.5))
    for j in range(n_pts):
        j_next = (j + 1) % n_pts
        bm.faces.new([v_front_center, loops[0][j_next], loops[0][j]])
        
    # Close rear cap (at station -1, y=+0.102)
    v_rear_center = bm.verts.new((0, stations[-1][0] + 0.005, (stations[-1][4] + stations[-1][6]) * 0.5))
    for j in range(n_pts):
        j_next = (j + 1) % n_pts
        bm.faces.new([v_rear_center, loops[-1][j], loops[-1][j_next]])

    bm.verts.ensure_lookup_table()
    bm.faces.ensure_lookup_table()

    me = bpy.data.meshes.new("CarBody")
    bm.to_mesh(me)
    bm.free()
    
    obj = bpy.data.objects.new("CarBody", me)
    bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(obj)
    obj.data.materials.append(mat)
    
    sub = obj.modifiers.new("Subsurf", "SUBSURF")
    sub.levels = 2
    sub.render_levels = 2
    with bpy.context.temp_override(object=obj, active_object=obj, selected_objects=[obj], selected_editable_objects=[obj]):
        bpy.ops.object.modifier_apply(modifier="Subsurf")

    # Rescale CarBody to exact target bbox
    bpy.context.view_layer.update()
    bb = [Vector(v) for v in obj.bound_box]
    min_x = min(v.x for v in bb); max_x = max(v.x for v in bb)
    min_y = min(v.y for v in bb); max_y = max(v.y for v in bb)
    min_z = min(v.z for v in bb); max_z = max(v.z for v in bb)
    
    curr_cx = (min_x + max_x) * 0.5
    curr_cy = (min_y + max_y) * 0.5
    curr_cz = (min_z + max_z) * 0.5
    curr_sx = max_x - min_x
    curr_sy = max_y - min_y
    curr_sz = max_z - min_z
    
    target_sx, target_sy, target_sz = CAR_BODY_EXTENTS
    target_cx, target_cy, target_cz = CAR_BODY_CENTER
    
    scale_x = target_sx / curr_sx if curr_sx > 0 else 1.0
    scale_y = target_sy / curr_sy if curr_sy > 0 else 1.0
    scale_z = target_sz / curr_sz if curr_sz > 0 else 1.0
    
    bm_adj = bmesh.new()
    bm_adj.from_mesh(obj.data)
    for v in bm_adj.verts:
        v.co.x = target_cx + (v.co.x - curr_cx) * scale_x
        v.co.y = target_cy + (v.co.y - curr_cy) * scale_y
        v.co.z = target_cz + (v.co.z - curr_cz) * scale_z
        
    bm_adj.to_mesh(obj.data)
    bm_adj.free()

    # Axle clearance holes via boolean cylinders (radius 5.5 mm)
    bm_cut = bmesh.new()
    # Front axle hole (at y = -0.065, z = 0.035)
    bmesh.ops.create_cone(bm_cut, cap_ends=True, segments=32, radius1=0.0055, radius2=0.0055, depth=0.15)
    bmesh.ops.rotate(bm_cut, cent=(0, 0, 0), matrix=Matrix.Rotation(math.pi / 2, 3, 'Y'), verts=bm_cut.verts)
    bmesh.ops.translate(bm_cut, vec=(0, -0.065, 0.035), verts=bm_cut.verts)
    
    # Rear axle hole (at y = +0.065, z = 0.035)
    v_start = len(bm_cut.verts)
    bmesh.ops.create_cone(bm_cut, cap_ends=True, segments=32, radius1=0.0055, radius2=0.0055, depth=0.15)
    new_v = bm_cut.verts[v_start:]
    bmesh.ops.rotate(bm_cut, cent=(0, 0, 0), matrix=Matrix.Rotation(math.pi / 2, 3, 'Y'), verts=new_v)
    bmesh.ops.translate(bm_cut, vec=(0, 0.065, 0.035), verts=new_v)

    me_c = bpy.data.meshes.new("_cut")
    bm_cut.to_mesh(me_c); bm_cut.free()
    c_obj = bpy.data.objects.new("_cut", me_c)
    bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(c_obj)

    b_mod = obj.modifiers.new("AxleCuts", "BOOLEAN")
    b_mod.object = c_obj
    b_mod.operation = "DIFFERENCE"
    b_mod.solver = "EXACT"
    with bpy.context.temp_override(object=obj, active_object=obj, selected_objects=[obj], selected_editable_objects=[obj]):
        bpy.ops.object.modifier_apply(modifier="AxleCuts")

    bpy.data.objects.remove(c_obj, do_unlink=True)
    bpy.data.meshes.remove(me_c, do_unlink=True)

    for poly in obj.data.polygons:
        poly.use_smooth = True

    return obj

FRONT_AXLE_CENTER = (0.000, -0.065, 0.035)

import math
import random
import bpy
import bmesh
from mathutils import Vector, Matrix

random.seed(0)

FRONT_WHEEL_CENTER = (0.054, -0.065, 0.035)
FRONT_WHEEL_EXTENTS = (0.024, 0.070, 0.070)

def make_material(name, rgb, roughness=0.55, metallic=0.0):
    mat = bpy.data.materials.new(name)
    bsdf = mat.node_tree.nodes["Principled BSDF"]
    bsdf.inputs["Base Color"].default_value = (rgb[0], rgb[1], rgb[2], 1.0)
    bsdf.inputs["Roughness"].default_value = roughness
    bsdf.inputs["Metallic"].default_value = metallic
    return mat

def create_wheel_mesh(name: str, x_pos: float, y_pos: float, z_pos: float, is_right: bool):
    """
    Creates a chunky toddler toy wheel:
    - Cylinder oriented along X axis (diameter 0.070 m, width 0.024 m)
    - Axle hole through the center (r=4.1 mm)
    - Shallow concentric hub cap detail on the outer face
    - Soft bevel along outer and inner rim
    """
    bm = bmesh.new()
    
    # Outer radius 0.035, width 0.024
    r = 0.035
    w = 0.024
    segments = 32
    
    # Build cylinder with concentric hub rings on end faces
    bmesh.ops.create_cone(bm, cap_ends=True, segments=segments, radius1=r, radius2=r, depth=w)
    bmesh.ops.rotate(bm, cent=(0, 0, 0), matrix=Matrix.Rotation(math.pi / 2, 3, 'Y'), verts=bm.verts)
    
    # Axle hole
    bm_hole = bmesh.new()
    bmesh.ops.create_cone(bm_hole, cap_ends=True, segments=24, radius1=0.0042, radius2=0.0042, depth=0.035)
    bmesh.ops.rotate(bm_hole, cent=(0, 0, 0), matrix=Matrix.Rotation(math.pi / 2, 3, 'Y'), verts=bm_hole.verts)
    
    # Hub indentation on outer face
    # For right wheel (is_right=True, outer is +X), for left wheel outer is -X
    hub_sign = 1.0 if is_right else -1.0
    bm_hub = bmesh.new()
    bmesh.ops.create_cone(bm_hub, cap_ends=True, segments=24, radius1=0.018, radius2=0.018, depth=0.004)
    bmesh.ops.rotate(bm_hub, cent=(0, 0, 0), matrix=Matrix.Rotation(math.pi / 2, 3, 'Y'), verts=bm_hub.verts)
    bmesh.ops.translate(bm_hub, vec=(hub_sign * (w * 0.5), 0, 0), verts=bm_hub.verts)
    
    me_hole = bpy.data.meshes.new("_w_hole")
    bm_hole.to_mesh(me_hole); bm_hole.free()
    hole_obj = bpy.data.objects.new("_w_hole", me_hole)
    hole_obj.location = (x_pos, y_pos, z_pos)
    bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(hole_obj)
    
    me_hub = bpy.data.meshes.new("_w_hub")
    bm_hub.to_mesh(me_hub); bm_hub.free()
    hub_obj = bpy.data.objects.new("_w_hub", me_hub)
    hub_obj.location = (x_pos, y_pos, z_pos)
    bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(hub_obj)
    
    me = bpy.data.meshes.new(name)
    bm.to_mesh(me); bm.free()
    
    obj = bpy.data.objects.new(name, me)
    obj.location = (x_pos, y_pos, z_pos)
    bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(obj)
    
    # Bevel rims
    bev = obj.modifiers.new("Bevel", "BEVEL")
    bev.width = 0.003
    bev.segments = 3
    bev.limit_method = "ANGLE"
    bev.angle_limit = math.radians(60)
    with bpy.context.temp_override(object=obj, active_object=obj, selected_objects=[obj], selected_editable_objects=[obj]):
        bpy.ops.object.modifier_apply(modifier="Bevel")
        
    # Cut hub dish
    cut_hub = obj.modifiers.new("HubDish", "BOOLEAN")
    cut_hub.object = hub_obj
    cut_hub.operation = "DIFFERENCE"
    cut_hub.solver = "EXACT"
    with bpy.context.temp_override(object=obj, active_object=obj, selected_objects=[obj], selected_editable_objects=[obj]):
        bpy.ops.object.modifier_apply(modifier="HubDish")
        
    # Cut axle hole
    cut_axle = obj.modifiers.new("AxleHole", "BOOLEAN")
    cut_axle.object = hole_obj
    cut_axle.operation = "DIFFERENCE"
    cut_axle.solver = "EXACT"
    with bpy.context.temp_override(object=obj, active_object=obj, selected_objects=[obj], selected_editable_objects=[obj]):
        bpy.ops.object.modifier_apply(modifier="AxleHole")
        
    for tool_obj in [hole_obj, hub_obj]:
        t_mesh = tool_obj.data.name
        bpy.data.objects.remove(tool_obj, do_unlink=True)
        if t_mesh in bpy.data.meshes:
            bpy.data.meshes.remove(bpy.data.meshes[t_mesh], do_unlink=True)
            
    # Normalize bounds
    bpy.context.view_layer.update()
    bb = [Vector(v) for v in obj.bound_box]
    min_x = min(v.x for v in bb); max_x = max(v.x for v in bb)
    min_y = min(v.y for v in bb); max_y = max(v.y for v in bb)
    min_z = min(v.z for v in bb); max_z = max(v.z for v in bb)
    
    scale_x = FRONT_WHEEL_EXTENTS[0] / (max_x - min_x)
    scale_y = FRONT_WHEEL_EXTENTS[1] / (max_y - min_y)
    scale_z = FRONT_WHEEL_EXTENTS[2] / (max_z - min_z)
    
    bm_adj = bmesh.new()
    bm_adj.from_mesh(obj.data)
    for v in bm_adj.verts:
        v.co.x = (v.co.x) * scale_x
        v.co.y = (v.co.y) * scale_y
        v.co.z = (v.co.z) * scale_z
    bm_adj.to_mesh(obj.data)
    bm_adj.free()
    obj.data.update()
    
    for poly in obj.data.polygons:
        poly.use_smooth = True
        
    return obj

def build_front_wheel():
    """FrontWheel — front rolling wheel
    Material: natural oiled beech wood with matte finish
    """
    mat = make_material("BeechWoodMat", (0.86, 0.72, 0.52), roughness=0.5, metallic=0.0)
    
    w0 = create_wheel_mesh("FrontWheel_0", 0.054, -0.065, 0.035, is_right=True)

import bpy
import bmesh
from mathutils import Vector, Matrix

random.seed(0)

REAR_WHEEL_EXTENTS = (0.024, 0.070, 0.070)

def make_material(name, rgb, roughness=0.55, metallic=0.0):
    mat = bpy.data.materials.new(name)
    bsdf = mat.node_tree.nodes["Principled BSDF"]
    bsdf.inputs["Base Color"].default_value = (rgb[0], rgb[1], rgb[2], 1.0)
    bsdf.inputs["Roughness"].default_value = roughness
    bsdf.inputs["Metallic"].default_value = metallic
    return mat

def create_wheel_mesh(name: str, x_pos: float, y_pos: float, z_pos: float, is_right: bool):
    """
    Creates a chunky toddler toy wheel:
    - Cylinder oriented along X axis (diameter 0.070 m, width 0.024 m)
    - Axle hole through the center (r=4.1 mm)
    - Shallow concentric hub cap detail on the outer face
    - Soft bevel along outer and inner rim
    """
    bm = bmesh.new()
    
    r = 0.035
    w = 0.024
    segments = 32
    
    bmesh.ops.create_cone(bm, cap_ends=True, segments=segments, radius1=r, radius2=r, depth=w)
    bmesh.ops.rotate(bm, cent=(0, 0, 0), matrix=Matrix.Rotation(math.pi / 2, 3, 'Y'), verts=bm.verts)
    
    bm_hole = bmesh.new()
    bmesh.ops.create_cone(bm_hole, cap_ends=True, segments=24, radius1=0.0042, radius2=0.0042, depth=0.035)
    bmesh.ops.rotate(bm_hole, cent=(0, 0, 0), matrix=Matrix.Rotation(math.pi / 2, 3, 'Y'), verts=bm_hole.verts)
    
    hub_sign = 1.0 if is_right else -1.0
    bm_hub = bmesh.new()
    bmesh.ops.create_cone(bm_hub, cap_ends=True, segments=24, radius1=0.018, radius2=0.018, depth=0.004)
    bmesh.ops.rotate(bm_hub, cent=(0, 0, 0), matrix=Matrix.Rotation(math.pi / 2, 3, 'Y'), verts=bm_hub.verts)
    bmesh.ops.translate(bm_hub, vec=(hub_sign * (w * 0.5), 0, 0), verts=bm_hub.verts)
    
    me_hole = bpy.data.meshes.new("_wr_hole")
    bm_hole.to_mesh(me_hole); bm_hole.free()
    hole_obj = bpy.data.objects.new("_wr_hole", me_hole)
    hole_obj.location = (x_pos, y_pos, z_pos)
    bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(hole_obj)
    
    me_hub = bpy.data.meshes.new("_wr_hub")
    bm_hub.to_mesh(me_hub); bm_hub.free()
    hub_obj = bpy.data.objects.new("_wr_hub", me_hub)
    hub_obj.location = (x_pos, y_pos, z_pos)
    bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(hub_obj)
    
    me = bpy.data.meshes.new(name)
    bm.to_mesh(me); bm.free()
    
    obj = bpy.data.objects.new(name, me)
    obj.location = (x_pos, y_pos, z_pos)
    bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(obj)
    
    bev = obj.modifiers.new("Bevel", "BEVEL")
    bev.width = 0.003
    bev.segments = 3
    bev.limit_method = "ANGLE"
    bev.angle_limit = math.radians(60)
    with bpy.context.temp_override(object=obj, active_object=obj, selected_objects=[obj], selected_editable_objects=[obj]):
        bpy.ops.object.modifier_apply(modifier="Bevel")
        
    cut_hub = obj.modifiers.new("HubDish", "BOOLEAN")
    cut_hub.object = hub_obj
    cut_hub.operation = "DIFFERENCE"
    cut_hub.solver = "EXACT"
    with bpy.context.temp_override(object=obj, active_object=obj, selected_objects=[obj], selected_editable_objects=[obj]):
        bpy.ops.object.modifier_apply(modifier="HubDish")
        
    cut_axle = obj.modifiers.new("AxleHole", "BOOLEAN")
    cut_axle.object = hole_obj
    cut_axle.operation = "DIFFERENCE"
    cut_axle.solver = "EXACT"
    with bpy.context.temp_override(object=obj, active_object=obj, selected_objects=[obj], selected_editable_objects=[obj]):
        bpy.ops.object.modifier_apply(modifier="AxleHole")
        
    for tool_obj in [hole_obj, hub_obj]:
        t_mesh = tool_obj.data.name
        bpy.data.objects.remove(tool_obj, do_unlink=True)
        if t_mesh in bpy.data.meshes:
            bpy.data.meshes.remove(bpy.data.meshes[t_mesh], do_unlink=True)
            
    bpy.context.view_layer.update()
    bb = [Vector(v) for v in obj.bound_box]
    min_x = min(v.x for v in bb); max_x = max(v.x for v in bb)
    min_y = min(v.y for v in bb); max_y = max(v.y for v in bb)
    min_z = min(v.z for v in bb); max_z = max(v.z for v in bb)
    
    scale_x = REAR_WHEEL_EXTENTS[0] / (max_x - min_x)
    scale_y = REAR_WHEEL_EXTENTS[1] / (max_y - min_y)
    scale_z = REAR_WHEEL_EXTENTS[2] / (max_z - min_z)
    
    bm_adj = bmesh.new()
    bm_adj.from_mesh(obj.data)
    for v in bm_adj.verts:
        v.co.x = (v.co.x) * scale_x
        v.co.y = (v.co.y) * scale_y
        v.co.z = (v.co.z) * scale_z
    bm_adj.to_mesh(obj.data)
    bm_adj.free()
    obj.data.update()
    
    for poly in obj.data.polygons:
        poly.use_smooth = True
        
    return obj

def build_rear_wheel():

    Material: natural oiled beech wood with matte finish

    w1 = create_wheel_mesh("RearWheel_1", -0.054, 0.065, 0.035, is_right=False)
    w1.data.materials.append(mat)
    
    return [w0, w1]

import math
import random
import bpy
import bmesh
from mathutils import Vector, Matrix

random.seed(0)

# Plan numbers
CAR_BODY_CENTER = (0.000, 0.000, 0.062)
CAR_BODY_EXTENTS = (0.088, 0.204, 0.096)
# x in [-0.044, 0.044], y in [-0.102, 0.102], z in [0.014, 0.110]

def make_material(name, rgb, roughness=0.25, metallic=0.0):
    mat = bpy.data.materials.new(name)
    bsdf = mat.node_tree.nodes["Principled BSDF"]
    bsdf.inputs["Base Color"].default_value = (rgb[0], rgb[1], rgb[2], 1.0)
    bsdf.inputs["Roughness"].default_value = roughness
    bsdf.inputs["Metallic"].default_value = metallic

def build_car_body():
    """CarBody — main unified vehicle body and cabin
    Smooth, one-piece contoured car body with a bulbous cabin top, rounded front hood, and tapered rear.
    Heavily beveled edges with integrated arched wheel-well clearances / axle hole clearances.
    Material: glossy bright red painted wood
    Plan bbox: center (0.000, 0.000, 0.062) extents (0.088, 0.204, 0.096)
    """
    mat = make_material("CarBodyMat", (0.85, 0.05, 0.05), roughness=0.2, metallic=0.0)

    bm = bmesh.new()
    
    # 11 Y stations from y=-0.102 to y=+0.102:
    stations = [
        # (y, half_width_bottom, half_width_top, z_bottom, z_waist, z_top, has_cabin)
        (-0.102, 0.038, 0.030, 0.022, 0.050, 0.058, False), # front nose rounded
        (-0.085, 0.043, 0.036, 0.016, 0.053, 0.063, False), # front hood
        (-0.065, 0.038, 0.038, 0.014, 0.055, 0.067, False), # over front wheels
        (-0.035, 0.044, 0.040, 0.014, 0.056, 0.075, False), # base of windshield
        (-0.015, 0.044, 0.034, 0.014, 0.057, 0.106, True),  # windshield / cabin front
        ( 0.000, 0.044, 0.034, 0.014, 0.057, 0.110, True),  # cabin peak
        ( 0.025, 0.044, 0.034, 0.014, 0.057, 0.107, True),  # cabin rear
        ( 0.045, 0.044, 0.037, 0.014, 0.056, 0.078, False), # rear window slope
        ( 0.065, 0.038, 0.038, 0.014, 0.055, 0.067, False), # over rear wheels
        ( 0.088, 0.043, 0.036, 0.016, 0.052, 0.062, False), # rear deck
        ( 0.102, 0.038, 0.028, 0.022, 0.048, 0.056, False), # rear bumper
    ]
    
    loops = []
    for y, wb, wt, zb, zw, zt, has_cab in stations:
        z_mid = (zb + zw) * 0.5
        top_w = wt * (0.65 if has_cab else 0.75)
        pts = [
            (-wb * 0.7, zb),          # 0 bottom left-center
            ( wb * 0.7, zb),          # 1 bottom right-center
            ( wb,       z_mid),       # 2 bottom right
            ( wt,       zw),          # 3 waist right
            ( top_w,    zt),          # 4 top right
            (-top_w,    zt),          # 5 top left
            (-wt,       zw),          # 6 waist left
            (-wb,       z_mid),       # 7 bottom left
        ]
        v_loop = []
        for x, z in pts:
            v_loop.append(bm.verts.new((x, y, z)))
        loops.append(v_loop)
    
    # Bridge loops with quads
    for i in range(len(loops) - 1):
        l1 = loops[i]
        l2 = loops[i + 1]
        for j in range(8):
            j_next = (j + 1) % 8
            bm.faces.new([l1[j], l2[j], l2[j_next], l1[j_next]])

    bm.faces.new([loops[0][7], loops[0][6], loops[0][5], loops[0][4], loops[0][3], loops[0][2], loops[0][1], loops[0][0]])
    bm.faces.new([loops[-1][0], loops[-1][1], loops[-1][2], loops[-1][3], loops[-1][4], loops[-1][5], loops[-1][6], loops[-1][7]])

    bm.faces.ensure_lookup_table()

    obj.data.materials.append(mat)

    sub.levels = 2
    sub.render_levels = 2

    bmesh.ops.create_cone(bm_cut1, cap_ends=True, segments=16, radius1=0.0042, radius2=0.0042, depth=0.15)
    bmesh.ops.rotate(bm_cut1, cent=(0, 0, 0), matrix=Matrix.Rotation(math.pi / 2, 3, 'Y'), verts=bm_cut1.verts)
    me_cut1 = bpy.data.meshes.new("_cut1")

    bm_cut1.free()
    c1 = bpy.data.objects.new("_cut1", me_cut1)
    c1.location = (0, -0.065, 0.035)
    bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(c1)
    
    # Rear axle cutout
    bm_cut2 = bmesh.new()
    bmesh.ops.create_cone(bm_cut2, cap_ends=True, segments=16, radius1=0.0042, radius2=0.0042, depth=0.15)
    bmesh.ops.rotate(bm_cut2, cent=(0, 0, 0), matrix=Matrix.Rotation(math.pi / 2, 3, 'Y'), verts=bm_cut2.verts)
    me_cut2 = bpy.data.meshes.new("_cut2")

    bm_cut2.free()
    c2 = bpy.data.objects.new("_cut2", me_cut2)
    c2.location = (0, 0.065, 0.035)
    bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(c2)
    
    # Apply subsurf
    with bpy.context.temp_override(object=obj, active_object=obj, selected_objects=[obj], selected_editable_objects=[obj]):
        bpy.ops.object.modifier_apply(modifier="Subsurf")
        
    # Apply boolean cuts
    for cutter, cut_name in [(c1, "Cut1"), (c2, "Cut2")]:
        b_mod = obj.modifiers.new(cut_name, "BOOLEAN")
        b_mod.object = cutter
        b_mod.operation = "DIFFERENCE"
        b_mod.solver = "EXACT"
        with bpy.context.temp_override(object=obj, active_object=obj, selected_objects=[obj], selected_editable_objects=[obj]):
            bpy.ops.object.modifier_apply(modifier=cut_name)
            
    # Clean up cutter objects
    for c in [c1, c2]:
        m_name = c.data.name
        bpy.data.objects.remove(c, do_unlink=True)
        if m_name in bpy.data.meshes:
            bpy.data.meshes.remove(bpy.data.meshes[m_name], do_unlink=True)

    bpy.context.view_layer.update()
    bb = [Vector(v) for v in obj.bound_box]
    min_x = min(v.x for v in bb); max_x = max(v.x for v in bb)
    min_y = min(v.y for v in bb); max_y = max(v.y for v in bb)
    min_z = min(v.z for v in bb); max_z = max(v.z for v in bb)
    
    curr_cx = (min_x + max_x) * 0.5
    curr_cy = (min_y + max_y) * 0.5
    curr_cz = (min_z + max_z) * 0.5
    curr_sx = max_x - min_x

    curr_sz = max_z - min_z

    scale_z = target_sz / curr_sz if curr_sz > 0 else 1.0
    
    bm_adj = bmesh.new()
    bm_adj.from_mesh(obj.data)
    for v in bm_adj.verts:
        v.co.x = target_cx + (v.co.x - curr_cx) * scale_x
        v.co.y = target_cy + (v.co.y - curr_cy) * scale_y
        v.co.z = target_cz + (v.co.z - curr_cz) * scale_z
    bm_adj.to_mesh(obj.data)
    bm_adj.free()
    obj.data.update()

        poly.use_smooth = True

    """
    Creates a chunky toddler toy wheel:
    - Cylinder oriented along X axis (diameter 0.070 m, width 0.024 m)
    - Center hub hole/indentation for the axle (diameter 0.0084 m, depth)
    - Soft bevel / chamfer along outer and inner rim

    # Outer radius 0.035, width 0.024
    # Let's create cylinder along Z then rotate to X
    r = 0.035
    w = 0.024
    segments = 32
    
    bmesh.ops.create_cone(bm, cap_ends=True, segments=segments, radius1=r, radius2=r, depth=w)
    
    # Rotate 90 degrees around Y axis so cylinder axis is X
    bmesh.ops.rotate(bm, cent=(0, 0, 0), matrix=Matrix.Rotation(math.pi / 2, 3, 'Y'), verts=bm.verts)
    
    # Center hub hole boolean or geometric indentation
    # Let's cut a hole of diameter 0.0082 (radius 0.0041) along X for axle fit
    # Axle diameter is 0.008 m. Radius 0.0041 gives a 0.1 mm clearance so no interpenetration!
    bm_hole = bmesh.new()
    bmesh.ops.create_cone(bm_hole, cap_ends=True, segments=16, radius1=0.0041, radius2=0.0041, depth=0.03)
    bmesh.ops.rotate(bm_hole, cent=(0, 0, 0), matrix=Matrix.Rotation(math.pi / 2, 3, 'Y'), verts=bm_hole.verts)
    
    me_hole = bpy.data.meshes.new("_hole")
    bm_hole.to_mesh(me_hole)
    bm_hole.free()
    hole_obj = bpy.data.objects.new("_hole", me_hole)
    bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(hole_obj)

    bm.free()
    
    obj = bpy.data.objects.new(name, me)
    obj.location = (x_pos, y_pos, z_pos)
    bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(obj)
    
    # Add bevel modifier for rounded rim edges (r = 3 mm)
    bev = obj.modifiers.new("Bevel", "BEVEL")
    bev.width = 0.003
    bev.segments = 2
    bev.limit_method = "ANGLE"

    cut = obj.modifiers.new("AxleHole", "BOOLEAN")
    cut.object = hole_obj
    cut.operation = "DIFFERENCE"
    cut.solver = "EXACT"
    with bpy.context.temp_override(object=obj, active_object=obj, selected_objects=[obj], selected_editable_objects=[obj]):
        bpy.ops.object.modifier_apply(modifier="AxleHole")
    bpy.data.objects.remove(hole_obj, do_unlink=True)
    bpy.data.meshes.remove(me_hole, do_unlink=True)
    
    # Ensure exact bbox bounds: X: [-0.012, 0.012] relative to center, Y: [-0.035, 0.035], Z: [-0.035, 0.035]
    # Let's adjust vertices to exactly match target bbox
    bpy.context.view_layer.update()
    bb = [Vector(v) for v in obj.bound_box]
    min_x = min(v.x for v in bb); max_x = max(v.x for v in bb)
    min_y = min(v.y for v in bb); max_y = max(v.y for v in bb)
    min_z = min(v.z for v in bb); max_z = max(v.z for v in bb)
    
    scale_x = FRONT_WHEEL_EXTENTS[0] / (max_x - min_x)
    scale_y = FRONT_WHEEL_EXTENTS[1] / (max_y - min_y)
    scale_z = FRONT_WHEEL_EXTENTS[2] / (max_z - min_z)
    
    bm_adj = bmesh.new()
    bm_adj.from_mesh(obj.data)
    for v in bm_adj.verts:
        v.co.x = (v.co.x) * scale_x
        v.co.y = (v.co.y) * scale_y
        v.co.z = (v.co.z) * scale_z
    bm_adj.to_mesh(obj.data)
    bm_adj.free()
    obj.data.update()
    
    # Set smooth shading
    for poly in obj.data.polygons:
        poly.use_smooth = True
        
    return obj

def build_front_wheel():
    """FrontWheel — front rolling wheel (pair at x = +0.054 and x = -0.054)
    Thick solid cylinder wheel oriented along X axis, diameter 0.070 m, thickness 0.024 m.
    Material: natural oiled beech wood with matte finish

"""ToyCar — Blender (bpy) model.

Chunky toddler-style toy car with a smoothly rounded one-piece body and four wide protruding wheels resting firmly on the ground. Measures approximately 0.14 x 0.21 x 0.11 m.
Style: Chunky Scandinavian wooden/plastic toddler toy aesthetic with exaggerated soft fillets (r=8-15 mm), playful bulbous cabin proportions, oversized thick wheels, and contrasting smooth materials.

CONTRACT (the harness runs this file in an EMPTY scene with `blender -b --factory-startup`):
  * Z is up, -Y is the FRONT, units are METERS. Object stands on z=0, footprint centred on Z.
  * Overall bbox: center (0.000, 0.000, 0.055) extents (0.136, 0.210, 0.110)
    -> x in [-0.068, 0.068]  y in [-0.105, 0.105]  z in [0.000, 0.110]
  * One mesh object per part, named EXACTLY as below (PascalCase); instances Name_0..Name_N-1,
    each TOP-LEVEL (never parented under an Empty — that merges them into ONE measured part).
  * LAYOUT: this file is the ENTRY. Each part lives in src/parts/<snake>.py and exports
    build_<snake>() -> bpy.types.Object; main() below imports and calls them in order.
    Edit geometry in the part files; keep this file to imports + calls + self-check.
  * Materials: Principled BSDF (Base Color / Roughness / Metallic). GLB keeps flat PBR + image
    textures only (procedural node textures are NOT exported) — rely on geometry + flat PBR.
  * Modifiers may stay unapplied (the exporter applies them). Keep < 500k triangles, < 120 s.
  * NEVER: cameras, lights, world, render settings, export/import, file IO, bpy.ops.wm.*.
  * Only bpy / bmesh / mathutils / math / random (seeded). No other imports.

import bpy
from mathutils import Vector

from parts.car_body import build_car_body
from parts.front_wheel import build_front_wheel
from parts.rear_wheel import build_rear_wheel
from parts.front_axle import build_front_axle
from parts.rear_axle import build_rear_axle
from parts.headlight import build_headlight

def _selfcheck():
    """What the harness checks first: meshes exist, no auto-suffixed names, stands on z=0."""
    bpy.context.view_layer.update()
    meshes = [o for o in bpy.data.objects if o.type == "MESH"]
    assert meshes, "no mesh objects built"
    for o in meshes:
        assert "." not in o.name, f"auto-suffixed name {o.name!r}: give every instance its own name"
    z_min = min((o.matrix_world @ Vector(c)).z for o in meshes for c in o.bound_box)
    assert abs(z_min) < 0.002, f"lowest point z={z_min:.4f}: the object must stand on z=0"
    print(f"[selfcheck] {len(meshes)} mesh objects, z_min={z_min:.4f}")


def main():
    # build every part (order = plan order); parts are placed at world pose by their builders
    build_car_body()
    build_front_wheel()
    build_rear_wheel()
    build_front_axle()
    build_rear_axle()
    build_headlight()
    build_taillight()
    _selfcheck()


main()

import math
import random
import bpy
import bmesh
from mathutils import Vector, Matrix

random.seed(0)

# Plan numbers
CAR_BODY_CENTER = (0.000, 0.000, 0.062)
CAR_BODY_EXTENTS = (0.088, 0.204, 0.096)
# x in [-0.044, 0.044], y in [-0.102, 0.102], z in [0.014, 0.110]

def make_material(name, rgb, roughness=0.25, metallic=0.0):
    mat = bpy.data.materials.new(name)
    bsdf = mat.node_tree.nodes["Principled BSDF"]
    bsdf.inputs["Base Color"].default_value = (rgb[0], rgb[1], rgb[2], 1.0)
    bsdf.inputs["Roughness"].default_value = roughness
    bsdf.inputs["Metallic"].default_value = metallic
    return mat

def build_car_body():
    """CarBody — main unified vehicle body and cabin
    Smooth, one-piece contoured car body with a bulbous cabin top, rounded front hood, and tapered rear.
    Heavily beveled edges with integrated arched wheel-well clearances / axle hole clearances.
    Material: glossy bright red painted wood
    Plan bbox: center (0.000, 0.000, 0.062) extents (0.088, 0.204, 0.096)
    """
    # Material: glossy bright red painted wood
    mat = make_material("CarBodyMat", (0.85, 0.05, 0.05), roughness=0.2, metallic=0.0)

    # Let's construct the car body mesh cleanly using bmesh
    # Grid of cross sections along Y (from front -0.102 to rear +0.102)
    # The body has a lower chassis part and an upper cabin part (one unified mesh).
    #
    # Let's define profile curves or create a base solid mesh and sculpt/round it.
    # A very solid, smooth way in Blender:
    # 1. Base block / subdivision cage with exact contours:
    # Front hood, windshield slope, bulbous roof, rear slope, rear deck.
    # Axle tunnels cut through at y = -0.065 and y = 0.065, z = 0.035, radius = 0.005 m.
    # Wheel arch recesses on the sides around x = +-0.044, at y = -0.065 and y = 0.065.
    
    bm = bmesh.new()
    
    # We can create a box grid / lofted profile for the car body:
    # Y stations:
    # y = -0.102 (front nose)
    # y = -0.065 (front axle / hood)
    # y = -0.025 (hood / windshield transition)
    # y = 0.000 (cabin peak)
    # y = 0.040 (cabin rear slope)
    # y = 0.065 (rear axle)
    # y = 0.102 (rear tail)
    
    # Let's create an 8-corner / multi-section prism and subdivide / bevel it:
    # Let's build vertices layer by layer or box modeling:
    # Overall target dimensions: X: [-0.044, 0.044], Y: [-0.102, 0.102], Z: [0.014, 0.110]
    
    # Let's create a base cube and form the car profile
    bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
    # scale to initial rough bounds:
    # Lower chassis: z from 0.014 to 0.058
    # Upper cabin: z from 0.058 to 0.110
    
    # Let's build the mesh directly with quad rings for perfect topology and exact bbox!
    bm.free()
    bm = bmesh.new()
    
    # Let's define the Y profiles (front to back):
    # Each profile is a 2D cross section in X-Z at a specific Y.
    # Half-width (X), bottom Z, hood/waist Z, top Z.
    
    # Let's define 11 Y stations from y=-0.102 to y=+0.102:
    stations = [
        # (y, half_width_bottom, half_width_top, z_bottom, z_waist, z_top, has_cabin)
        (-0.102, 0.038, 0.030, 0.022, 0.050, 0.058, False), # front nose rounded
        (-0.085, 0.043, 0.036, 0.016, 0.053, 0.063, False), # front hood
        (-0.065, 0.038, 0.038, 0.014, 0.055, 0.067, False), # over front wheels (tucked slightly at bottom)
        (-0.035, 0.044, 0.040, 0.014, 0.056, 0.075, False), # base of windshield
        (-0.015, 0.044, 0.034, 0.014, 0.057, 0.106, True),  # windshield / cabin front
        ( 0.000, 0.044, 0.034, 0.014, 0.057, 0.110, True),  # cabin peak
        ( 0.025, 0.044, 0.034, 0.014, 0.057, 0.107, True),  # cabin rear
        ( 0.045, 0.044, 0.037, 0.014, 0.056, 0.078, False), # rear window slope
        ( 0.065, 0.038, 0.038, 0.014, 0.055, 0.067, False), # over rear wheels
        ( 0.088, 0.043, 0.036, 0.016, 0.052, 0.062, False), # rear deck
        ( 0.102, 0.038, 0.028, 0.022, 0.048, 0.056, False), # rear bumper
    ]
    
    # We can create a smooth 8-vertex loop per station:
    # 0: bottom-left (-w_b, z_b)
    # 1: bottom-right (+w_b, z_b)
    # 2: lower-mid-right (+w_b, z_mid)
    # 3: waist-right (+w_t, z_w)
    # 4: top-right (+w_t*0.7, z_t)
    # 5: top-left (-w_t*0.7, z_t)
    # 6: waist-left (-w_t, z_w)
    # 7: lower-mid-left (-w_b, z_mid)
    
    loops = []
    for y, wb, wt, zb, zw, zt, has_cab in stations:
        z_mid = (zb + zw) * 0.5
        top_w = wt * (0.65 if has_cab else 0.75)
        # 8 boundary points in CCW order around Y
        pts = [
            (-wb * 0.7, zb),          # 0 bottom left-center
            ( wb * 0.7, zb),          # 1 bottom right-center
            ( wb,       z_mid),       # 2 bottom right
            ( wt,       zw),          # 3 waist right
            ( top_w,    zt),          # 4 top right
            (-top_w,    zt),          # 5 top left
            (-wt,       zw),          # 6 waist left
            (-wb,       z_mid),       # 7 bottom left
        ]
        v_loop = []
        for x, z in pts:
            v_loop.append(bm.verts.new((x, y, z)))
        loops.append(v_loop)
    
    # Bridge loops with quads
    for i in range(len(loops) - 1):
        l1 = loops[i]
        l2 = loops[i + 1]
        for j in range(8):
            j_next = (j + 1) % 8
            # Face vertices in CCW winding
            bm.faces.new([l1[j], l2[j], l2[j_next], l1[j_next]])
            
    # Cap front (station 0) and back (station -1)
    # Station 0 face (normal pointing -Y): vertices ordered CW when looking from front:
    bm.faces.new([loops[0][7], loops[0][6], loops[0][5], loops[0][4], loops[0][3], loops[0][2], loops[0][1], loops[0][0]])
    # Station -1 face (normal pointing +Y): vertices ordered CCW when looking from rear:
    bm.faces.new([loops[-1][0], loops[-1][1], loops[-1][2], loops[-1][3], loops[-1][4], loops[-1][5], loops[-1][6], loops[-1][7]])

    bm.verts.ensure_lookup_table()
    bm.faces.ensure_lookup_table()

    me = bpy.data.meshes.new("CarBody")
    bm.to_mesh(me)
    bm.free()
    
    obj = bpy.data.objects.new("CarBody", me)
    bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(obj)
    obj.data.materials.append(mat)
    
    # Add Subdivision Surface modifier for ultra smooth toy look
    sub = obj.modifiers.new("Subsurf", "SUBSURF")
    sub.levels = 2
    sub.render_levels = 2

    # Add boolean difference to cut axle tunnels so axles pass through without overlap errors!
    # Axle diameter = 0.008 m. A cutout cylinder of radius 0.0045 m at (0, -0.065, 0.035) and (0, 0.065, 0.035)
    # creates clearance for the steel axle rods.
    
    # Cut front axle tunnel
    bm_cut1 = bmesh.new()
    bmesh.ops.create_cone(bm_cut1, cap_ends=True, segments=16, radius1=0.0045, radius2=0.0045, depth=0.15)
    me_cut1 = bpy.data.meshes.new("_cut1")
    bm_cut1.to_mesh(me_cut1)
    bm_cut1.free()
    c1 = bpy.data.objects.new("_cut1", me_cut1)
    c1.rotation_euler = (0, math.pi / 2, 0)
    c1.location = (0, -0.065, 0.035)
    bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(c1)
    
    # Cut rear axle tunnel
    bm_cut2 = bmesh.new()
    bmesh.ops.create_cone(bm_cut2, cap_ends=True, segments=16, radius1=0.0045, radius2=0.0045, depth=0.15)
    me_cut2 = bpy.data.meshes.new("_cut2")
    bm_cut2.to_mesh(me_cut2)
    bm_cut2.free()
    c2 = bpy.data.objects.new("_cut2", me_cut2)
    c2.rotation_euler = (0, math.pi / 2, 0)
    c2.location = (0, 0.065, 0.035)
    bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(c2)
    
    # Apply subdivision first, then booleans
    # To ensure exact bbox and clean mesh, let's apply modifiers
    bpy.context.view_layer.objects.active = obj
    obj.select_set(True)
    
    # Apply subsurf
    with bpy.context.temp_override(object=obj, active_object=obj, selected_objects=[obj], selected_editable_objects=[obj]):
        bpy.ops.object.modifier_apply(modifier="Subsurf")
        
    # Apply boolean cuts
    for cutter, cut_name in [(c1, "Cut1"), (c2, "Cut2")]:
        b_mod = obj.modifiers.new(cut_name, "BOOLEAN")
        b_mod.object = cutter
        b_mod.operation = "DIFFERENCE"
        b_mod.solver = "EXACT"
        with bpy.context.temp_override(object=obj, active_object=obj, selected_objects=[obj], selected_editable_objects=[obj]):
            bpy.ops.object.modifier_apply(modifier=cut_name)
        bpy.data.objects.remove(cutter, do_unlink=True)
        bpy.data.meshes.remove(bpy.data.meshes.get(cutter.name), do_unlink=True) if bpy.data.meshes.get(cutter.name) else None

    # Now let's ensure the bounding box fits the plan exactly:
    # Center (0, 0, 0.062), Extents (0.088, 0.204, 0.096)
    # Let's measure and normalize bounds to exact plan
    bpy.context.view_layer.update()
    bb = [Vector(v) for v in obj.bound_box]
    min_x = min(v.x for v in bb); max_x = max(v.x for v in bb)
    min_y = min(v.y for v in bb); max_y = max(v.y for v in bb)
    min_z = min(v.z for v in bb); max_z = max(v.z for v in bb)
    
    curr_cx = (min_x + max_x) * 0.5
    curr_cy = (min_y + max_y) * 0.5
    curr_cz = (min_z + max_z) * 0.5
    curr_sx = max_x - min_x
    curr_sy = max_y - min_y
    curr_sz = max_z - min_z
    
    # Rescale vertices to match CAR_BODY_EXTENTS exactly and center at CAR_BODY_CENTER
    target_sx, target_sy, target_sz = CAR_BODY_EXTENTS
    target_cx, target_cy, target_cz = CAR_BODY_CENTER
    
    scale_x = target_sx / curr_sx if curr_sx > 0 else 1.0
    scale_y = target_sy / curr_sy if curr_sy > 0 else 1.0
    scale_z = target_sz / curr_sz if curr_sz > 0 else 1.0
    
    bm_adj = bmesh.new()
    bm_adj.from_mesh(obj.data)
    for v in bm_adj.verts:
        v.co.x = target_cx + (v.co.x - curr_cx) * scale_x
        v.co.y = target_cy + (v.co.y - curr_cy) * scale_y
        v.co.z = target_cz + (v.co.z - curr_cz) * scale_z
    bm_adj.to_mesh(obj.data)
    bm_adj.free()
    obj.data.update()
    
    # Smooth shading
    for poly in obj.data.polygons:
        poly.use_smooth = True

    return obj

import math
import random
import bpy
import bmesh
from mathutils import Vector, Matrix

random.seed(0)

FRONT_AXLE_CENTER = (0.000, -0.065, 0.035)
FRONT_AXLE_EXTENTS = (0.114, 0.008, 0.008)

def make_material(name, rgb, roughness=0.35, metallic=1.0):
    mat = bpy.data.materials.new(name)
    bsdf = mat.node_tree.nodes["Principled BSDF"]
    bsdf.inputs["Base Color"].default_value = (rgb[0], rgb[1], rgb[2], 1.0)
    bsdf.inputs["Roughness"].default_value = roughness
    bsdf.inputs["Metallic"].default_value = metallic
    return mat

def build_front_axle():
    """FrontAxle — transverse front wheel axle
    Solid horizontal cylinder rod (diameter 8 mm, length 0.114 m) passing through the lower front chassis.
    Material: semi-gloss steel rod
    """
    mat = make_material("FrontAxleMat", (0.75, 0.75, 0.78), roughness=0.35, metallic=1.0)
    
    # Cylinder of length 0.114, radius 0.004 m
    bm = bmesh.new()
    bmesh.ops.create_cone(bm, cap_ends=True, segments=24, radius1=0.004, radius2=0.004, depth=0.114)
    # Rotate to align with X axis
    bmesh.ops.rotate(bm, cent=(0, 0, 0), matrix=Matrix.Rotation(math.pi / 2, 3, 'Y'), verts=bm.verts)
    
    me = bpy.data.meshes.new("FrontAxle")
    bm.to_mesh(me)
    bm.free()
    
    obj = bpy.data.objects.new("FrontAxle", me)
    obj.location = FRONT_AXLE_CENTER
    bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(obj)
    obj.data.materials.append(mat)
    
    # Soft end bevel
    bev = obj.modifiers.new("Bevel", "BEVEL")
    bev.width = 0.0006
    bev.segments = 2
    
    for poly in obj.data.polygons:
        poly.use_smooth = True
        
    return obj

import math
import random
import bpy
import bmesh
from mathutils import Vector, Matrix

random.seed(0)

FRONT_WHEEL_CENTER = (0.054, -0.065, 0.035)
FRONT_WHEEL_EXTENTS = (0.024, 0.070, 0.070)
# Cylinder along X axis: radius = 0.035 m (diameter 0.070 m), thickness = 0.024 m

def make_material(name, rgb, roughness=0.6, metallic=0.0):
    mat = bpy.data.materials.new(name)
    bsdf = mat.node_tree.nodes["Principled BSDF"]
    bsdf.inputs["Base Color"].default_value = (rgb[0], rgb[1], rgb[2], 1.0)
    bsdf.inputs["Roughness"].default_value = roughness
    bsdf.inputs["Metallic"].default_value = metallic
    return mat

def create_wheel_mesh(name: str, x_pos: float, y_pos: float, z_pos: float, is_right: bool):
    """
    Creates a chunky toddler toy wheel:
    - Cylinder oriented along X axis (diameter 0.070 m, width 0.024 m)
    - Center hub hole/indentation for the axle (diameter 0.0084 m, depth)
    - Soft bevel / chamfer along outer and inner rim
    """
    bm = bmesh.new()
    
    # Outer radius 0.035, width 0.024
    # Let's create cylinder along Z then rotate to X
    r = 0.035
    w = 0.024
    segments = 32
    
    bmesh.ops.create_cone(bm, cap_ends=True, segments=segments, radius1=r, radius2=r, depth=w)
    
    # Rotate 90 degrees around Y axis so cylinder axis is X
    bmesh.ops.rotate(bm, cent=(0, 0, 0), matrix=Matrix.Rotation(math.pi / 2, 3, 'Y'), verts=bm.verts)
    
    # Center hub hole boolean or geometric indentation
    # Let's cut a hole of diameter 0.0082 (radius 0.0041) along X for axle fit
    # Axle diameter is 0.008 m. Radius 0.0041 gives a 0.1 mm clearance so no interpenetration!
    bm_hole = bmesh.new()
    bmesh.ops.create_cone(bm_hole, cap_ends=True, segments=16, radius1=0.0041, radius2=0.0041, depth=0.03)
    bmesh.ops.rotate(bm_hole, cent=(0, 0, 0), matrix=Matrix.Rotation(math.pi / 2, 3, 'Y'), verts=bm_hole.verts)
    
    me_hole = bpy.data.meshes.new("_hole")
    bm_hole.to_mesh(me_hole)
    bm_hole.free()
    hole_obj = bpy.data.objects.new("_hole", me_hole)
    bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(hole_obj)
    
    me = bpy.data.meshes.new(name)
    bm.to_mesh(me)
    bm.free()
    
    obj = bpy.data.objects.new(name, me)
    obj.location = (x_pos, y_pos, z_pos)
    bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(obj)
    
    # Add bevel modifier for rounded rim edges (r = 3 mm)
    bev = obj.modifiers.new("Bevel", "BEVEL")
    bev.width = 0.003
    bev.segments = 2
    bev.limit_method = "ANGLE"
    bev.angle_limit = math.radians(60)
    
    # Apply bevel modifier
    with bpy.context.temp_override(object=obj, active_object=obj, selected_objects=[obj], selected_editable_objects=[obj]):
        bpy.ops.object.modifier_apply(modifier="Bevel")
        
    # Cut center axle hole
    hole_obj.location = (x_pos, y_pos, z_pos)
    cut = obj.modifiers.new("AxleHole", "BOOLEAN")
    cut.object = hole_obj
    cut.operation = "DIFFERENCE"
    cut.solver = "EXACT"
    with bpy.context.temp_override(object=obj, active_object=obj, selected_objects=[obj], selected_editable_objects=[obj]):
        bpy.ops.object.modifier_apply(modifier="AxleHole")
    bpy.data.objects.remove(hole_obj, do_unlink=True)
    bpy.data.meshes.remove(me_hole, do_unlink=True)
    
    # Ensure exact bbox bounds: X: [-0.012, 0.012] relative to center, Y: [-0.035, 0.035], Z: [-0.035, 0.035]
    # Let's adjust vertices to exactly match target bbox
    bpy.context.view_layer.update()
    bb = [Vector(v) for v in obj.bound_box]
    min_x = min(v.x for v in bb); max_x = max(v.x for v in bb)
    min_y = min(v.y for v in bb); max_y = max(v.y for v in bb)
    min_z = min(v.z for v in bb); max_z = max(v.z for v in bb)
    
    scale_x = FRONT_WHEEL_EXTENTS[0] / (max_x - min_x)
    scale_y = FRONT_WHEEL_EXTENTS[1] / (max_y - min_y)
    scale_z = FRONT_WHEEL_EXTENTS[2] / (max_z - min_z)
    
    bm_adj = bmesh.new()
    bm_adj.from_mesh(obj.data)
    for v in bm_adj.verts:
        v.co.x = (v.co.x) * scale_x
        v.co.y = (v.co.y) * scale_y
        v.co.z = (v.co.z) * scale_z
    bm_adj.to_mesh(obj.data)
    bm_adj.free()
    obj.data.update()
    
    # Set smooth shading
    for poly in obj.data.polygons:
        poly.use_smooth = True
        
    return obj

def build_front_wheel():
    """FrontWheel — front rolling wheel (pair at x = +0.054 and x = -0.054)
    Thick solid cylinder wheel oriented along X axis, diameter 0.070 m, thickness 0.024 m.
    Material: natural oiled beech wood with matte finish
    """
    # Natural oiled beech wood color (warm pale timber)
    mat = make_material("BeechWoodMat", (0.82, 0.68, 0.48), roughness=0.5, metallic=0.0)
    
    w0 = create_wheel_mesh("FrontWheel_0", 0.054, -0.065, 0.035, is_right=True)
    w0.data.materials.append(mat)
    
    w1 = create_wheel_mesh("FrontWheel_1", -0.054, -0.065, 0.035, is_right=False)
    w1.data.materials.append(mat)
    
    return [w0, w1]

import math
import random
import bpy
import bmesh
from mathutils import Vector, Matrix

random.seed(0)

HEADLIGHT_CENTER = (0.026, -0.100, 0.045)
HEADLIGHT_EXTENTS = (0.018, 0.006, 0.018)

def make_material(name, rgb, roughness=0.3, metallic=0.0):
    mat = bpy.data.materials.new(name)
    bsdf = mat.node_tree.nodes["Principled BSDF"]
    bsdf.inputs["Base Color"].default_value = (rgb[0], rgb[1], rgb[2], 1.0)
    bsdf.inputs["Roughness"].default_value = roughness
    bsdf.inputs["Metallic"].default_value = metallic
    return mat

def create_headlight(name: str, x_pos: float, y_pos: float, z_pos: float):
    """
    Flattened circular dome cap (diameter 18 mm, depth 6 mm), facing -Y.
    """
    bm = bmesh.new()
    # Cylinder along Y: radius 0.009 (diameter 0.018), depth 0.006
    bmesh.ops.create_cone(bm, cap_ends=True, segments=24, radius1=0.009, radius2=0.009, depth=0.006)
    # Rotate cylinder from Z to Y axis
    bmesh.ops.rotate(bm, cent=(0, 0, 0), matrix=Matrix.Rotation(math.pi / 2, 3, 'X'), verts=bm.verts)
    
    # Bevel the front rim for a soft dome cap look
    me = bpy.data.meshes.new(name)
    bm.to_mesh(me)
    bm.free()
    
    obj = bpy.data.objects.new(name, me)
    obj.location = (x_pos, y_pos, z_pos)

def make_material(name, rgb, roughness=0.6, metallic=0.0):
    mat = bpy.data.materials.new(name)

    bsdf.inputs["Base Color"].default_value = (rgb[0], rgb[1], rgb[2], 1.0)
    bsdf.inputs["Roughness"].default_value = roughness
    bsdf.inputs["Metallic"].default_value = metallic
    return mat

def create_wheel_mesh(name: str, x_pos: float, y_pos: float, z_pos: float, is_right: bool):
    """
    Creates a chunky toddler toy wheel:
    - Cylinder oriented along X axis (diameter 0.070 m, width 0.024 m)
    - Center hub hole/indentation for the axle (diameter 0.0084 m, depth)
    - Soft bevel / chamfer along outer and inner rim
    """
    bm = bmesh.new()
    
    r = 0.035
    w = 0.024
    segments = 32
    
    bmesh.ops.create_cone(bm, cap_ends=True, segments=segments, radius1=r, radius2=r, depth=w)
    bmesh.ops.rotate(bm, cent=(0, 0, 0), matrix=Matrix.Rotation(math.pi / 2, 3, 'Y'), verts=bm.verts)
    
    bm_hole = bmesh.new()
    bmesh.ops.create_cone(bm_hole, cap_ends=True, segments=16, radius1=0.0041, radius2=0.0041, depth=0.03)
    bmesh.ops.rotate(bm_hole, cent=(0, 0, 0), matrix=Matrix.Rotation(math.pi / 2, 3, 'Y'), verts=bm_hole.verts)
    
    me_hole = bpy.data.meshes.new("_hole_r")
    bm_hole.to_mesh(me_hole)
    bm_hole.free()
    hole_obj = bpy.data.objects.new("_hole_r", me_hole)
    bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(hole_obj)
    
    me = bpy.data.meshes.new(name)
    bm.to_mesh(me)
    bm.free()
    
    obj = bpy.data.objects.new(name, me)
    obj.location = (x_pos, y_pos, z_pos)
    bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(obj)
    
    bev = obj.modifiers.new("Bevel", "BEVEL")
    bev.width = 0.003
    bev.segments = 2
    bev.limit_method = "ANGLE"
    bev.angle_limit = math.radians(60)
    
    with bpy.context.temp_override(object=obj, active_object=obj, selected_objects=[obj], selected_editable_objects=[obj]):
        bpy.ops.object.modifier_apply(modifier="Bevel")
        
    hole_obj.location = (x_pos, y_pos, z_pos)
    cut = obj.modifiers.new("AxleHole", "BOOLEAN")
    cut.object = hole_obj
    cut.operation = "DIFFERENCE"
    cut.solver = "EXACT"
    with bpy.context.temp_override(object=obj, active_object=obj, selected_objects=[obj], selected_editable_objects=[obj]):
        bpy.ops.object.modifier_apply(modifier="AxleHole")
    bpy.data.objects.remove(hole_obj, do_unlink=True)
    bpy.data.meshes.remove(me_hole, do_unlink=True)
    
    bpy.context.view_layer.update()
    bb = [Vector(v) for v in obj.bound_box]
    min_x = min(v.x for v in bb); max_x = max(v.x for v in bb)
    min_y = min(v.y for v in bb); max_y = max(v.y for v in bb)
    min_z = min(v.z for v in bb); max_z = max(v.z for v in bb)
    
    scale_x = REAR_WHEEL_EXTENTS[0] / (max_x - min_x)
    scale_y = REAR_WHEEL_EXTENTS[1] / (max_y - min_y)
    scale_z = REAR_WHEEL_EXTENTS[2] / (max_z - min_z)
    
    bm_adj = bmesh.new()
    bm_adj.from_mesh(obj.data)
    for v in bm_adj.verts:
        v.co.x = (v.co.x) * scale_x
        v.co.y = (v.co.y) * scale_y
        v.co.z = (v.co.z) * scale_z
    bm_adj.to_mesh(obj.data)
    bm_adj.free()
    obj.data.update()
    
    for poly in obj.data.polygons:
        poly.use_smooth = True
        
    return obj

def build_rear_wheel():
    """RearWheel — rear rolling wheel (pair at x = +0.054 and x = -0.054)
    Thick solid cylinder wheel oriented along X axis, diameter 0.070 m, thickness 0.024 m.
    Material: natural oiled beech wood with matte finish

import math

from mathutils import Vector, Matrix

random.seed(0)

CAR_BODY_CENTER = (0.000, 0.000, 0.062)
CAR_BODY_EXTENTS = (0.088, 0.204, 0.096)

def make_material(name, rgb, roughness=0.25, metallic=0.0):

def build_car_body():
    """CarBody — main unified vehicle body and cabin
    Smooth, one-piece contoured car body with a bulbous cabin top, rounded front hood, and tapered rear.
    Material: glossy bright red painted wood
    """
    mat = make_material("CarBodyMat", (0.85, 0.05, 0.05), roughness=0.2, metallic=0.0)

    bm = bmesh.new()
    
    # 13 Y stations from y=-0.102 to y=+0.102
    stations = [
        # (y, w_bottom, w_mid, w_top, z_bottom, z_waist, z_top, is_cabin)
        (-0.102, 0.034, 0.038, 0.026, 0.018, 0.042, 0.052, False), # front nose tip
        (-0.088, 0.040, 0.044, 0.034, 0.015, 0.045, 0.056, False), # front hood
        (-0.065, 0.036, 0.042, 0.035, 0.014, 0.048, 0.058, False), # over front wheels
        (-0.040, 0.040, 0.044, 0.038, 0.014, 0.050, 0.062, False), # base of windshield
        (-0.020, 0.042, 0.044, 0.034, 0.014, 0.052, 0.098, True),  # windshield
        ( 0.000, 0.042, 0.044, 0.035, 0.014, 0.052, 0.110, True),  # cabin peak
        ( 0.020, 0.042, 0.044, 0.034, 0.014, 0.052, 0.104, True),  # cabin rear
        ( 0.040, 0.042, 0.044, 0.037, 0.014, 0.050, 0.072, False), # rear window base
        ( 0.065, 0.036, 0.042, 0.035, 0.014, 0.048, 0.058, False), # over rear wheels
        ( 0.088, 0.040, 0.044, 0.032, 0.015, 0.045, 0.054, False), # rear deck
        ( 0.102, 0.032, 0.036, 0.024, 0.018, 0.040, 0.050, False), # rear bumper tip
    ]
    
    loops = []
    for y, wb, wm, wt, zb, zw, zt, is_cab in stations:
        z_mid_low = (zb + zw) * 0.5
        z_mid_high = (zw + zt) * 0.5
        wt_eff = wt * (0.75 if is_cab else 0.85)
        
        pts = [
            ( 0.0,         zb),          # 0 bottom center
            ( wb * 0.7,    zb + (zw - zb)*0.1), # 1 bottom right
            ( wm,          z_mid_low),   # 2 lower right
            ( wm,          zw),          # 3 waist right
            ( wt,          z_mid_high),  # 4 upper right
            ( wt_eff,      zt - (zt - zw)*0.1), # 5 top right
            ( 0.0,         zt),          # 6 top center
            (-wt_eff,      zt - (zt - zw)*0.1), # 7 top left
            (-wt,          z_mid_high),  # 8 upper left
            (-wm,          zw),          # 9 waist left
            (-wm,          z_mid_low),   # 10 lower left
            (-wb * 0.7,    zb + (zw - zb)*0.1), # 11 bottom left
        ]
        v_loop = []
        for x, z in pts:
            v_loop.append(bm.verts.new((x, y, z)))
        loops.append(v_loop)
        
    n_pts = len(loops[0])
    for i in range(len(loops) - 1):
        l1 = loops[i]
        l2 = loops[i + 1]
        for j in range(n_pts):
            j_next = (j + 1) % n_pts
            bm.faces.new([l1[j], l2[j], l2[j_next], l1[j_next]])
            
    v_front_center = bm.verts.new((0, stations[0][0] - 0.005, (stations[0][4] + stations[0][6]) * 0.5))
    for j in range(n_pts):
        j_next = (j + 1) % n_pts
        bm.faces.new([v_front_center, loops[0][j_next], loops[0][j]])
        
    v_rear_center = bm.verts.new((0, stations[-1][0] + 0.005, (stations[-1][4] + stations[-1][6]) * 0.5))
    for j in range(n_pts):
        j_next = (j + 1) % n_pts
        bm.faces.new([v_rear_center, loops[-1][j], loops[-1][j_next]])

    bm.verts.ensure_lookup_table()
    bm.faces.ensure_lookup_table()

    me = bpy.data.meshes.new("CarBody")
    bm.to_mesh(me)
    bm.free()
    
    obj = bpy.data.objects.new("CarBody", me)
    bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(obj)
    obj.data.materials.append(mat)
    
    sub = obj.modifiers.new("Subsurf", "SUBSURF")

    sub.render_levels = 2

    bmesh.ops.rotate(bm_cutters, cent=(0, 0, 0), matrix=Matrix.Rotation(math.pi / 2, 3, 'Y'), verts=bm_cutters.verts)
    bmesh.ops.translate(bm_cutters, vec=(0, -0.065, 0.035), verts=bm_cutters.verts)
    
    bmesh.ops.create_cone(bm_cutters, cap_ends=True, segments=24, radius1=0.0044, radius2=0.0044, depth=0.25)
    new_verts = bm_cutters.verts[26:]
    bmesh.ops.rotate(bm_cutters, cent=(0, 0, 0), matrix=Matrix.Rotation(math.pi / 2, 3, 'Y'), verts=new_verts)
    bmesh.ops.translate(bm_cutters, vec=(0, 0.065, 0.035), verts=new_verts)

    me_cut = bpy.data.meshes.new("_axle_cutters")
    bm_cutters.to_mesh(me_cut); bm_cutters.free()
    cutter_obj = bpy.data.objects.new("_axle_cutters", me_cut)
    bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(cutter_obj)
    
    b_mod = obj.modifiers.new("AxleCuts", "BOOLEAN")
    b_mod.object = cutter_obj
    b_mod.operation = "DIFFERENCE"
    b_mod.solver = "MANIFOLD"
    with bpy.context.temp_override(object=obj, active_object=obj, selected_objects=[obj], selected_editable_objects=[obj]):
        bpy.ops.object.modifier_apply(modifier="AxleCuts")
        
    bpy.data.objects.remove(cutter_obj, do_unlink=True)
    bpy.data.meshes.remove(me_cut, do_unlink=True)

    bpy.context.view_layer.update()
    bb = [Vector(v) for v in obj.bound_box]
    min_x = min(v.x for v in bb); max_x = max(v.x for v in bb)
    min_y = min(v.y for v in bb); max_y = max(v.y for v in bb)
    min_z = min(v.z for v in bb); max_z = max(v.z for v in bb)
    
    curr_cx = (min_x + max_x) * 0.5
    curr_cy = (min_y + max_y) * 0.5
    curr_cz = (min_z + max_z) * 0.5
    curr_sx = max_x - min_x
    curr_sy = max_y - min_y
    curr_sz = max_z - min_z
    
    target_sx, target_sy, target_sz = CAR_BODY_EXTENTS
    target_cx, target_cy, target_cz = CAR_BODY_CENTER
    
    scale_x = target_sx / curr_sx if curr_sx > 0 else 1.0
    scale_y = target_sy / curr_sy if curr_sy > 0 else 1.0
    scale_z = target_sz / curr_sz if curr_sz > 0 else 1.0
    
    bm_adj = bmesh.new()
    bm_adj.from_mesh(obj.data)
    for v in bm_adj.verts:
        v.co.x = target_cx + (v.co.x - curr_cx) * scale_x
        v.co.y = target_cy + (v.co.y - curr_cy) * scale_y
        v.co.z = target_cz + (v.co.z - curr_cz) * scale_z
    bm_adj.to_mesh(obj.data)
    bm_adj.free()
    obj.data.update()
    
    for poly in obj.data.polygons:
        poly.use_smooth = True

    return obj

import math
import random
import bpy
import bmesh
from mathutils import Vector, Matrix

random.seed(0)

FRONT_WHEEL_CENTER = (0.054, -0.065, 0.035)
FRONT_WHEEL_EXTENTS = (0.024, 0.070, 0.070)

def make_material(name, rgb, roughness=0.55, metallic=0.0):
    mat = bpy.data.materials.new(name)
    bsdf = mat.node_tree.nodes["Principled BSDF"]
    bsdf.inputs["Base Color"].default_value = (rgb[0], rgb[1], rgb[2], 1.0)
    bsdf.inputs["Roughness"].default_value = roughness
    bsdf.inputs["Metallic"].default_value = metallic
    return mat

def create_wheel_mesh(name: str, x_pos: float, y_pos: float, z_pos: float, is_right: bool):
    """
    Creates a chunky toddler toy wheel:
    - Cylinder oriented along X axis (diameter 0.070 m, width 0.024 m)
    - Axle hole through the center (r=4.1 mm)
    - Shallow concentric hub cap detail on the outer face
    - Soft bevel along outer and inner rim
    """
    bm = bmesh.new()
    
    # Outer radius 0.035, width 0.024
    r = 0.035
    w = 0.024
    segments = 32
    
    # Build cylinder with concentric hub rings on end faces
    bmesh.ops.create_cone(bm, cap_ends=True, segments=segments, radius1=r, radius2=r, depth=w)
    bmesh.ops.rotate(bm, cent=(0, 0, 0), matrix=Matrix.Rotation(math.pi / 2, 3, 'Y'), verts=bm.verts)
    
    # Axle hole
    bm_hole = bmesh.new()
    bmesh.ops.create_cone(bm_hole, cap_ends=True, segments=24, radius1=0.0042, radius2=0.0042, depth=0.035)
    bmesh.ops.rotate(bm_hole, cent=(0, 0, 0), matrix=Matrix.Rotation(math.pi / 2, 3, 'Y'), verts=bm_hole.verts)
    
    # Hub indentation on outer face
    # For right wheel (is_right=True, outer is +X), for left wheel outer is -X
    hub_sign = 1.0 if is_right else -1.0
    bm_hub = bmesh.new()
    bmesh.ops.create_cone(bm_hub, cap_ends=True, segments=24, radius1=0.018, radius2=0.018, depth=0.004)
    bmesh.ops.rotate(bm_hub, cent=(0, 0, 0), matrix=Matrix.Rotation(math.pi / 2, 3, 'Y'), verts=bm_hub.verts)
    bmesh.ops.translate(bm_hub, vec=(hub_sign * (w * 0.5), 0, 0), verts=bm_hub.verts)
    
    me_hole = bpy.data.meshes.new("_w_hole")
    bm_hole.to_mesh(me_hole); bm_hole.free()
    hole_obj = bpy.data.objects.new("_w_hole", me_hole)
    hole_obj.location = (x_pos, y_pos, z_pos)
    bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(hole_obj)
    
    me_hub = bpy.data.meshes.new("_w_hub")
    bm_hub.to_mesh(me_hub); bm_hub.free()
    hub_obj = bpy.data.objects.new("_w_hub", me_hub)
    hub_obj.location = (x_pos, y_pos, z_pos)
    bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(hub_obj)
    
    me = bpy.data.meshes.new(name)
    bm.to_mesh(me); bm.free()
    
    obj = bpy.data.objects.new(name, me)
    obj.location = (x_pos, y_pos, z_pos)
    bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(obj)
    
    # Bevel rims
    bev = obj.modifiers.new("Bevel", "BEVEL")
    bev.width = 0.003
    bev.segments = 3
    bev.limit_method = "ANGLE"
    bev.angle_limit = math.radians(60)
    with bpy.context.temp_override(object=obj, active_object=obj, selected_objects=[obj], selected_editable_objects=[obj]):
        bpy.ops.object.modifier_apply(modifier="Bevel")
        
    # Cut hub dish
    cut_hub = obj.modifiers.new("HubDish", "BOOLEAN")
    cut_hub.object = hub_obj
    cut_hub.operation = "DIFFERENCE"
    cut_hub.solver = "EXACT"
    with bpy.context.temp_override(object=obj, active_object=obj, selected_objects=[obj], selected_editable_objects=[obj]):
        bpy.ops.object.modifier_apply(modifier="HubDish")
        
    # Cut axle hole
    cut_axle = obj.modifiers.new("AxleHole", "BOOLEAN")
    cut_axle.object = hole_obj
    cut_axle.operation = "DIFFERENCE"
    cut_axle.solver = "EXACT"
    with bpy.context.temp_override(object=obj, active_object=obj, selected_objects=[obj], selected_editable_objects=[obj]):
        bpy.ops.object.modifier_apply(modifier="AxleHole")
        
    for tool_obj in [hole_obj, hub_obj]:
        t_mesh = tool_obj.data.name
        bpy.data.objects.remove(tool_obj, do_unlink=True)
        if t_mesh in bpy.data.meshes:
            bpy.data.meshes.remove(bpy.data.meshes[t_mesh], do_unlink=True)
            
    # Normalize bounds
    bpy.context.view_layer.update()
    bb = [Vector(v) for v in obj.bound_box]
    min_x = min(v.x for v in bb); max_x = max(v.x for v in bb)
    min_y = min(v.y for v in bb); max_y = max(v.y for v in bb)
    min_z = min(v.z for v in bb); max_z = max(v.z for v in bb)
    
    scale_x = FRONT_WHEEL_EXTENTS[0] / (max_x - min_x)
    scale_y = FRONT_WHEEL_EXTENTS[1] / (max_y - min_y)
    scale_z = FRONT_WHEEL_EXTENTS[2] / (max_z - min_z)
    
    bm_adj = bmesh.new()
    bm_adj.from_mesh(obj.data)
    for v in bm_adj.verts:
        v.co.x = (v.co.x) * scale_x
        v.co.y = (v.co.y) * scale_y
        v.co.z = (v.co.z) * scale_z
    bm_adj.to_mesh(obj.data)
    bm_adj.free()
    obj.data.update()
    
    for poly in obj.data.polygons:
        poly.use_smooth = True
        
    return obj

def build_front_wheel():
    """FrontWheel — front rolling wheel
    Material: natural oiled beech wood with matte finish
    """
    mat = make_material("BeechWoodMat", (0.86, 0.72, 0.52), roughness=0.5, metallic=0.0)
    
    w0 = create_wheel_mesh("FrontWheel_0", 0.054, -0.065, 0.035, is_right=True)
    w0.data.materials.append(mat)
    
    w1 = create_wheel_mesh("FrontWheel_1", -0.054, -0.065, 0.035, is_right=False)
    w1.data.materials.append(mat)
    
    return [w0, w1]

  - Taillight x2: rear decorative taillights; bbox center (0.026, 0.100, 0.045) extents (0.014, 0.006, 0.014)  [src/parts/taillight.py]

  - [a1] Overall bounding box is approximately 0.136 x 0.210 x 0.110 m (±0.01 m)
  - [a2] All four wheels touch the ground plane at z = 0.000 m (±0.001 m)
  - [a3] Wheel outer faces extend beyond the car body sides by at least 0.020 m on each side
  - [a4] Car body is a cohesive, rounded one-piece shape with smooth corners
  - [a5] Axles pass continuously through the lower body section into wheel hubs
  - [a6] Headlights and taillights are symmetrically placed on the front and rear faces
  - [must1] Includes: one-piece rounded body
  - [must2] Includes: four wheels touching the ground
  - [must3] Includes: wheels protrude sideways
"""
import bpy
from mathutils import Vector

from parts.car_body import build_car_body
from parts.front_wheel import build_front_wheel
from parts.rear_wheel import build_rear_wheel
from parts.front_axle import build_front_axle
from parts.rear_axle import build_rear_axle
from parts.headlight import build_headlight
from parts.taillight import build_taillight


def _selfcheck():
    """What the harness checks first: meshes exist, no auto-suffixed names, stands on z=0."""
    bpy.context.view_layer.update()
    meshes = [o for o in bpy.data.objects if o.type == "MESH"]
    assert meshes, "no mesh objects built"
    for o in meshes:
        assert "." not in o.name, f"auto-suffixed name {o.name!r}: give every instance its own name"
    z_min = min((o.matrix_world @ Vector(c)).z for o in meshes for c in o.bound_box)
    assert abs(z_min) < 0.002, f"lowest point z={z_min:.4f}: the object must stand on z=0"
    print(f"[selfcheck] {len(meshes)} mesh objects, z_min={z_min:.4f}")


def main():
    # build every part (order = plan order); parts are placed at world pose by their builders
    build_car_body()
    build_front_wheel()
    build_rear_wheel()
    build_front_axle()
    build_rear_axle()
    build_headlight()
    build_taillight()
    _selfcheck()


main()

import math
import random
import bpy
import bmesh
from mathutils import Vector, Matrix

random.seed(0)

CAR_BODY_CENTER = (0.000, 0.000, 0.062)
CAR_BODY_EXTENTS = (0.088, 0.204, 0.096)

def make_material(name, rgb, roughness=0.25, metallic=0.0):
    mat = bpy.data.materials.new(name)
    bsdf = mat.node_tree.nodes["Principled BSDF"]
    bsdf.inputs["Base Color"].default_value = (rgb[0], rgb[1], rgb[2], 1.0)
    bsdf.inputs["Roughness"].default_value = roughness
    bsdf.inputs["Metallic"].default_value = metallic
    return mat

def build_car_body():
    """CarBody — main unified vehicle body and cabin
    Smooth, one-piece contoured car body with a bulbous cabin top, rounded front hood, and tapered rear.
    Material: glossy bright red painted wood
    """
    mat = make_material("CarBodyMat", (0.85, 0.05, 0.05), roughness=0.2, metallic=0.0)

    bm = bmesh.new()
    
    # 13 Y stations from y=-0.102 to y=+0.102
    stations = [
        # (y, w_bottom, w_mid, w_top, z_bottom, z_waist, z_top, is_cabin)
        (-0.102, 0.034, 0.038, 0.026, 0.018, 0.042, 0.052, False), # front nose tip
        (-0.088, 0.040, 0.044, 0.034, 0.015, 0.045, 0.056, False), # front hood
        (-0.065, 0.036, 0.042, 0.035, 0.014, 0.048, 0.058, False), # over front wheels
        (-0.040, 0.040, 0.044, 0.038, 0.014, 0.050, 0.062, False), # base of windshield
        (-0.020, 0.042, 0.044, 0.034, 0.014, 0.052, 0.098, True),  # windshield
        ( 0.000, 0.042, 0.044, 0.035, 0.014, 0.052, 0.110, True),  # cabin peak
        ( 0.020, 0.042, 0.044, 0.034, 0.014, 0.052, 0.104, True),  # cabin rear
        ( 0.040, 0.042, 0.044, 0.037, 0.014, 0.050, 0.072, False), # rear window base
        ( 0.065, 0.036, 0.042, 0.035, 0.014, 0.048, 0.058, False), # over rear wheels
        ( 0.088, 0.040, 0.044, 0.032, 0.015, 0.045, 0.054, False), # rear deck
        ( 0.102, 0.032, 0.036, 0.024, 0.018, 0.040, 0.050, False), # rear bumper tip
    ]
    
    loops = []
    for y, wb, wm, wt, zb, zw, zt, is_cab in stations:
        z_mid_low = (zb + zw) * 0.5
        z_mid_high = (zw + zt) * 0.5
        wt_eff = wt * (0.75 if is_cab else 0.85)
        
        pts = [
            ( 0.0,         zb),          # 0 bottom center
            ( wb * 0.7,    zb + (zw - zb)*0.1), # 1 bottom right
            ( wm,          z_mid_low),   # 2 lower right
            ( wm,          zw),          # 3 waist right
            ( wt,          z_mid_high),  # 4 upper right
            ( wt_eff,      zt - (zt - zw)*0.1), # 5 top right
            ( 0.0,         zt),          # 6 top center
            (-wt_eff,      zt - (zt - zw)*0.1), # 7 top left
            (-wt,          z_mid_high),  # 8 upper left
            (-wm,          zw),          # 9 waist left
            (-wm,          z_mid_low),   # 10 lower left
            (-wb * 0.7,    zb + (zw - zb)*0.1), # 11 bottom left
        ]
        v_loop = []
        for x, z in pts:
            v_loop.append(bm.verts.new((x, y, z)))
        loops.append(v_loop)
        
    n_pts = len(loops[0])
    for i in range(len(loops) - 1):
        l1 = loops[i]
        l2 = loops[i + 1]
        for j in range(n_pts):
            j_next = (j + 1) % n_pts
            bm.faces.new([l1[j], l2[j], l2[j_next], l1[j_next]])
            
    v_front_center = bm.verts.new((0, stations[0][0] - 0.005, (stations[0][4] + stations[0][6]) * 0.5))
    for j in range(n_pts):
        j_next = (j + 1) % n_pts
        bm.faces.new([v_front_center, loops[0][j_next], loops[0][j]])
        
    v_rear_center = bm.verts.new((0, stations[-1][0] + 0.005, (stations[-1][4] + stations[-1][6]) * 0.5))
    for j in range(n_pts):
        j_next = (j + 1) % n_pts
        bm.faces.new([v_rear_center, loops[-1][j], loops[-1][j_next]])

    bm.verts.ensure_lookup_table()
    bm.faces.ensure_lookup_table()

    me = bpy.data.meshes.new("CarBody")
    bm.to_mesh(me)
    bm.free()
    
    obj = bpy.data.objects.new("CarBody", me)
    bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(obj)
    obj.data.materials.append(mat)
    
    sub = obj.modifiers.new("Subsurf", "SUBSURF")
    sub.levels = 2
    sub.render_levels = 2
    
    with bpy.context.temp_override(object=obj, active_object=obj, selected_objects=[obj], selected_editable_objects=[obj]):
        bpy.ops.object.modifier_apply(modifier="Subsurf")

    # Clean cutter: two cylinders in one mesh, FAST solver or EXACT with clean manifold
    bm_cutters = bmesh.new()
    bmesh.ops.create_cone(bm_cutters, cap_ends=True, segments=24, radius1=0.0044, radius2=0.0044, depth=0.25)
    bmesh.ops.rotate(bm_cutters, cent=(0, 0, 0), matrix=Matrix.Rotation(math.pi / 2, 3, 'Y'), verts=bm_cutters.verts)
    bmesh.ops.translate(bm_cutters, vec=(0, -0.065, 0.035), verts=bm_cutters.verts)
    
    # Add second cone
    bmesh.ops.create_cone(bm_cutters, cap_ends=True, segments=24, radius1=0.0044, radius2=0.0044, depth=0.25)
    new_verts = bm_cutters.verts[26:]
    bmesh.ops.rotate(bm_cutters, cent=(0, 0, 0), matrix=Matrix.Rotation(math.pi / 2, 3, 'Y'), verts=new_verts)
    bmesh.ops.translate(bm_cutters, vec=(0, 0.065, 0.035), verts=new_verts)

    me_cut = bpy.data.meshes.new("_axle_cutters")
    bm_cutters.to_mesh(me_cut); bm_cutters.free()
    cutter_obj = bpy.data.objects.new("_axle_cutters", me_cut)
    bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(cutter_obj)
    
    b_mod = obj.modifiers.new("AxleCuts", "BOOLEAN")
    b_mod.object = cutter_obj
    b_mod.operation = "DIFFERENCE"
    b_mod.solver = "FAST"
    with bpy.context.temp_override(object=obj, active_object=obj, selected_objects=[obj], selected_editable_objects=[obj]):
        bpy.ops.object.modifier_apply(modifier="AxleCuts")
        
    bpy.data.objects.remove(cutter_obj, do_unlink=True)
    bpy.data.meshes.remove(me_cut, do_unlink=True)

    bpy.context.view_layer.update()
    bb = [Vector(v) for v in obj.bound_box]
    min_x = min(v.x for v in bb); max_x = max(v.x for v in bb)
    min_y = min(v.y for v in bb); max_y = max(v.y for v in bb)
    min_z = min(v.z for v in bb); max_z = max(v.z for v in bb)
    
    curr_cx = (min_x + max_x) * 0.5
    curr_cy = (min_y + max_y) * 0.5
    curr_cz = (min_z + max_z) * 0.5
    curr_sx = max_x - min_x
    curr_sy = max_y - min_y
    curr_sz = max_z - min_z
    
    target_sx, target_sy, target_sz = CAR_BODY_EXTENTS
    target_cx, target_cy, target_cz = CAR_BODY_CENTER
    
    scale_x = target_sx / curr_sx if curr_sx > 0 else 1.0
    scale_y = target_sy / curr_sy if curr_sy > 0 else 1.0
    scale_z = target_sz / curr_sz if curr_sz > 0 else 1.0
    
    bm_adj = bmesh.new()
    bm_adj.from_mesh(obj.data)
    for v in bm_adj.verts:
        v.co.x = target_cx + (v.co.x - curr_cx) * scale_x
        v.co.y = target_cy + (v.co.y - curr_cy) * scale_y
        v.co.z = target_cz + (v.co.z - curr_cz) * scale_z
    bm_adj.to_mesh(obj.data)
    bm_adj.free()
    obj.data.update()
    
    for poly in obj.data.polygons:
        poly.use_smooth = True

    return obj
