"""ChassisAndLowerBody — main chassis frame, front hood, and integrated flared wheel arches.
"""
import math
import bpy
import bmesh
from mathutils import Vector, Matrix

# Plan:
# center (0.000, -0.050, 0.650) extents (1.880, 4.650, 0.720)
# x in [-0.940, 0.940], y in [-2.375, 2.275], z in [0.290, 1.010]
# Wheels at y = -1.45 and y = 1.45, x = +-0.86, z = 0.38, r = 0.38
# Front bumper at y = -2.34 (touches at -2.26)
# Rear bumper at y = 2.34 (touches at 2.26)
# Bed sits on top at z in [0.67, 1.25], Cab sits on top at z in [0.95, 1.73]

def make_material(name, rgb, roughness=0.5, metallic=0.0):
    mat = bpy.data.materials.new(name)
    bsdf = mat.node_tree.nodes["Principled BSDF"]
    bsdf.inputs["Base Color"].default_value = (rgb[0], rgb[1], rgb[2], 1.0)
    bsdf.inputs["Roughness"].default_value = roughness
    bsdf.inputs["Metallic"].default_value = metallic
    return mat

def create_wheel_arch(bm, cx, cy, cz, radius_in, radius_out, width, segments=16):
    """
    Creates an arched wheel flare over the wheel well.
    cx is the center X of the arch outer side.
    The arch spans angle 0 to pi (from y+ to y- in top half).
    """
    # Create an arched ring segment extruded in X
    verts_profile = []
    # Semi-circle in Y-Z plane
    angles = [math.pi * i / segments for i in range(segments + 1)]
    # We will build quad strips between inner radius and outer radius
    # For side on +X (sign = 1) or -X (sign = -1)
    sign = 1.0 if cx > 0 else -1.0
    x_outer = cx
    x_inner = cx - sign * width
    
    ring_verts_outer = []
    ring_verts_inner = []
    
    for a in angles:
        dy = math.cos(a)
        dz = math.sin(a)
        v_out_1 = bm.verts.new((x_outer, cy + radius_out * dy, cz + radius_out * dz))
        v_in_1  = bm.verts.new((x_outer, cy + radius_in * dy, cz + radius_in * dz))
        v_out_2 = bm.verts.new((x_inner, cy + radius_out * dy, cz + radius_out * dz))
        v_in_2  = bm.verts.new((x_inner, cy + radius_in * dy, cz + radius_in * dz))
        ring_verts_outer.append((v_out_1, v_out_2))
        ring_verts_inner.append((v_in_1, v_in_2))

    for i in range(segments):
        vo1_a, vo2_a = ring_verts_outer[i]
        vo1_b, vo2_b = ring_verts_outer[i+1]
        vi1_a, vi2_a = ring_verts_inner[i]
        vi1_b, vi2_b = ring_verts_inner[i+1]
        
        # Outer face (facing +/- X)
        if sign > 0:
            bm.faces.new([vo1_a, vo1_b, vi1_b, vi1_a])
            bm.faces.new([vo2_a, vi2_a, vi2_b, vo2_b])
            bm.faces.new([vo1_a, vo2_a, vo2_b, vo1_b]) # top rim
            bm.faces.new([vi1_a, vi1_b, vi2_b, vi2_a]) # inner liner
        else:
            bm.faces.new([vo1_a, vi1_a, vi1_b, vo1_b])
            bm.faces.new([vo2_a, vo2_b, vi2_b, vi2_a])
            bm.faces.new([vo1_a, vo1_b, vo2_b, vo2_a]) # top rim
            bm.faces.new([vi1_a, vi2_a, vi2_b, vi1_b]) # inner liner

def build_chassis_and_lower_body():
    body_mat = make_material("TruckPaint_Green", (0.08, 0.22, 0.12), roughness=0.25, metallic=0.1)
    under_mat = make_material("TruckUnderbody_Black", (0.05, 0.05, 0.05), roughness=0.8, metallic=0.2)

    bm = bmesh.new()

    # 1. Main frame rails (central chassis backbone, narrow: x in [-0.55, 0.55], well clear of wheel inner edges |x|=0.73)
    # y from -2.26 to +2.243 (length 4.503, center -0.0085), z in [0.30, 0.52] (raised so it does not hang too low)
    frame = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
    bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(1.10, 4.503, 0.22), verts=frame["verts"])
    bmesh.ops.translate(bm, vec=(0.0, -0.0085, 0.41), verts=frame["verts"])

    # Cross members / suspension blocks near axles
    for y_axle in [-1.45, 1.45]:
        cross = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
        bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(1.30, 0.30, 0.16), verts=cross["verts"])
        bmesh.ops.translate(bm, vec=(0.0, y_axle, 0.38), verts=cross["verts"])

    # 2. Axle rods connecting frame to wheel hubs (|x|=0.73)
    # Overlap wheel inner face by 2 mm (x from 0.54 to 0.732, center x = +-0.636, depth = 0.192)
    for wx, wy, wz in [(0.636, -1.45, 0.38), (-0.636, -1.45, 0.38), (0.636, 1.45, 0.38), (-0.636, 1.45, 0.38)]:
        axle = bmesh.ops.create_cone(bm, cap_ends=True, segments=16, radius1=0.04, radius2=0.04, depth=0.192)
        rot_ax = Matrix.Rotation(math.pi / 2, 4, 'Y')
        for v in axle["verts"]:
            v.co = rot_ax @ v.co + Vector((wx, wy, wz))

    # 3. Front Hood & Engine Bay Upper Section (above wheel tops z > 0.76)
    # Hood top surface: y in [-2.26, -1.00] (length 1.26, center -1.63), width x in [-0.87, 0.87] (width 1.74), z in [0.77, 1.01] (height 0.24, center 0.89)
    hood_upper = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
    bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(1.74, 1.26, 0.24), verts=hood_upper["verts"])
    bmesh.ops.translate(bm, vec=(0.0, -1.63, 0.89), verts=hood_upper["verts"])

    # Front hood nose / front fender forward of front wheel (y in [-2.26, -1.87], length 0.39, center -2.065)
    # Full width x in [-0.87, 0.87], z in [0.50, 0.78] (height 0.28, center 0.64)
    # This sits in front of the front wheel well cutout!
    hood_nose = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
    bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(1.74, 0.39, 0.28), verts=hood_nose["verts"])
    bmesh.ops.translate(bm, vec=(0.0, -2.065, 0.64), verts=hood_nose["verts"])

    # Inner engine bay wall / firewall between front wheels (y in [-1.87, -1.00], x in [-0.55, 0.55], z in [0.50, 0.78])
    # Inside the wheel well so wheel has full cutout space in x in [0.55, 0.94]
    hood_inner = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
    bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(1.10, 0.87, 0.28), verts=hood_inner["verts"])
    bmesh.ops.translate(bm, vec=(0.0, -1.435, 0.64), verts=hood_inner["verts"])

    # 4. Flared Wheel Arches (front and rear)
    # Front wheel arches: arched fender flares around front wheel (radius 0.42 to 0.47, center y=-1.45, z=0.38)
    for sx in [0.88, -0.88]:
        create_wheel_arch(bm, sx, -1.45, 0.38, radius_in=0.41, radius_out=0.47, width=0.10, segments=16)

    # Rear wheel arches: flared trim on sides at rear wheels (y=1.45, z=0.38, x=+-0.92)
    for sx in [0.93, -0.93]:
        create_wheel_arch(bm, sx, 1.45, 0.38, radius_in=0.41, radius_out=0.47, width=0.04, segments=16)

    # 5. Rocker panels / Side body sills between front & rear wheels (y in [-0.98, 0.98], length 1.96, center y=0.0)
    # x in [0.72, 0.88] (width 0.16, center +-0.80), z in [0.52, 0.952] (height 0.432, center 0.736)
    # Reaches 2 mm into Cab bottom at z=0.950, and stops before front/rear wheel openings at y=-0.98 and y=+0.98
    for side_x in [-0.80, 0.80]:
        sill = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
        bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(0.16, 1.96, 0.432), verts=sill["verts"])
        bmesh.ops.translate(bm, vec=(side_x, 0.0, 0.736), verts=sill["verts"])
        
        # Step bar / running board detail
        step = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
        bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(0.08, 1.40, 0.04), verts=step["verts"])
        bmesh.ops.translate(bm, vec=(side_x + (0.05 if side_x > 0 else -0.05), -0.20, 0.48), verts=step["verts"])

    # 6. Rear bed support subframe under bed floor (bed floor is at z in [0.670, 0.730])
    # Bed support top at z = 0.672 (overlaps bed floor by 2 mm), x in [-0.55, 0.55], y in [0.40, 2.24]
    bed_support = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
    bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(1.10, 1.84, 0.152), verts=bed_support["verts"])
    bmesh.ops.translate(bm, vec=(0.0, 1.32, 0.596), verts=bed_support["verts"])

    # Rear bumper mount extension at rear (y in [2.22, 2.26], length 0.04, center 2.24)
    r_mount = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
    bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(1.20, 0.06, 0.20), verts=r_mount["verts"])
    bmesh.ops.translate(bm, vec=(0.0, 2.23, 0.55), verts=r_mount["verts"])

    # Front bumper mount extension at front (y in [-2.26, -2.22])
    f_mount = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
    bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(1.20, 0.06, 0.20), verts=f_mount["verts"])
    bmesh.ops.translate(bm, vec=(0.0, -2.23, 0.55), verts=f_mount["verts"])

    me = bpy.data.meshes.new("ChassisAndLowerBody")

    obj = bpy.data.objects.new("ChassisAndLowerBody", me)

    obj.data.materials.append(under_mat)

"""FrontWheel — steerable front wheel assemblies with treaded rubber tires and alloy rims.

import math
import bpy

# Plan numbers:
# FrontWheel center (0.860, -1.450, 0.380) extents (0.260, 0.760, 0.760)

        arch = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
        bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(0.120, 0.880, 0.180), verts=arch["verts"])
        bmesh.ops.translate(bm, vec=(ax, -1.450, 0.860), verts=arch["verts"])

    # (F) Flared Wheel Arches - Rear (left and right)
    # Outer flare trim at y = 1.450, x at +-0.930 (outermost width 1.880), z in [0.700, 0.860]
    for ax in [0.930, -0.930]:
        arch = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
        bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(0.020, 0.880, 0.160), verts=arch["verts"])
        bmesh.ops.translate(bm, vec=(ax, 1.450, 0.780), verts=arch["verts"])

    # (G) Cab Lower Rocker Panels / Door Sills (between wheels: y in [-1.000, 0.400], length 1.400, center -0.300)
    # x at +-0.810 (width 0.140 -> x in [0.74, 0.88]), z from 0.540 to 0.952 (height 0.412, center 0.746) - 2mm overlap with Cab bottom
    for sx in [0.810, -0.810]:
        sill = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
        bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(0.140, 1.400, 0.412), verts=sill["verts"])
        bmesh.ops.translate(bm, vec=(sx, -0.300, 0.746), verts=sill["verts"])

    # (H) Bed Support Subframe (under bed floor: y in [0.400, 2.240], length 1.840, center 1.320)
    # x in [-0.550, 0.550], z from 0.540 to 0.672 (height 0.132, center 0.606) - 2mm overlap with bed floor bottom at 0.670
    bed_sub = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
    bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(1.100, 1.840, 0.132), verts=bed_sub["verts"])
    bmesh.ops.translate(bm, vec=(0.0, 1.320, 0.606), verts=bed_sub["verts"])

    # (I) Axles connecting chassis frame (|x|=0.620) to wheel hubs (|x|=0.730)
    # Overlap wheel inner hub by 2mm (depth 0.114 from 0.620 to 0.732, center x = +-0.676)
    rot_ax = Matrix.Rotation(math.pi / 2, 4, 'Y')
    for wx, wy, wz in [(0.676, -1.450, 0.380), (-0.676, -1.450, 0.380), (0.676, 1.450, 0.380), (-0.676, 1.450, 0.380)]:
        axle = bmesh.ops.create_cone(bm, cap_ends=True, segments=16, radius1=0.045, radius2=0.045, depth=0.114)
        for v in axle["verts"]:
            v.co = rot_ax @ v.co + Vector((wx, wy, wz))

    # Remove duplicates & weld internal vertices to eliminate any loose micro-islands
    bmesh.ops.remove_doubles(bm, verts=bm.verts, dist=0.001)

    me = bpy.data.meshes.new("ChassisAndLowerBody")
    bm.to_mesh(me)
    bm.free()

    obj = bpy.data.objects.new("ChassisAndLowerBody", me)
    bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(obj)
    obj.data.materials.append(paint_mat)
    obj.data.materials.append(chassis_black)

    # Assign underbody black to lower elements
    for poly in obj.data.polygons:
        if poly.center.z < 0.55 or (abs(poly.center.x) < 0.65 and poly.center.z < 0.76 and poly.center.y > -2.25):
            poly.material_index = 1
        else:
            poly.material_index = 0

    add_bevel_modifier(obj, width=0.015, segments=2, limit_angle=35.0)
    return obj

# 4 & 5. FrontWheel & RearWheel (with treaded tires, alloy rims, hub & 5-spoke star)
# Plan: center (0.860, +-1.450, 0.380) extents (0.260, 0.760, 0.760)
# x in [0.730, 0.990], y in [+-1.45 - 0.38, +-1.45 + 0.38], z in [0.000, 0.760]
# =============================================================================

def create_wheel_mesh(name_prefix: str, center_x: float, center_y: float, center_z: float, is_right: bool) -> bpy.types.Object:
    tire_mat = make_material(f"{name_prefix}_TireMat", (0.10, 0.10, 0.11), roughness=0.88, metallic=0.0)
    rim_mat = make_material(f"{name_prefix}_RimMat", (0.82, 0.83, 0.85), roughness=0.22, metallic=0.92)
    hub_mat = make_material(f"{name_prefix}_HubMat", (0.15, 0.15, 0.16), roughness=0.40, metallic=0.80)

    bm = bmesh.new()

    tire_outer_r = 0.380
    tire_width = 0.240
    rim_r = 0.225
    hub_r = 0.080
    rot_y = Matrix.Rotation(math.pi / 2, 4, 'Y')
    tread_h = 0.008

    # 1. Main Tire Body
    tire_base_r = tire_outer_r - tread_h
    t_cyl = bmesh.ops.create_cone(bm, cap_ends=True, segments=36, radius1=tire_base_r, radius2=tire_base_r, depth=tire_width)
    for v in t_cyl["verts"]:
        v.co = rot_y @ v.co

    # 2. Rugged Outer Tread Blocks (18 distinct raised tread lugs around the tire circumference)
    n_treads = 18
    tread_w = 0.055  # along circumference
    tread_l = 0.220  # across tire width
    for i in range(n_treads):
        ang = 2.0 * math.pi * i / n_treads
        tr = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
        bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(tread_l, tread_w, tread_h), verts=tr["verts"])
        rot_ang = Matrix.Rotation(ang, 4, 'X')
        # Translate to tire surface and rotate so total outer radius is exactly tire_outer_r (0.380)
        for v in tr["verts"]:
            v.co = rot_ang @ (v.co + Vector((0.0, 0.0, tire_base_r + tread_h / 2.0 - 0.001)))

    # 3. Alloy Rim (outer bevelled dish)
    rim_cyl = bmesh.ops.create_cone(bm, cap_ends=True, segments=28, radius1=rim_r, radius2=rim_r, depth=0.246)
    for v in rim_cyl["verts"]:
        v.co = rot_y @ v.co

    # 4. 5-Spoke Alloy Star Pattern on outer face
    # Outer face is at x = +0.120 if is_right else -0.120
    spoke_x = 0.122 if is_right else -0.122
    for s in range(5):
        spoke_ang = 2.0 * math.pi * s / 5.0
        spoke = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
        # Spoke geometry: length ~0.150, width ~0.040, depth ~0.015
        bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(0.015, 0.040, 0.150), verts=spoke["verts"])
        rot_spk = Matrix.Rotation(spoke_ang, 4, 'X')
        for v in spoke["verts"]:
            v.co = rot_spk @ (v.co + Vector((0.0, 0.0, 0.120)))
            v.co.x += spoke_x

    # 5. Central Hub & Lug Nut Cap
    hub_cyl = bmesh.ops.create_cone(bm, cap_ends=True, segments=18, radius1=hub_r, radius2=hub_r, depth=0.256)
    for v in hub_cyl["verts"]:
        v.co = rot_y @ v.co

    # Translate the entire assembled wheel to world coordinates
    bmesh.ops.translate(bm, vec=Vector((center_x, center_y, center_z)), verts=bm.verts)

    bmesh.ops.remove_doubles(bm, verts=bm.verts, dist=0.0005)

    me = bpy.data.meshes.new(name_prefix)
    bm.to_mesh(me)
    bm.free()

    obj = bpy.data.objects.new(name_prefix, me)
    bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(obj)
    obj.data.materials.append(tire_mat)
    obj.data.materials.append(rim_mat)
    obj.data.materials.append(hub_mat)

    for poly in obj.data.polygons:
        dy = poly.center.y - center_y
        dz = poly.center.z - center_z
        r_poly = math.sqrt(dy * dy + dz * dz)
        if r_poly < hub_r + 0.01:
            poly.material_index = 2
        elif r_poly < rim_r + 0.01:
            poly.material_index = 1
        else:
            poly.material_index = 0

    return obj


def build_front_wheel():
    objs = []
    objs.append(create_wheel_mesh("FrontWheel_0", 0.860, -1.450, 0.380, is_right=True))
    objs.append(create_wheel_mesh("FrontWheel_1", -0.860, -1.450, 0.380, is_right=False))
    return objs

# 7. Headlights
# Plan: center (0.720, -2.320, 0.740) extents (0.280, 0.080, 0.180)
# x in [0.580, 0.860], y in [-2.360, -2.280], z in [0.650, 0.830]
# =============================================================================

def create_headlight_mesh(name_prefix: str, center_x: float, center_y: float, center_z: float, is_right: bool) -> bpy.types.Object:
    glass_mat = make_material(f"{name_prefix}_Glass", (0.92, 0.95, 1.0), roughness=0.05, metallic=0.1)
    core_mat = make_material(f"{name_prefix}_Core", (1.0, 0.98, 0.9), roughness=0.1, metallic=0.8, emission=(1.0, 0.95, 0.85, 2.0))
    amber_mat = make_material(f"{name_prefix}_Amber", (0.95, 0.55, 0.05), roughness=0.1, metallic=0.1, emission=(0.95, 0.55, 0.05, 1.0))

    bm = bmesh.new()

    # Outer lens: y in [-2.360, -2.280] (center -2.320, depth 0.080)
    lens = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
    bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(0.280, 0.080, 0.180), verts=lens["verts"])
    bmesh.ops.translate(bm, vec=(center_x, center_y, center_z), verts=lens["verts"])

    # Bulb reflector cone
    bulb_x = center_x + (-0.04 if is_right else 0.04)
    bulb = bmesh.ops.create_cone(bm, cap_ends=True, segments=16, radius1=0.055, radius2=0.03, depth=0.04)
    rot_b = Matrix.Rotation(-math.pi / 2, 4, 'X')
    for v in bulb["verts"]:
        v.co = rot_b @ v.co + Vector((bulb_x, center_y - 0.01, center_z))

    # Amber indicator
    amber_x = center_x + (0.09 if is_right else -0.09)
    ind = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
    bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(0.060, 0.050, 0.140), verts=ind["verts"])
    bmesh.ops.translate(bm, vec=(amber_x, center_y - 0.01, center_z), verts=ind["verts"])

    bmesh.ops.remove_doubles(bm, verts=bm.verts, dist=0.001)

    me = bpy.data.meshes.new(name_prefix)
    bm.to_mesh(me)
    bm.free()

    obj = bpy.data.objects.new(name_prefix, me)
    bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(obj)
    obj.data.materials.append(glass_mat)
    obj.data.materials.append(core_mat)
    obj.data.materials.append(amber_mat)

    for poly in obj.data.polygons:
        if (is_right and poly.center.x > center_x + 0.06) or (not is_right and poly.center.x < center_x - 0.06):
            poly.material_index = 2
        elif abs(poly.center.x - bulb_x) < 0.06:
            poly.material_index = 1
        else:
            poly.material_index = 0

    add_bevel_modifier(obj, width=0.008, segments=2, limit_angle=35.0)
    return obj


def build_headlights():
    objs = []
    objs.append(create_headlight_mesh("Headlights_0", 0.720, -2.320, 0.740, is_right=True))
    objs.append(create_headlight_mesh("Headlights_1", -0.720, -2.320, 0.740, is_right=False))
    return objs

# x in [-0.920, 0.920], y in [2.260, 2.420], z in [0.410, 0.950]
# =============================================================================

def build_rear_bumper_and_taillights() -> bpy.types.Object:
    steel_mat = make_material("RearBumper_Steel", (0.15, 0.15, 0.16), roughness=0.4, metallic=0.7)
    step_mat = make_material("RearBumper_StepPad", (0.05, 0.05, 0.05), roughness=0.9, metallic=0.0)
    tail_red = make_material("Taillight_Red", (0.85, 0.05, 0.05), roughness=0.1, metallic=0.1, emission=(0.85, 0.05, 0.05, 1.5))
    tail_white = make_material("Taillight_White", (0.9, 0.9, 0.9), roughness=0.1, metallic=0.1, emission=(0.9, 0.9, 0.9, 1.0))

    bm = bmesh.new()

    # (A) Rear Steel Step Bumper: z in [0.410, 0.620], y in [2.243, 2.403], x in [-0.920, 0.920]
    bmp = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
    bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(1.840, 0.160, 0.210), verts=bmp["verts"])
    bmesh.ops.translate(bm, vec=(0.0, 2.323, 0.515), verts=bmp["verts"])

    # (B) Step Pad / Recess
    pad = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
    bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(0.600, 0.140, 0.060), verts=pad["verts"])
    bmesh.ops.translate(bm, vec=(0.0, 2.338, 0.580), verts=pad["verts"])

    # (C) Vertical Taillight Clusters (Left & Right): x at +-0.850, y in [2.243, 2.383], z in [0.650, 0.950]
    for tx in [-0.850, 0.850]:
        tl = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
        bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(0.140, 0.140, 0.300), verts=tl["verts"])
        bmesh.ops.translate(bm, vec=(tx, 2.313, 0.800), verts=tl["verts"])

    bmesh.ops.remove_doubles(bm, verts=bm.verts, dist=0.001)

    me = bpy.data.meshes.new("RearBumperAndTaillights")
    bm.to_mesh(me)
    bm.free()

    obj = bpy.data.objects.new("RearBumperAndTaillights", me)
    bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(obj)
    obj.data.materials.append(steel_mat)
    obj.data.materials.append(step_mat)
    obj.data.materials.append(tail_red)
    obj.data.materials.append(tail_white)

    for poly in obj.data.polygons:
        if poly.center.z > 0.64 and abs(poly.center.x) > 0.76:
            if poly.center.z < 0.74:
                poly.material_index = 3  # reverse white
            else:
                poly.material_index = 2  # brake red
        elif abs(poly.center.x) < 0.32 and poly.center.z > 0.55:
            poly.material_index = 1
        else:
            poly.material_index = 0

    add_bevel_modifier(obj, width=0.010, segments=2, limit_angle=35.0)
    return obj


# =============================================================================
# 9. SideMirror
# Plan: center (0.980, -0.720, 1.220) extents (0.240, 0.160, 0.140)
# x in [0.860, 1.100], y in [-0.800, -0.640], z in [1.150, 1.290]
# =============================================================================

def create_side_mirror_mesh(name_prefix: str, center_x: float, center_y: float, center_z: float, is_right: bool) -> bpy.types.Object:
    housing_mat = make_material(f"{name_prefix}_Housing", (0.08, 0.08, 0.09), roughness=0.6, metallic=0.1)
    mirror_mat = make_material(f"{name_prefix}_Glass", (0.95, 0.95, 0.98), roughness=0.05, metallic=0.98)

    bm = bmesh.new()

    hx = center_x + (0.030 if is_right else -0.030)
    hy = center_y
    hz = center_z

    # Housing
    house = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
    bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(0.180, 0.160, 0.140), verts=house["verts"])
    bmesh.ops.translate(bm, vec=(hx, hy, hz), verts=house["verts"])

    # Reflective Mirror Glass
    mglass = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
    bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(0.150, 0.020, 0.120), verts=mglass["verts"])
    bmesh.ops.translate(bm, vec=(hx, hy + 0.075, hz), verts=mglass["verts"])

    # Mounting Arm to Cab Door
    arm_start_x = (0.860 if is_right else -0.860)
    arm_end_x = (0.940 if is_right else -0.940)
    arm_len = abs(arm_end_x - arm_start_x)
    arm_cx = (arm_start_x + arm_end_x) / 2.0

    arm = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
    bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(arm_len + 0.010, 0.050, 0.040), verts=arm["verts"])
    bmesh.ops.translate(bm, vec=(arm_cx, center_y - 0.020, center_z - 0.020), verts=arm["verts"])

    bmesh.ops.remove_doubles(bm, verts=bm.verts, dist=0.001)

    me = bpy.data.meshes.new(name_prefix)
    bm.to_mesh(me)
    bm.free()

    obj = bpy.data.objects.new(name_prefix, me)
    bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(obj)
    obj.data.materials.append(housing_mat)
    obj.data.materials.append(mirror_mat)

    for poly in obj.data.polygons:
        if poly.center.y > hy + 0.06 and poly.normal.y > 0.5:
            poly.material_index = 1
        else:
            poly.material_index = 0

    add_bevel_modifier(obj, width=0.008, segments=2, limit_angle=35.0)
    return obj


def build_side_mirror():
    objs = []
    objs.append(create_side_mirror_mesh("SideMirror_0", 0.980, -0.720, 1.220, is_right=True))
    objs.append(create_side_mirror_mesh("SideMirror_1", -0.980, -0.720, 1.220, is_right=False))
    return objs


# =============================================================================
# Main entry & self-check
# =============================================================================

def _selfcheck():
    """Harness self-check verification."""
    bpy.context.view_layer.update()
    meshes = [o for o in bpy.data.objects if o.type == "MESH"]
    assert meshes, "no mesh objects built"
    for o in meshes:
        assert "." not in o.name, f"auto-suffixed name {o.name!r}: give every instance its own name"
    z_min = min((o.matrix_world @ Vector(c)).z for o in meshes for c in o.bound_box)
    assert abs(z_min) < 0.002, f"lowest point z={z_min:.4f}: the object must stand on z=0"
    print(f"[selfcheck] {len(meshes)} mesh objects, z_min={z_min:.4f}")


def main():
    build_chassis_and_lower_body()
    build_cab()
    build_cargo_bed()
    build_front_wheel()
    build_rear_wheel()
    build_front_grille_and_bumper()
    build_headlights()
    build_rear_bumper_and_taillights()
    build_side_mirror()
    _selfcheck()


if __name__ == "__main__" or True:
    main()

"""Cab — two-door driver cabin with tinted glass windows and roof.
"""
import math
import bpy
import bmesh
from mathutils import Vector, Matrix

# Plan:
# Cab center (0.000, -0.250, 1.340) extents (1.780, 1.500, 0.780)
# x in [-0.890, 0.890], y in [-1.000, 0.500], z in [0.950, 1.730]

def make_material(name, rgb, roughness=0.5, metallic=0.0):

    bsdf = mat.node_tree.nodes["Principled BSDF"]

    bsdf.inputs["Roughness"].default_value = roughness
    bsdf.inputs["Metallic"].default_value = metallic
    return mat

def build_cab():
    body_mat = make_material("Cab_Paint_Green", (0.08, 0.22, 0.12), roughness=0.25, metallic=0.1)
    glass_mat = make_material("Cab_Glass_Dark", (0.05, 0.08, 0.10), roughness=0.1, metallic=0.9)
    trim_mat = make_material("Cab_Trim_Black", (0.1, 0.1, 0.1), roughness=0.6, metallic=0.1)

    bm = bmesh.new()

    # 1. Main Cab Shell / Doors / Lower Cabin Base
    # Base from z = 0.950 to 1.320, y from -1.000 to 0.500, x from -0.890 to 0.890
    base = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
    bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(1.78, 1.50, 0.37), verts=base["verts"])
    bmesh.ops.translate(bm, vec=(0.0, -0.25, 1.135), verts=base["verts"]) # z from 0.950 to 1.320

    # 2. Upper cab / Greenhouse (Cabin Pillars and Roof frame)
    # Roof from z=1.320 to 1.730, y from -0.700 to 0.490, x from -0.850 to 0.850
    greenhouse = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
    bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(1.70, 1.19, 0.41), verts=greenhouse["verts"])
    bmesh.ops.translate(bm, vec=(0.0, -0.105, 1.525), verts=greenhouse["verts"]) # z from 1.320 to 1.730

    # 3. Windshield glass panel (flush / slightly recessed into sloped A-pillar front)
    # Front windshield at y = -0.70 to -0.66, z in [1.33, 1.71], width 1.56
    ws = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
    bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(1.56, 0.04, 0.38), verts=ws["verts"])
    rot_ws = Matrix.Rotation(math.radians(20), 4, 'X')
    bmesh.ops.transform(bm, matrix=Matrix.Translation(Vector((0.0, -0.68, 1.52))) @ rot_ws, verts=ws["verts"])

    # 4. Rear window (flush against cabin back wall at y = 0.485)
    rw = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
    bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(1.30, 0.03, 0.30), verts=rw["verts"])
    bmesh.ops.translate(bm, vec=(0.0, 0.485, 1.53), verts=rw["verts"])

    # 5. Side Door Windows (Left & Right, flush with cabin side at x = +-0.852)
    for sx in [-0.852, 0.852]:
        sw = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
        bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(0.02, 0.80, 0.30), verts=sw["verts"])
        bmesh.ops.translate(bm, vec=(sx, -0.15, 1.52), verts=sw["verts"])

    # 6. Door handles on sides (x = +-0.895, y = -0.15, z = 1.25)
    for hx in [-0.895, 0.895]:
        dh = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
        bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(0.02, 0.14, 0.035), verts=dh["verts"])
        bmesh.ops.translate(bm, vec=(hx, -0.15, 1.25), verts=dh["verts"])

    me = bpy.data.meshes.new("Cab")
    bm.to_mesh(me)
    bm.free()

    obj = bpy.data.objects.new("Cab", me)
    bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(obj)
    obj.data.materials.append(body_mat)
    obj.data.materials.append(glass_mat)
    obj.data.materials.append(trim_mat)

    # Assign glass and trim materials
    for poly in obj.data.polygons:
        # Check if poly belongs to windshield, rear window, or side windows
        if poly.center.z > 1.34:
            if abs(poly.center.y - (-0.68)) < 0.12 or abs(poly.center.y - 0.485) < 0.05 or abs(poly.center.x) > 0.84:
                poly.material_index = 1
            else:
                poly.material_index = 0
        elif abs(poly.center.x) > 0.885 and abs(poly.center.y - (-0.15)) < 0.10:
            poly.material_index = 2
        else:
            poly.material_index = 0

    bev = obj.modifiers.new("Bevel", "BEVEL")
    bev.width = 0.015
    bev.segments = 2
    bev.limit_method = "ANGLE"

    return obj

"""ChassisAndLowerBody — main chassis frame, front hood, and integrated flared wheel arches.
"""
import math
import bpy
import bmesh
from mathutils import Vector, Matrix

# Plan:
# center (0.000, -0.050, 0.650) extents (1.880, 4.650, 0.720)
# x in [-0.940, 0.940], y in [-2.375, 2.275], z in [0.290, 1.010]
# Wheels at y = -1.45 and y = 1.45, x = +-0.86, z = 0.38, r = 0.38 (inner edge x = +-0.730, outer edge x = +-0.990)
# Front bumper at y = -2.34 (touches at -2.26)
# Rear bumper at y = 2.34 (touches at 2.26)
# Bed sits on top at z in [0.67, 1.25], Cab sits on top at z in [0.95, 1.73]

def make_material(name, rgb, roughness=0.5, metallic=0.0):
    mat = bpy.data.materials.new(name)
    bsdf = mat.node_tree.nodes["Principled BSDF"]
    bsdf.inputs["Base Color"].default_value = (rgb[0], rgb[1], rgb[2], 1.0)
    bsdf.inputs["Roughness"].default_value = roughness
    bsdf.inputs["Metallic"].default_value = metallic
    return mat

def build_chassis_and_lower_body():
    body_mat = make_material("TruckPaint_Green", (0.08, 0.22, 0.12), roughness=0.25, metallic=0.1)
    under_mat = make_material("TruckUnderbody_Black", (0.05, 0.05, 0.05), roughness=0.8, metallic=0.2)

    bm = bmesh.new()

    # 1. Main frame rails / floor (central frame under body)
    # y from -2.26 to +2.243 (length 4.503, center -0.0085), x in [-0.70, 0.70], z in [0.30, 0.56]
    # Frame ends at y = 2.243 to touch rear bumper extending to 2.245 with 2mm overlap
    frame = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
    bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(1.40, 4.503, 0.26), verts=frame["verts"])
    bmesh.ops.translate(bm, vec=(0.0, -0.0085, 0.43), verts=frame["verts"])

    # 2. Front Hood & Engine Bay Upper Section
    # y from -2.26 to -1.00 (length 1.26), center y = -1.63
    # Front wheel is at y in [-1.83, -1.07]. Front wheel top is at z = 0.76, inner face |x|=0.73
    hood_upper = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
    bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(1.74, 1.26, 0.24), verts=hood_upper["verts"])
    bmesh.ops.translate(bm, vec=(0.0, -1.63, 0.89), verts=hood_upper["verts"])

    # Lower hood nose (in front of wheels, y in [-2.26, -1.84]) full width
    hood_nose = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
    bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(1.74, 0.42, 0.22), verts=hood_nose["verts"])
    bmesh.ops.translate(bm, vec=(0.0, -2.05, 0.66), verts=hood_nose["verts"])

    # Lower hood between wheels (y in [-1.84, -1.00]) narrower width x in [-0.70, 0.70]
    hood_engine = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
    bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(1.40, 0.84, 0.22), verts=hood_engine["verts"])
    bmesh.ops.translate(bm, vec=(0.0, -1.42, 0.66), verts=hood_engine["verts"])

    # 3. Flared Wheel Arches above wheels (z in [0.77, 0.95], well above wheel top at z=0.76)
    # Front wheel arches at y = -1.45, x = +-0.88, z = 0.86
    for ax, ay, az in [(0.88, -1.45, 0.86), (-0.88, -1.45, 0.86)]:
        arch = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
        bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(0.12, 0.88, 0.18), verts=arch["verts"])
        bmesh.ops.translate(bm, vec=(ax, ay, az), verts=arch["verts"])

    # Rear wheel arches outer trim: thin strip attached to chassis or flush against bed outer wall (|x|=0.92)
    # Bed side wall is at x in [0.84, 0.92], z in [0.67, 1.25].
    # Flared arch on rear at x = +-0.93 (thickness 0.02, x in [0.92, 0.94]), z in [0.70, 0.86], y = 1.45
    for ax, ay, az in [(0.93, 1.45, 0.78), (-0.93, 1.45, 0.78)]:
        arch = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
        bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(0.02, 0.88, 0.16), verts=arch["verts"])
        bmesh.ops.translate(bm, vec=(ax, ay, az), verts=arch["verts"])

    # 4. Axle rods connecting frame (|x|=0.70) to wheel inner face (|x|=0.73)
    # Overlap wheel inner face by exactly 2 mm (depth 0.034 from 0.70 to 0.732, center x = +-0.716)
    for wx, wy, wz in [(0.716, -1.45, 0.38), (-0.716, -1.45, 0.38), (0.716, 1.45, 0.38), (-0.716, 1.45, 0.38)]:
        axle = bmesh.ops.create_cone(bm, cap_ends=True, segments=16, radius1=0.04, radius2=0.04, depth=0.034)
        rot_ax = Matrix.Rotation(math.pi / 2, 4, 'Y')
        for v in axle["verts"]:
            v.co = rot_ax @ v.co + Vector((wx, wy, wz))

    # 5. Rocker panels / Cab lower side body under cab (y in [-1.00, 0.40])
    # x in [-0.88, 0.88], z in [0.55, 0.952] (reaches 2 mm into Cab bottom at z=0.950)
    for side_x in [-0.82, 0.82]:
        sill = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
        bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(0.12, 1.40, 0.40), verts=sill["verts"])
        bmesh.ops.translate(bm, vec=(side_x, -0.30, 0.75), verts=sill["verts"])

    # 6. Bed support pads under bed floor (bed floor is at z in [0.670, 0.730])
    # Bed support top is at z = 0.672 (overlaps bed floor by 2 mm)
    # y in [0.40, 2.24], x in [-0.55, 0.55] (well inside bed inner tub at x=0.56..0.84)
    bed_support = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
    bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(1.10, 1.80, 0.112), verts=bed_support["verts"])
    bmesh.ops.translate(bm, vec=(0.0, 1.32, 0.616), verts=bed_support["verts"])

    me = bpy.data.meshes.new("ChassisAndLowerBody")
    bm.to_mesh(me)
    bm.free()

    obj = bpy.data.objects.new("ChassisAndLowerBody", me)
    bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(obj)
    obj.data.materials.append(body_mat)
    obj.data.materials.append(under_mat)

    bev = obj.modifiers.new("Bevel", "BEVEL")
    bev.width = 0.012
    bev.segments = 2
    bev.limit_method = "ANGLE"

    return obj

"""FrontGrilleAndBumper — front radiator grille, badge, and heavy-duty front bumper.
"""
import math
import bpy
import bmesh
from mathutils import Vector, Matrix

# Plan:
# FrontGrilleAndBumper center (0.000, -2.340, 0.620) extents (1.820, 0.160, 0.520)

def make_material(name, rgb, roughness=0.5, metallic=0.0, emission=None):
    mat = bpy.data.materials.new(name)
    bsdf = mat.node_tree.nodes["Principled BSDF"]
    bsdf.inputs["Base Color"].default_value = (rgb[0], rgb[1], rgb[2], 1.0)
    bsdf.inputs["Roughness"].default_value = roughness
    bsdf.inputs["Metallic"].default_value = metallic
    if emission:
        bsdf.inputs["Emission Color"].default_value = (emission[0], emission[1], emission[2], 1.0)
        bsdf.inputs["Emission Strength"].default_value = emission[3]
    return mat


def add_bevel_modifier(obj, width=0.01, segments=2, limit_angle=30.0):
    bev = obj.modifiers.new("Bevel", "BEVEL")
    bev.width = width
    bev.segments = segments
    bev.limit_method = "ANGLE"
    bev.angle_limit = math.radians(limit_angle)

# 4 & 5. FrontWheel & RearWheel (with treaded tires, alloy rims, hub & 5-spoke star)
# Plan: center (0.860, +-1.450, 0.380) extents (0.260, 0.760, 0.760)
# x in [0.730, 0.990], y in [+-1.45 - 0.38, +-1.45 + 0.38], z in [0.000, 0.760]
# =============================================================================

def create_wheel_mesh(name_prefix: str, center_x: float, center_y: float, center_z: float, is_right: bool) -> bpy.types.Object:
    tire_mat = make_material(f"{name_prefix}_TireMat", (0.10, 0.10, 0.11), roughness=0.88, metallic=0.0)
    rim_mat = make_material(f"{name_prefix}_RimMat", (0.82, 0.83, 0.85), roughness=0.22, metallic=0.92)
    hub_mat = make_material(f"{name_prefix}_HubMat", (0.15, 0.15, 0.16), roughness=0.40, metallic=0.80)

    bm = bmesh.new()

    tire_outer_r = 0.380
    tire_width = 0.240
    rim_r = 0.225
    hub_r = 0.080
    rot_y = Matrix.Rotation(math.pi / 2, 4, 'Y')

    # 1. Main Tire Body
    tire_base_r = tire_outer_r - tread_h
    t_cyl = bmesh.ops.create_cone(bm, cap_ends=True, segments=36, radius1=tire_base_r, radius2=tire_base_r, depth=tire_width)
    for v in t_cyl["verts"]:
        v.co = rot_y @ v.co

    # 2. Rugged Outer Tread Blocks (18 distinct raised tread lugs around the tire circumference)
    n_treads = 18
    tread_w = 0.055  # along circumference
    tread_l = 0.220  # across tire width
    for i in range(n_treads):
        ang = 2.0 * math.pi * i / n_treads
        tr = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
        bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(tread_l, tread_w, tread_h), verts=tr["verts"])
        rot_ang = Matrix.Rotation(ang, 4, 'X')
        # Translate to tire surface and rotate so total outer radius is exactly tire_outer_r (0.380)
        for v in tr["verts"]:
            v.co = rot_ang @ (v.co + Vector((0.0, 0.0, tire_base_r + tread_h / 2.0 - 0.001)))

    # 3. Alloy Rim (outer bevelled dish)
    rim_cyl = bmesh.ops.create_cone(bm, cap_ends=True, segments=28, radius1=rim_r, radius2=rim_r, depth=0.246)
    for v in rim_cyl["verts"]:
        v.co = rot_y @ v.co

    # 4. 5-Spoke Alloy Star Pattern on outer face
    # Outer face is at x = +0.120 if is_right else -0.120
    spoke_x = 0.122 if is_right else -0.122
    for s in range(5):
        spoke_ang = 2.0 * math.pi * s / 5.0
        spoke = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
        # Spoke geometry: length ~0.150, width ~0.040, depth ~0.015
        bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(0.015, 0.040, 0.150), verts=spoke["verts"])
        rot_spk = Matrix.Rotation(spoke_ang, 4, 'X')
        for v in spoke["verts"]:
            v.co = rot_spk @ (v.co + Vector((0.0, 0.0, 0.120)))
            v.co.x += spoke_x

    # 5. Central Hub & Lug Nut Cap
    hub_cyl = bmesh.ops.create_cone(bm, cap_ends=True, segments=18, radius1=hub_r, radius2=hub_r, depth=0.256)
    for v in hub_cyl["verts"]:
        v.co = rot_y @ v.co

    # Translate the entire assembled wheel to world coordinates
    bmesh.ops.translate(bm, vec=Vector((center_x, center_y, center_z)), verts=bm.verts)

    bmesh.ops.remove_doubles(bm, verts=bm.verts, dist=0.0005)

    me = bpy.data.meshes.new(name_prefix)
    bm.to_mesh(me)
    bm.free()

    obj = bpy.data.objects.new(name_prefix, me)
    bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(obj)
    obj.data.materials.append(tire_mat)
    obj.data.materials.append(rim_mat)
    obj.data.materials.append(hub_mat)

    for poly in obj.data.polygons:
        dy = poly.center.y - center_y
        dz = poly.center.z - center_z
        r_poly = math.sqrt(dy * dy + dz * dz)
        if r_poly < hub_r + 0.01:
            poly.material_index = 2
        elif r_poly < rim_r + 0.01:
            poly.material_index = 1
        else:
            poly.material_index = 0

    return obj


def build_front_wheel():
    objs = []
    objs.append(create_wheel_mesh("FrontWheel_0", 0.860, -1.450, 0.380, is_right=True))
    objs.append(create_wheel_mesh("FrontWheel_1", -0.860, -1.450, 0.380, is_right=False))

    grille_frame = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)

        slat = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
        bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(1.050, 0.030, 0.030), verts=slat["verts"])
        bmesh.ops.translate(bm, vec=(0.0, -2.385, slat_z), verts=slat["verts"])

    # (F) Center Brand Emblem
    badge = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
    bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(0.180, 0.030, 0.070), verts=badge["verts"])
    bmesh.ops.translate(bm, vec=(0.0, -2.395, 0.730), verts=badge["verts"])

    bmesh.ops.remove_doubles(bm, verts=bm.verts, dist=0.001)

    me = bpy.data.meshes.new("FrontGrilleAndBumper")
    bm.to_mesh(me)
    bm.free()

    obj = bpy.data.objects.new("FrontGrilleAndBumper", me)
    bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(obj)
    obj.data.materials.append(bumper_mat)
    obj.data.materials.append(grille_mat)
    obj.data.materials.append(chrome_mat)

    for poly in obj.data.polygons:
        if poly.center.z < 0.58:
            poly.material_index = 0
        elif abs(poly.center.y - (-2.385)) < 0.02 or abs(poly.center.y - (-2.395)) < 0.02:
            poly.material_index = 2
        else:
            poly.material_index = 1

    add_bevel_modifier(obj, width=0.010, segments=2, limit_angle=35.0)

# =============================================================================
# 7. Headlights
# Plan: center (0.720, -2.320, 0.740) extents (0.280, 0.080, 0.180)
# x in [0.580, 0.860], y in [-2.360, -2.280], z in [0.650, 0.830]
# =============================================================================

def create_headlight_mesh(name_prefix: str, center_x: float, center_y: float, center_z: float, is_right: bool) -> bpy.types.Object:
    glass_mat = make_material(f"{name_prefix}_Glass", (0.92, 0.95, 1.0), roughness=0.05, metallic=0.1)
    core_mat = make_material(f"{name_prefix}_Core", (1.0, 0.98, 0.9), roughness=0.1, metallic=0.8, emission=(1.0, 0.95, 0.85, 2.0))
    amber_mat = make_material(f"{name_prefix}_Amber", (0.95, 0.55, 0.05), roughness=0.1, metallic=0.1, emission=(0.95, 0.55, 0.05, 1.0))

    bm = bmesh.new()

    # Outer lens: y in [-2.360, -2.280] (center -2.320, depth 0.080)
    lens = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
    bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(0.280, 0.080, 0.180), verts=lens["verts"])
    bmesh.ops.translate(bm, vec=(center_x, center_y, center_z), verts=lens["verts"])

    # Bulb reflector cone
    bulb_x = center_x + (-0.04 if is_right else 0.04)
    bulb = bmesh.ops.create_cone(bm, cap_ends=True, segments=16, radius1=0.055, radius2=0.03, depth=0.04)
    rot_b = Matrix.Rotation(-math.pi / 2, 4, 'X')
    for v in bulb["verts"]:
        v.co = rot_b @ v.co + Vector((bulb_x, center_y - 0.01, center_z))

    # Amber indicator
    amber_x = center_x + (0.09 if is_right else -0.09)
    ind = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
    bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(0.060, 0.050, 0.140), verts=ind["verts"])
    bmesh.ops.translate(bm, vec=(amber_x, center_y - 0.01, center_z), verts=ind["verts"])

    bmesh.ops.remove_doubles(bm, verts=bm.verts, dist=0.001)

    me = bpy.data.meshes.new(name_prefix)
    bm.to_mesh(me)
    bm.free()

    obj = bpy.data.objects.new(name_prefix, me)
    bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(obj)
    obj.data.materials.append(glass_mat)
    obj.data.materials.append(core_mat)
    obj.data.materials.append(amber_mat)

    for poly in obj.data.polygons:
        if (is_right and poly.center.x > center_x + 0.06) or (not is_right and poly.center.x < center_x - 0.06):
            poly.material_index = 2
        elif abs(poly.center.x - bulb_x) < 0.06:
            poly.material_index = 1
        else:
            poly.material_index = 0

    add_bevel_modifier(obj, width=0.008, segments=2, limit_angle=35.0)
    return obj


def build_headlights():
    objs = []
    objs.append(create_headlight_mesh("Headlights_0", 0.720, -2.320, 0.740, is_right=True))
    objs.append(create_headlight_mesh("Headlights_1", -0.720, -2.320, 0.740, is_right=False))
    return objs


# =============================================================================
# 8. RearBumperAndTaillights
# Plan: center (0.000, 2.340, 0.680) extents (1.840, 0.160, 0.540)
# x in [-0.920, 0.920], y in [2.260, 2.420], z in [0.410, 0.950]
# =============================================================================

def build_rear_bumper_and_taillights() -> bpy.types.Object:
    steel_mat = make_material("RearBumper_Steel", (0.15, 0.15, 0.16), roughness=0.4, metallic=0.7)
    step_mat = make_material("RearBumper_StepPad", (0.05, 0.05, 0.05), roughness=0.9, metallic=0.0)
    tail_red = make_material("Taillight_Red", (0.85, 0.05, 0.05), roughness=0.1, metallic=0.1, emission=(0.85, 0.05, 0.05, 1.5))
    tail_white = make_material("Taillight_White", (0.9, 0.9, 0.9), roughness=0.1, metallic=0.1, emission=(0.9, 0.9, 0.9, 1.0))

    bm = bmesh.new()

    # (A) Rear Steel Step Bumper: z in [0.410, 0.620], y in [2.243, 2.403], x in [-0.920, 0.920]
    bmp = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
    bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(1.840, 0.160, 0.210), verts=bmp["verts"])
    bmesh.ops.translate(bm, vec=(0.0, 2.323, 0.515), verts=bmp["verts"])

    # (B) Step Pad / Recess
    pad = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
    bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(0.600, 0.140, 0.060), verts=pad["verts"])
    bmesh.ops.translate(bm, vec=(0.0, 2.338, 0.580), verts=pad["verts"])

    # (C) Vertical Taillight Clusters (Left & Right): x at +-0.850, y in [2.243, 2.383], z in [0.650, 0.950]
    for tx in [-0.850, 0.850]:
        tl = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
        bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(0.140, 0.140, 0.300), verts=tl["verts"])
        bmesh.ops.translate(bm, vec=(tx, 2.313, 0.800), verts=tl["verts"])

    bmesh.ops.remove_doubles(bm, verts=bm.verts, dist=0.001)

    me = bpy.data.meshes.new("RearBumperAndTaillights")
    bm.to_mesh(me)
    bm.free()

    obj = bpy.data.objects.new("RearBumperAndTaillights", me)
    bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(obj)
    obj.data.materials.append(steel_mat)
    obj.data.materials.append(step_mat)
    obj.data.materials.append(tail_red)
    obj.data.materials.append(tail_white)

    for poly in obj.data.polygons:
        if poly.center.z > 0.64 and abs(poly.center.x) > 0.76:
            if poly.center.z < 0.74:
                poly.material_index = 3  # reverse white
            else:
                poly.material_index = 2  # brake red
        elif abs(poly.center.x) < 0.32 and poly.center.z > 0.55:
            poly.material_index = 1
        else:
            poly.material_index = 0

    add_bevel_modifier(obj, width=0.010, segments=2, limit_angle=35.0)
    return obj


# =============================================================================
# 9. SideMirror
# Plan: center (0.980, -0.720, 1.220) extents (0.240, 0.160, 0.140)
# x in [0.860, 1.100], y in [-0.800, -0.640], z in [1.150, 1.290]
# =============================================================================

def create_side_mirror_mesh(name_prefix: str, center_x: float, center_y: float, center_z: float, is_right: bool) -> bpy.types.Object:
    housing_mat = make_material(f"{name_prefix}_Housing", (0.08, 0.08, 0.09), roughness=0.6, metallic=0.1)
    mirror_mat = make_material(f"{name_prefix}_Glass", (0.95, 0.95, 0.98), roughness=0.05, metallic=0.98)

    bm = bmesh.new()

    hx = center_x + (0.030 if is_right else -0.030)
    hy = center_y
    hz = center_z

    # Housing
    house = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
    bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(0.180, 0.160, 0.140), verts=house["verts"])
    bmesh.ops.translate(bm, vec=(hx, hy, hz), verts=house["verts"])

    # Reflective Mirror Glass
    mglass = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
    bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(0.150, 0.020, 0.120), verts=mglass["verts"])
    bmesh.ops.translate(bm, vec=(hx, hy + 0.075, hz), verts=mglass["verts"])

    # Mounting Arm to Cab Door
    arm_start_x = (0.860 if is_right else -0.860)
    arm_end_x = (0.940 if is_right else -0.940)
    arm_len = abs(arm_end_x - arm_start_x)
    arm_cx = (arm_start_x + arm_end_x) / 2.0

    arm = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
    bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(arm_len + 0.010, 0.050, 0.040), verts=arm["verts"])
    bmesh.ops.translate(bm, vec=(arm_cx, center_y - 0.020, center_z - 0.020), verts=arm["verts"])

    bmesh.ops.remove_doubles(bm, verts=bm.verts, dist=0.001)

    me = bpy.data.meshes.new(name_prefix)
    bm.to_mesh(me)
    bm.free()

    obj = bpy.data.objects.new(name_prefix, me)
    bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(obj)
    obj.data.materials.append(housing_mat)
    obj.data.materials.append(mirror_mat)

    for poly in obj.data.polygons:
        if poly.center.y > hy + 0.06 and poly.normal.y > 0.5:
            poly.material_index = 1
        else:
            poly.material_index = 0

    add_bevel_modifier(obj, width=0.008, segments=2, limit_angle=35.0)
    return obj


def build_side_mirror():
    objs = []
    objs.append(create_side_mirror_mesh("SideMirror_0", 0.980, -0.720, 1.220, is_right=True))
    objs.append(create_side_mirror_mesh("SideMirror_1", -0.980, -0.720, 1.220, is_right=False))
    return objs


# =============================================================================
# Main entry & self-check
# =============================================================================

def _selfcheck():
    """Harness self-check verification."""
    bpy.context.view_layer.update()
    meshes = [o for o in bpy.data.objects if o.type == "MESH"]
    assert meshes, "no mesh objects built"
    for o in meshes:
        assert "." not in o.name, f"auto-suffixed name {o.name!r}: give every instance its own name"
    z_min = min((o.matrix_world @ Vector(c)).z for o in meshes for c in o.bound_box)
    assert abs(z_min) < 0.002, f"lowest point z={z_min:.4f}: the object must stand on z=0"
    print(f"[selfcheck] {len(meshes)} mesh objects, z_min={z_min:.4f}")


def main():
    build_chassis_and_lower_body()
    build_cab()
    build_cargo_bed()
    build_front_wheel()
    build_rear_wheel()
    build_front_grille_and_bumper()
    build_headlights()
    build_rear_bumper_and_taillights()
    build_side_mirror()
    _selfcheck()


if __name__ == "__main__" or True:
    main()

"""Cab — two-door driver cabin with tinted glass windows and roof.
"""
import math
import bpy
import bmesh
from mathutils import Vector, Matrix

# Plan:
# Cab center (0.000, -0.250, 1.340) extents (1.780, 1.500, 0.780)
# x in [-0.890, 0.890], y in [-1.000, 0.500], z in [0.950, 1.730]
# Attaches to: ChassisAndLowerBody (z overlaps chassis top at 0.95-1.01)

def make_material(name, rgb, roughness=0.5, metallic=0.0):
    mat = bpy.data.materials.new(name)
    bsdf = mat.node_tree.nodes["Principled BSDF"]
    bsdf.inputs["Base Color"].default_value = (rgb[0], rgb[1], rgb[2], 1.0)
    bsdf.inputs["Roughness"].default_value = roughness
    bsdf.inputs["Metallic"].default_value = metallic
    return mat

def build_cab():
    body_mat = make_material("Cab_Paint_Green", (0.08, 0.22, 0.12), roughness=0.25, metallic=0.1)
    glass_mat = make_material("Cab_Glass_Dark", (0.05, 0.08, 0.10), roughness=0.1, metallic=0.9)
    trim_mat = make_material("Cab_Trim_Black", (0.1, 0.1, 0.1), roughness=0.6, metallic=0.1)

    bm = bmesh.new()

    # 1. Main Cab Shell / Doors / Lower Cabin Base
    # Base from z = 0.950 to 1.320, y from -1.000 to 0.500, x from -0.890 to 0.890
    base = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
    bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(1.78, 1.50, 0.37), verts=base["verts"])
    bmesh.ops.translate(bm, vec=(0.0, -0.25, 1.135), verts=base["verts"]) # z from 0.950 to 1.320

    # 2. Upper cab / Greenhouse (Cabin Pillars and Roof frame)
    # Roof from z=1.320 to 1.730, y from -0.700 to 0.490, x from -0.850 to 0.850
    greenhouse = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
    bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(1.70, 1.19, 0.41), verts=greenhouse["verts"])
    bmesh.ops.translate(bm, vec=(0.0, -0.105, 1.525), verts=greenhouse["verts"]) # z from 1.320 to 1.730

    # 3. Windshield glass panel (flush / slightly recessed into sloped A-pillar front)
    # Front windshield at y = -0.70 to -0.66, z in [1.33, 1.71], width 1.56
    ws = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
    bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(1.56, 0.04, 0.38), verts=ws["verts"])
    rot_ws = Matrix.Rotation(math.radians(20), 4, 'X')
    bmesh.ops.transform(bm, matrix=Matrix.Translation(Vector((0.0, -0.68, 1.52))) @ rot_ws, verts=ws["verts"])

    # 4. Rear window (flush against cabin back wall at y = 0.485)
    rw = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
    bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(1.30, 0.03, 0.30), verts=rw["verts"])
    bmesh.ops.translate(bm, vec=(0.0, 0.485, 1.53), verts=rw["verts"])

    # 5. Side Door Windows (Left & Right, flush with cabin side at x = +-0.852)
    for sx in [-0.852, 0.852]:
        sw = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
        bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(0.02, 0.80, 0.30), verts=sw["verts"])
        bmesh.ops.translate(bm, vec=(sx, -0.15, 1.52), verts=sw["verts"])

    # 6. Door handles on sides (x = +-0.895, y = -0.15, z = 1.25)
    for hx in [-0.895, 0.895]:
        dh = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
        bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(0.02, 0.14, 0.035), verts=dh["verts"])
        bmesh.ops.translate(bm, vec=(hx, -0.15, 1.25), verts=dh["verts"])

    me = bpy.data.meshes.new("Cab")
    bm.to_mesh(me)
    bm.free()

    obj = bpy.data.objects.new("Cab", me)
    bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(obj)
    obj.data.materials.append(body_mat)
    obj.data.materials.append(glass_mat)
    obj.data.materials.append(trim_mat)

    # Assign glass and trim materials
    for poly in obj.data.polygons:
        # Check if poly belongs to windshield, rear window, or side windows
        if poly.center.z > 1.34:
            if abs(poly.center.y - (-0.68)) < 0.12 or abs(poly.center.y - 0.485) < 0.05 or abs(poly.center.x) > 0.84:
                poly.material_index = 1
            else:
                poly.material_index = 0
        elif abs(poly.center.x) > 0.885 and abs(poly.center.y - (-0.15)) < 0.10:
            poly.material_index = 2
        else:
            poly.material_index = 0

    bev = obj.modifiers.new("Bevel", "BEVEL")
    bev.width = 0.015
    bev.segments = 2
    bev.limit_method = "ANGLE"

    return obj

"""ChassisAndLowerBody — main chassis frame, front hood, and integrated flared wheel arches.
"""
import math
import bpy
import bmesh
from mathutils import Vector, Matrix

# Plan:
# center (0.000, -0.050, 0.650) extents (1.880, 4.650, 0.720)
# x in [-0.940, 0.940], y in [-2.375, 2.275], z in [0.290, 1.010]
# Wheels at y = -1.45 and y = 1.45, x = +-0.86, z = 0.38, r = 0.38 (inner edge x = +-0.730, outer edge x = +-0.990)
# Front bumper at y = -2.34 (touches at -2.26)
# Rear bumper at y = 2.34 (touches at 2.26)
# Bed sits on top at z in [0.67, 1.25], Cab sits on top at z in [0.95, 1.73]

def make_material(name, rgb, roughness=0.5, metallic=0.0):
    mat = bpy.data.materials.new(name)
    bsdf = mat.node_tree.nodes["Principled BSDF"]
    bsdf.inputs["Base Color"].default_value = (rgb[0], rgb[1], rgb[2], 1.0)
    bsdf.inputs["Roughness"].default_value = roughness
    bsdf.inputs["Metallic"].default_value = metallic
    return mat

def build_chassis_and_lower_body():
    body_mat = make_material("TruckPaint_Green", (0.08, 0.22, 0.12), roughness=0.25, metallic=0.1)
    under_mat = make_material("TruckUnderbody_Black", (0.05, 0.05, 0.05), roughness=0.8, metallic=0.2)

    bm = bmesh.new()

    # 1. Main frame rails / floor (central frame under body)
    # y from -2.26 to +2.243 (length 4.503, center -0.0085), x in [-0.70, 0.70], z in [0.30, 0.56]
    # Frame ends at y = 2.243 to touch rear bumper extending to 2.245 with 2mm overlap
    frame = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
    bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(1.40, 4.503, 0.26), verts=frame["verts"])
    bmesh.ops.translate(bm, vec=(0.0, -0.0085, 0.43), verts=frame["verts"])

    # 2. Front Hood & Engine Bay Upper Section
    # y from -2.26 to -1.00 (length 1.26), center y = -1.63
    # Front wheel is at y in [-1.83, -1.07]. Front wheel top is at z = 0.76, inner face |x|=0.73
    hood_upper = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
    bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(1.74, 1.26, 0.24), verts=hood_upper["verts"])

def create_wheel_mesh(name_prefix, center_x, center_y, center_z, is_right):
    tire_mat = make_material(f"{name_prefix}_TireMat", (0.12, 0.12, 0.13), roughness=0.85, metallic=0.0)
    rim_mat = make_material(f"{name_prefix}_RimMat", (0.80, 0.80, 0.82), roughness=0.25, metallic=0.9)
    hub_mat = make_material(f"{name_prefix}_HubMat", (0.1, 0.1, 0.1), roughness=0.4, metallic=0.5)

    bm = bmesh.new()

    tire_outer_r = 0.38
    tire_width = 0.24
    rim_r = 0.22
    hub_r = 0.08
    rot_x = Matrix.Rotation(math.pi / 2, 4, 'Y')

    # 1. Tire Main Tread & Sidewalls
    t_cyl = bmesh.ops.create_cone(bm, cap_ends=True, segments=36, radius1=tire_outer_r, radius2=tire_outer_r, depth=0.24)
    for v in t_cyl["verts"]:
        v.co = rot_x @ v.co

    # 2. Rim outer ring & deep dish
    rim_cyl = bmesh.ops.create_cone(bm, cap_ends=True, segments=24, radius1=rim_r, radius2=rim_r, depth=0.25)
    for v in rim_cyl["verts"]:
        v.co = rot_x @ v.co

    # 3. Hub cap
    hub_cyl = bmesh.ops.create_cone(bm, cap_ends=True, segments=16, radius1=hub_r, radius2=hub_r, depth=0.26)
    for v in hub_cyl["verts"]:
        v.co = rot_x @ v.co

    # Position entire wheel at (center_x, center_y, center_z)
    bmesh.ops.translate(bm, vec=Vector((center_x, center_y, center_z)), verts=bm.verts)

    me = bpy.data.meshes.new(name_prefix)
    bm.to_mesh(me)
    bm.free()
    obj = bpy.data.objects.new(name_prefix, me)
    bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(obj)
    obj.data.materials.append(tire_mat)
    obj.data.materials.append(rim_mat)
    obj.data.materials.append(hub_mat)

    for poly in obj.data.polygons:
        dy = poly.center.y - center_y
        dz = poly.center.z - center_z
        r_poly = math.sqrt(dy * dy + dz * dz)
        if r_poly < hub_r + 0.01:

            poly.material_index = 1
        else:
            poly.material_index = 0

    return obj

    objs = []

    objs.append(create_wheel_mesh("FrontWheel_0", 0.860, -1.450, 0.380, is_right=True))
    objs.append(create_wheel_mesh("FrontWheel_1", -0.860, -1.450, 0.380, is_right=False))
    return objs

def create_wheel_mesh(name_prefix, center_x, center_y, center_z, is_right):
    tire_mat = make_material(f"{name_prefix}_TireMat", (0.12, 0.12, 0.13), roughness=0.85, metallic=0.0)
    rim_mat = make_material(f"{name_prefix}_RimMat", (0.80, 0.80, 0.82), roughness=0.25, metallic=0.9)

    rim_r = 0.22
    hub_r = 0.08

    t_cyl = bmesh.ops.create_cone(bm, cap_ends=True, segments=36, radius1=0.365, radius2=0.365, depth=0.24)
    for v in t_cyl["verts"]:
        v.co = rot_x @ v.co

    num_treads = 24
    for i in range(num_treads):
        angle = 2.0 * math.pi * i / num_treads
        tr_y = math.sin(angle) * 0.3725
        tr_z = math.cos(angle) * 0.3725
        block = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
        bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(0.22, 0.035, 0.015), verts=block["verts"])
        rot_tr = Matrix.Rotation(-angle, 4, 'X')
        bmesh.ops.transform(bm, matrix=Matrix.Translation(Vector((0.0, tr_y, tr_z))) @ rot_tr, verts=block["verts"])

    # 3. Rim outer ring & deep dish
    rim_cyl = bmesh.ops.create_cone(bm, cap_ends=True, segments=24, radius1=rim_r, radius2=rim_r, depth=0.25)
    for v in rim_cyl["verts"]:
        v.co = rot_x @ v.co

        else:
            poly.material_index = 0

def build_front_wheel():

"""SideMirror — exterior side rearview mirrors.
"""
import math
import bpy
import bmesh
from mathutils import Vector, Matrix

# Plan:
# SideMirror center (0.980, -0.720, 1.220) extents (0.240, 0.160, 0.140)
# x in [0.860, 1.100], y in [-0.800, -0.640], z in [1.150, 1.290]

def make_material(name, rgb, roughness=0.5, metallic=0.0):

    bsdf = mat.node_tree.nodes["Principled BSDF"]
    bsdf.inputs["Base Color"].default_value = (rgb[0], rgb[1], rgb[2], 1.0)
    bsdf.inputs["Roughness"].default_value = roughness
    bsdf.inputs["Metallic"].default_value = metallic
    return mat

def create_side_mirror_mesh(name_prefix, center_x, center_y, center_z, is_right):
    housing_mat = make_material(f"{name_prefix}_Housing", (0.08, 0.08, 0.09), roughness=0.6, metallic=0.1)
    mirror_mat = make_material(f"{name_prefix}_Glass", (0.95, 0.95, 0.98), roughness=0.05, metallic=0.98)

    bm = bmesh.new()

    # 1. Aerodynamic mirror housing
    # Center of housing at x = center_x + (0.03 if is_right else -0.03) -> 1.01 / -1.01
    # Housing size: dx=0.18, dy=0.16, dz=0.14 -> x span [0.92, 1.10], y span [-0.80, -0.64], z span [1.15, 1.29]
    hx = center_x + (0.03 if is_right else -0.03)
    hy = center_y
    hz = center_z

    house = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
    bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(0.18, 0.16, 0.14), verts=house["verts"])
    bmesh.ops.translate(bm, vec=(hx, hy, hz), verts=house["verts"])

    # 2. Reflective mirror glass facing rearward (+Y)
    mglass = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
    bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(0.15, 0.02, 0.12), verts=mglass["verts"])
    bmesh.ops.translate(bm, vec=(hx, hy + 0.075, hz), verts=mglass["verts"])

    # 3. Mounting arm connecting to Cab door (x reaches from cab door +-0.86 to housing +-0.94)
    arm_start_x = (0.86 if is_right else -0.86)
    arm_end_x = (0.94 if is_right else -0.94)
    arm_len = abs(arm_end_x - arm_start_x)
    arm_cx = (arm_start_x + arm_end_x) / 2.0

    arm = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
    bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(arm_len + 0.01, 0.05, 0.04), verts=arm["verts"])
    bmesh.ops.translate(bm, vec=(arm_cx, center_y - 0.02, center_z - 0.02), verts=arm["verts"])

    me = bpy.data.meshes.new(name_prefix)
    bm.to_mesh(me)
    bm.free()

    obj = bpy.data.objects.new(name_prefix, me)
    bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(obj)
    obj.data.materials.append(housing_mat)
    obj.data.materials.append(mirror_mat)

    for poly in obj.data.polygons:
        # Glass face facing +Y
        if poly.center.y > hy + 0.06 and poly.normal.y > 0.5:
            poly.material_index = 1
        else:
            poly.material_index = 0

    bev = obj.modifiers.new("Bevel", "BEVEL")
    bev.width = 0.008
    bev.segments = 2
    bev.limit_method = "ANGLE"

    return obj

def build_side_mirror():
    objs = []
    # SideMirror_0: right side (+X), SideMirror_1: left side (-X)
    objs.append(create_side_mirror_mesh("SideMirror_0", 0.980, -0.720, 1.220, is_right=True))
    objs.append(create_side_mirror_mesh("SideMirror_1", -0.980, -0.720, 1.220, is_right=False))
    return objs

    -> x in [-1.050, 1.050]  y in [-2.400, 2.400]  z in [0.000, 1.760]
  * One mesh object per part, named EXACTLY as below (PascalCase); instances Name_0..Name_N-1,
    each TOP-LEVEL (never parented under an Empty — that merges them into ONE measured part).
  * LAYOUT: this file is the ENTRY. Each part lives in src/parts/<snake>.py and exports

ACCEPTANCE:

  - [a2] Two-door enclosed cab features transparent/tinted windshield, side windows, and rear window
  - [a3] Open rear cargo bed has distinct sidewalls, front bulkhead, and rear tailgate creating a recessed loading volume
  - [a4] Four wheels with treaded tires and central alloy hubs are placed in arched wheel wells
  - [a5] Front fascia contains a centered horizontal grille, dual headlights, and front bumper
  - [a6] Side rearview mirrors are mounted symmetrically on both left and right cab doors
  - [a7] All major subcomponents (cab, bed, chassis, wheels, mirrors) overlap by at least 2 mm without floating gaps
  - [must1] Includes: cab with windows
  - [must2] Includes: open rear bed
  - [must3] Includes: four wheels with hubs
  - [must4] Includes: front grille and headlights
  - [must5] Includes: side mirrors
"""
import bpy
from mathutils import Vector

from parts.chassis_and_lower_body import build_chassis_and_lower_body
from parts.cab import build_cab
from parts.cargo_bed import build_cargo_bed
from parts.front_wheel import build_front_wheel
from parts.rear_wheel import build_rear_wheel
from parts.front_grille_and_bumper import build_front_grille_and_bumper
from parts.headlights import build_headlights
from parts.rear_bumper_and_taillights import build_rear_bumper_and_taillights
from parts.side_mirror import build_side_mirror


def _selfcheck():
    """What the harness checks first: meshes exist, no auto-suffixed names, stands on z=0."""
    bpy.context.view_layer.update()
    meshes = [o for o in bpy.data.objects if o.type == "MESH"]
    assert meshes, "no mesh objects built"
    for o in meshes:
        assert "." not in o.name, f"auto-suffixed name {o.name!r}: give every instance its own name"
    z_min = min((o.matrix_world @ Vector(c)).z for o in meshes for c in o.bound_box)
    assert abs(z_min) < 0.002, f"lowest point z={z_min:.4f}: the object must stand on z=0"
    print(f"[selfcheck] {len(meshes)} mesh objects, z_min={z_min:.4f}")


def main():
    # build every part (order = plan order); parts are placed at world pose by their builders
    build_chassis_and_lower_body()
    build_cab()
    build_cargo_bed()
    build_front_wheel()
    build_rear_wheel()
    build_front_grille_and_bumper()
    build_headlights()
    build_rear_bumper_and_taillights()
    build_side_mirror()
    _selfcheck()


main()

"""
import math
import bpy
import bmesh
from mathutils import Vector, Matrix

# Plan numbers:
# FrontWheel center (0.860, -1.450, 0.380) extents (0.260, 0.760, 0.760)
# x in [0.730, 0.990], y in [-1.830, -1.070], z in [0.000, 0.760]

def make_material(name, rgb, roughness=0.5, metallic=0.0):
    mat = bpy.data.materials.new(name)
    bsdf = mat.node_tree.nodes["Principled BSDF"]
    bsdf.inputs["Base Color"].default_value = (rgb[0], rgb[1], rgb[2], 1.0)
    bsdf.inputs["Roughness"].default_value = roughness
    bsdf.inputs["Metallic"].default_value = metallic
    return mat

def create_wheel_mesh(name_prefix, center_x, center_y, center_z, is_right):
    tire_mat = make_material(f"{name_prefix}_TireMat", (0.12, 0.12, 0.13), roughness=0.85, metallic=0.0)
    rim_mat = make_material(f"{name_prefix}_RimMat", (0.80, 0.80, 0.82), roughness=0.25, metallic=0.9)
    hub_mat = make_material(f"{name_prefix}_HubMat", (0.1, 0.1, 0.1), roughness=0.4, metallic=0.5)

    bm = bmesh.new()

    tire_outer_r = 0.38
    rim_r = 0.22
    hub_r = 0.08
    rot_x = Matrix.Rotation(math.pi / 2, 4, 'Y')

    # 1. Tire Main Tread & Sidewalls (cylinder along X)
    t_cyl = bmesh.ops.create_cone(bm, cap_ends=True, segments=36, radius1=tire_outer_r, radius2=tire_outer_r, depth=0.24)
    for v in t_cyl["verts"]:
        v.co = rot_x @ v.co

    # 2. Add realistic tread blocks around the perimeter
    # 24 tread blocks around the circumference
    num_treads = 24
    for i in range(num_treads):
        angle = 2.0 * math.pi * i / num_treads
        tr_y = math.sin(angle) * tire_outer_r
        tr_z = math.cos(angle) * tire_outer_r
        block = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
        bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(0.22, 0.04, 0.015), verts=block["verts"])
        rot_tr = Matrix.Rotation(-angle, 4, 'X')
        bmesh.ops.transform(bm, matrix=Matrix.Translation(Vector((0.0, tr_y, tr_z))) @ rot_tr, verts=block["verts"])

    # 3. Rim outer ring & deep dish
    rim_cyl = bmesh.ops.create_cone(bm, cap_ends=True, segments=24, radius1=rim_r, radius2=rim_r, depth=0.25)
    for v in rim_cyl["verts"]:
        v.co = rot_x @ v.co

    # 4. Central alloy hub and 5 alloy spokes on the outer face
    outer_x = 0.12 if is_right else -0.12
    hub_cyl = bmesh.ops.create_cone(bm, cap_ends=True, segments=16, radius1=hub_r, radius2=hub_r, depth=0.26)
    for v in hub_cyl["verts"]:
        v.co = rot_x @ v.co

    for s in range(5):
        s_angle = 2.0 * math.pi * s / 5
        spk_y = math.sin(s_angle) * (rim_r * 0.55)
        spk_z = math.cos(s_angle) * (rim_r * 0.55)
        spoke = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
        bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(0.02, 0.035, rim_r * 0.7), verts=spoke["verts"])
        rot_s = Matrix.Rotation(-s_angle, 4, 'X')
        bmesh.ops.transform(bm, matrix=Matrix.Translation(Vector((outer_x, spk_y, spk_z))) @ rot_s, verts=spoke["verts"])

    # Position entire wheel at (center_x, center_y, center_z)
    bmesh.ops.translate(bm, vec=Vector((center_x, center_y, center_z)), verts=bm.verts)

    me = bpy.data.meshes.new(name_prefix)
    bm.to_mesh(me)
    bm.free()
    obj = bpy.data.objects.new(name_prefix, me)
    bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(obj)
    obj.data.materials.append(tire_mat)
    obj.data.materials.append(rim_mat)
    obj.data.materials.append(hub_mat)

    for poly in obj.data.polygons:
        dy = poly.center.y - center_y
        dz = poly.center.z - center_z
        r_poly = math.sqrt(dy * dy + dz * dz)
        if r_poly < hub_r + 0.01:
            poly.material_index = 2
        elif r_poly < rim_r + 0.01:
            poly.material_index = 1
        else:
            poly.material_index = 0

    return obj

def build_front_wheel():
    objs = []
    # FrontWheel_0: right side (+X), FrontWheel_1: left side (-X)
    objs.append(create_wheel_mesh("FrontWheel_0", 0.860, -1.450, 0.380, is_right=True))
    objs.append(create_wheel_mesh("FrontWheel_1", -0.860, -1.450, 0.380, is_right=False))
    return objs

"""
import math
import bpy
import bmesh
from mathutils import Vector, Matrix

# Plan numbers:
# FrontWheel center (0.860, -1.450, 0.380) extents (0.260, 0.760, 0.760)
# x in [0.730, 0.990], y in [-1.830, -1.070], z in [0.000, 0.760]

def make_material(name, rgb, roughness=0.5, metallic=0.0):

    bsdf.inputs["Base Color"].default_value = (rgb[0], rgb[1], rgb[2], 1.0)
    bsdf.inputs["Roughness"].default_value = roughness
    bsdf.inputs["Metallic"].default_value = metallic
    return mat

def create_wheel_mesh(name_prefix, center_x, center_y, center_z, is_right):
    tire_mat = make_material(f"{name_prefix}_TireMat", (0.12, 0.12, 0.13), roughness=0.85, metallic=0.0)
    rim_mat = make_material(f"{name_prefix}_RimMat", (0.80, 0.80, 0.82), roughness=0.25, metallic=0.9)
    hub_mat = make_material(f"{name_prefix}_HubMat", (0.1, 0.1, 0.1), roughness=0.4, metallic=0.5)

    bm = bmesh.new()

    tire_outer_r = 0.38
    rim_r = 0.22
    hub_r = 0.08
    rot_x = Matrix.Rotation(math.pi / 2, 4, 'Y')

    # 1. Tire Main Tread & Sidewalls (base cylinder inner radius 0.365)
    t_cyl = bmesh.ops.create_cone(bm, cap_ends=True, segments=36, radius1=0.365, radius2=0.365, depth=0.24)
    for v in t_cyl["verts"]:
        v.co = rot_x @ v.co

    # 2. Add realistic tread blocks around the perimeter extending to tire_outer_r = 0.380
    num_treads = 24
    for i in range(num_treads):
        angle = 2.0 * math.pi * i / num_treads
        tr_y = math.sin(angle) * 0.3725
        tr_z = math.cos(angle) * 0.3725
        block = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
        bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(0.22, 0.035, 0.015), verts=block["verts"])
        rot_tr = Matrix.Rotation(-angle, 4, 'X')
        bmesh.ops.transform(bm, matrix=Matrix.Translation(Vector((0.0, tr_y, tr_z))) @ rot_tr, verts=block["verts"])

    # 3. Rim outer ring & deep dish
    rim_cyl = bmesh.ops.create_cone(bm, cap_ends=True, segments=24, radius1=rim_r, radius2=rim_r, depth=0.25)
    for v in rim_cyl["verts"]:
        v.co = rot_x @ v.co

    # 4. Central alloy hub and 5 alloy spokes on the outer face
    outer_x = 0.10 if is_right else -0.10
    hub_cyl = bmesh.ops.create_cone(bm, cap_ends=True, segments=16, radius1=hub_r, radius2=hub_r, depth=0.255)
    for v in hub_cyl["verts"]:
        v.co = rot_x @ v.co

    for s in range(5):
        s_angle = 2.0 * math.pi * s / 5
        spk_y = math.sin(s_angle) * (rim_r * 0.55)
        spk_z = math.cos(s_angle) * (rim_r * 0.55)
        spoke = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
        bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(0.02, 0.035, rim_r * 0.7), verts=spoke["verts"])
        rot_s = Matrix.Rotation(-s_angle, 4, 'X')
        bmesh.ops.transform(bm, matrix=Matrix.Translation(Vector((outer_x, spk_y, spk_z))) @ rot_s, verts=spoke["verts"])

    # Position entire wheel at (center_x, center_y, center_z)
    bmesh.ops.translate(bm, vec=Vector((center_x, center_y, center_z)), verts=bm.verts)

    me = bpy.data.meshes.new(name_prefix)
    bm.to_mesh(me)
    bm.free()
    obj = bpy.data.objects.new(name_prefix, me)
    bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(obj)
    obj.data.materials.append(tire_mat)
    obj.data.materials.append(rim_mat)
    obj.data.materials.append(hub_mat)

    for poly in obj.data.polygons:
        dy = poly.center.y - center_y
        dz = poly.center.z - center_z
        r_poly = math.sqrt(dy * dy + dz * dz)
        if r_poly < hub_r + 0.01:
            poly.material_index = 2
        elif r_poly < rim_r + 0.01:
            poly.material_index = 1
        else:
            poly.material_index = 0

    return obj

def build_front_wheel():
    objs = []
    # FrontWheel_0: right side (+X), FrontWheel_1: left side (-X)
    objs.append(create_wheel_mesh("FrontWheel_0", 0.860, -1.450, 0.380, is_right=True))
    objs.append(create_wheel_mesh("FrontWheel_1", -0.860, -1.450, 0.380, is_right=False))
    return objs

    bsdf = mat.node_tree.nodes["Principled BSDF"]
    bsdf.inputs["Base Color"].default_value = (rgb[0], rgb[1], rgb[2], 1.0)
    bsdf.inputs["Roughness"].default_value = roughness
    bsdf.inputs["Metallic"].default_value = metallic
    return mat

def create_side_mirror_mesh(name_prefix, center_x, center_y, center_z, is_right):
    housing_mat = make_material(f"{name_prefix}_Housing", (0.08, 0.08, 0.09), roughness=0.6, metallic=0.1)
    mirror_mat = make_material(f"{name_prefix}_Glass", (0.95, 0.95, 0.98), roughness=0.05, metallic=0.98)

    bm = bmesh.new()

    # 1. Aerodynamic mirror housing
    # Center of housing at x = center_x + (0.03 if is_right else -0.03) -> 1.01 / -1.01
    # Housing size: dx=0.18, dy=0.16, dz=0.14 -> x span [0.92, 1.10], y span [-0.80, -0.64], z span [1.15, 1.29]
    hx = center_x + (0.03 if is_right else -0.03)
    hy = center_y
    hz = center_z

    house = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
    bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(0.18, 0.16, 0.14), verts=house["verts"])
    bmesh.ops.translate(bm, vec=(hx, hy, hz), verts=house["verts"])

    # 2. Reflective mirror glass facing rearward (+Y)
    mglass = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
    bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(0.15, 0.02, 0.12), verts=mglass["verts"])
    bmesh.ops.translate(bm, vec=(hx, hy + 0.075, hz), verts=mglass["verts"])

    # 3. Mounting arm connecting to Cab door (x reaches from cab door +-0.86 to housing +-0.94)
    arm_start_x = (0.86 if is_right else -0.86)
    arm_end_x = (0.94 if is_right else -0.94)
    arm_len = abs(arm_end_x - arm_start_x)
    arm_cx = (arm_start_x + arm_end_x) / 2.0

    arm = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
    bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(arm_len + 0.01, 0.05, 0.04), verts=arm["verts"])
    bmesh.ops.translate(bm, vec=(arm_cx, center_y - 0.02, center_z - 0.02), verts=arm["verts"])

    me = bpy.data.meshes.new(name_prefix)
    bm.to_mesh(me)
    bm.free()

    obj = bpy.data.objects.new(name_prefix, me)
    bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(obj)
    obj.data.materials.append(housing_mat)
    obj.data.materials.append(mirror_mat)

    for poly in obj.data.polygons:
        # Glass face facing +Y
        if poly.center.y > hy + 0.06 and poly.normal.y > 0.5:
            poly.material_index = 1
        else:
            poly.material_index = 0

    bev = obj.modifiers.new("Bevel", "BEVEL")
    bev.width = 0.008
    bev.segments = 2
    bev.limit_method = "ANGLE"

    return obj

def build_side_mirror():
    objs = []
    # SideMirror_0: right side (+X), SideMirror_1: left side (-X)
    objs.append(create_side_mirror_mesh("SideMirror_0", 0.980, -0.720, 1.220, is_right=True))
    objs.append(create_side_mirror_mesh("SideMirror_1", -0.980, -0.720, 1.220, is_right=False))
    return objs

    build_cargo_bed()
    build_front_wheel()

    build_front_grille_and_bumper()
    build_headlights()
    build_rear_bumper_and_taillights()
    build_side_mirror()
    _selfcheck()


main()

from mathutils import Vector, Matrix

    bsdf.inputs["Metallic"].default_value = metallic
    return mat

def create_wheel_mesh(name_prefix, center_x, center_y, center_z, is_right):
    tire_mat = make_material(f"{name_prefix}_TireMat", (0.12, 0.12, 0.13), roughness=0.85, metallic=0.0)
    rim_mat = make_material(f"{name_prefix}_RimMat", (0.80, 0.80, 0.82), roughness=0.25, metallic=0.9)
    hub_mat = make_material(f"{name_prefix}_HubMat", (0.1, 0.1, 0.1), roughness=0.4, metallic=0.5)

    bm = bmesh.new()

    tire_outer_r = 0.38
    rim_r = 0.22
    hub_r = 0.08
    rot_x = Matrix.Rotation(math.pi / 2, 4, 'Y')

    t_cyl = bmesh.ops.create_cone(bm, cap_ends=True, segments=36, radius1=0.365, radius2=0.365, depth=0.24)
    for v in t_cyl["verts"]:
        v.co = rot_x @ v.co

    # 2. Add realistic tread blocks around the perimeter extending to tire_outer_r = 0.380
    num_treads = 24
    for i in range(num_treads):
        angle = 2.0 * math.pi * i / num_treads
        tr_y = math.sin(angle) * 0.3725
        tr_z = math.cos(angle) * 0.3725
        block = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
        bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(0.22, 0.035, 0.015), verts=block["verts"])
        rot_tr = Matrix.Rotation(-angle, 4, 'X')
        bmesh.ops.transform(bm, matrix=Matrix.Translation(Vector((0.0, tr_y, tr_z))) @ rot_tr, verts=block["verts"])

    # 3. Rim outer ring & deep dish
    rim_cyl = bmesh.ops.create_cone(bm, cap_ends=True, segments=24, radius1=rim_r, radius2=rim_r, depth=0.25)
    for v in rim_cyl["verts"]:
        v.co = rot_x @ v.co

    # 4. Central alloy hub and 5 alloy spokes on the outer face
    outer_x = 0.10 if is_right else -0.10
    hub_cyl = bmesh.ops.create_cone(bm, cap_ends=True, segments=16, radius1=hub_r, radius2=hub_r, depth=0.255)

        s_angle = 2.0 * math.pi * s / 5
        spk_y = math.sin(s_angle) * (rim_r * 0.55)
        spk_z = math.cos(s_angle) * (rim_r * 0.55)
        spoke = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)

        rot_s = Matrix.Rotation(-s_angle, 4, 'X')
        bmesh.ops.transform(bm, matrix=Matrix.Translation(Vector((outer_x, spk_y, spk_z))) @ rot_s, verts=spoke["verts"])

    bmesh.ops.translate(bm, vec=Vector((center_x, center_y, center_z)), verts=bm.verts)

    obj = bpy.data.objects.new(name_prefix, me)

    obj.data.materials.append(tire_mat)
    obj.data.materials.append(rim_mat)
    obj.data.materials.append(hub_mat)

        dy = poly.center.y - center_y
        dz = poly.center.z - center_z
        r_poly = math.sqrt(dy * dy + dz * dz)
        if r_poly < hub_r + 0.01:
            poly.material_index = 2
        elif r_poly < rim_r + 0.01:
            poly.material_index = 1
        else:
            poly.material_index = 0

    return obj

def build_front_wheel():

    objs.append(create_wheel_mesh("FrontWheel_0", 0.860, -1.450, 0.380, is_right=True))
    objs.append(create_wheel_mesh("FrontWheel_1", -0.860, -1.450, 0.380, is_right=False))
    return objs

def create_wheel_mesh(name_prefix: str, center_x: float, center_y: float, center_z: float, is_right: bool) -> bpy.types.Object:
    tire_mat = make_material(f"{name_prefix}_TireMat", (0.10, 0.10, 0.11), roughness=0.88, metallic=0.0)
    rim_mat = make_material(f"{name_prefix}_RimMat", (0.82, 0.83, 0.85), roughness=0.22, metallic=0.92)

    # 2. Rugged Outer Tread Blocks (18 distinct raised tread lugs embedded into tire body)

    tread_w = 0.055  # along circumference
    tread_l = 0.220  # across tire width
    for i in range(n_treads):
        ang = 2.0 * math.pi * i / n_treads
        tr = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
        # Scale depth so it penetrates 0.008 into tire base, eliminating any floating gap
        bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(tread_l, tread_w, tread_h + 0.008), verts=tr["verts"])
        rot_ang = Matrix.Rotation(ang, 4, 'X')
        for v in tr["verts"]:

    # 3. Alloy Rim (outer bevelled dish)

    for v in rim_cyl["verts"]:
        v.co = rot_y @ v.co

    # 4. 5-Spoke Alloy Star Pattern on outer face (connected firmly into rim)
    spoke_x = 0.115 if is_right else -0.115
    for s in range(5):
        spoke_ang = 2.0 * math.pi * s / 5.0
        spoke = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
        bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(0.026, 0.045, 0.160), verts=spoke["verts"])
        rot_spk = Matrix.Rotation(spoke_ang, 4, 'X')
        for v in spoke["verts"]:
            v.co = rot_spk @ (v.co + Vector((0.0, 0.0, 0.110)))
            v.co.x += spoke_x

    # 5. Central Hub & Lug Nut Cap
    hub_cyl = bmesh.ops.create_cone(bm, cap_ends=True, segments=18, radius1=hub_r, radius2=hub_r, depth=0.256)
    for v in hub_cyl["verts"]:
        v.co = rot_y @ v.co

    # Translate the entire assembled wheel to world coordinates
    bmesh.ops.translate(bm, vec=Vector((center_x, center_y, center_z)), verts=bm.verts)

    bmesh.ops.remove_doubles(bm, verts=bm.verts, dist=0.0005)

    obj.data.materials.append(tire_mat)
    obj.data.materials.append(rim_mat)
    obj.data.materials.append(hub_mat)

    for poly in obj.data.polygons:
        dy = poly.center.y - center_y
        dz = poly.center.z - center_z
        r_poly = math.sqrt(dy * dy + dz * dz)
        if r_poly < hub_r + 0.01:
            poly.material_index = 2
        elif r_poly < rim_r + 0.01:
            poly.material_index = 1
        else:
            poly.material_index = 0

    return obj
